Apple-200682870.title: Product RF Design Engineer
Apple-200682870.description:
At Apple, you will have a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to deliver best in class performance for our wireless products. As a member of the Product RF team, you will be at the forefront of wireless technology, as we push the boundaries of achievable performance in wireless for state-of-the-art products. You will become part of a hands-on product development team that shape and influence current and future generations of Apple products. We're looking for self-driven and motivated engineers with good fundamentals in one or more areas of RF/wireless and electromagnetic theory, antenna design, system integration, & wireless communications.

Product RF Design Engineers should have a broad-based knowledge in aspects RF architecture, design, integration and manufacturing. They have deep theoretical and practical knowledge in one or more areas of electromagnetic theory, RF and Wireless circuit design, communication theory, and product design trade-off. They use electromagnetic and system simulation, hands on prototyping, test and measurement to understand complex system and sub-system interactions, implications to product level design, and manufacturing trade-offs to enable mass production.

Product RF Design Engineers apply their expertise in all aspects of product design from concept, architecture definition, integration and prototyping to final production.
They work closely with wireless and software architects, industrial designers, and product designers to guide and sculpt the product design with an eye towards optimizing RF functionality for the user.
Regular travels to manufacturing facilities are needed to support builds from prototype phase to mass production.
Apple-200682870.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
BSEE or equivalent education
Coursework or experience in antenna/RF design, wireless communications, EM, or circuits.
Knowledge of EM or RF or antenna design
Knowledge of integration of wireless technologies such as cellular, GPS, Wifi, and NFC into products.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
As a Product RF engineer, you would have the opportunity to work and expand on multiple aspects of RF technology. While these are not required from you, they will help you in pushing boundaries of innovation at Apple. A non-comprehensive list may include: 

Knowledge of electromagnetic simulation tools
Hands-on experience with RF lab instrumentation
Ability to debug desense issues and characterize noise sources
Experience with production environment and statistical analysis 
Excellent interpersonal skills

Apple-200676278.title: Quality Engineer
Apple-200676278.description:
Do you want to help build some of the largest and most consequential enterprise and customer technology systems in the world? Join Apple’s Information Systems and Technology (IS&T) organization. IS&T is the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. It’s Apple’s central nervous system. Supporting 2.5 billion active Apple devices, processing billions of secure transactions, and keeping the technology that defines modern life running flawlessly, IS&T makes the impossible feel effortless.  

Do you love building solutions to handle global complexity and immense scale? Imagine what you could do here.  Sales and Operations Engineering is part of IS&T and drives the technology behind Apple's global operations, sales, and supply chain. The team connects the systems that move products from factory to customer — bridging sales platforms with the operational infrastructure that keeps Apple running at scale and ensuring Apple's technology and business priorities move in lockstep.

The Sales Engineering team is the technical backbone powering our in-store and digital Channel Sales partner ecosystems. We connect business vision with technical execution, designing scalable, integrated systems that enhance customer engagement and partner performance. 

By combining deep technical expertise with strategic business insight, we help partners deliver personalized, data-driven experiences that build stronger relationships and drive measurable growth. Together, we empower our organization and partners to operate efficiently, adapt quickly, and thrive in an evolving landscape.

At our core, we’re innovators, problem solvers, and collaborators – focused on reliability, scalability, and continuous improvement. We’re always looking for curious problem-solvers who want to make a real impact in how technology drives business growth.

Will you join us in crafting solutions that do not yet exist?
Apple-200676278.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
B.S. in Computer Science or equivalent. 5+ years of relevant experience. 
Solid understanding of development lifecycles, testing methodologies, and QA processes.
Experienced in developing test plans, building tools, and test frameworks.
Computer Science fundamentals and experience in object-oriented design, data structures, and algorithms
Proficiency in a programming language (e.g. Java, Python, JavaScript, SQL)
Experience understanding and/or testing with APIs
Programming experience with automation scripting/tools/tests harness (e.g. Selenium, Cucumber, Karate, RestAssured, Appium)
Experience with building & leveraging Gen AI evaluation frameworks, skills, agents, plugins for QE workflow efficiencies. 
Strong debugging skills to identify software issues.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Experience testing AEM-based solutions is a plus.
Experience testing Salesforce ecosystem is a plus.

Apple-200631784.title: Quality System Lead (Head of QMS/ Management Representative), Health China
Apple-200631784.description:
Apple is where individual imaginations gather together, committing to the values that lead to great work. Every new product we build, service we create, or Apple Store experience we deliver is the result of us making each other’s ideas stronger. That happens because every one of us shares a belief that we can make something wonderful and share it with the world, changing lives for the better. It’s the diversity of our people and their thinking that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do. When we bring everybody in, we can do the best work of our lives. Here, you’ll do more than join something — you’ll add something.

Our ever-evolving suite of Heath and Wellness products for iPhone and Watch are helping our users live more active, healthier lives. Be ready to make something great when you come here. Dynamic, inspiring people and innovative, industry-defining technologies are the norm at Apple. The people who work here have reinvented and defined entire industries with our products and services. The same dedication to innovation also applies to our business practices -strengthening our commitment to leave the world better than we found it. 

The  Health group is looking for a Principle Quality System Lead to support regulated features in China. If you are passionate about the health space and want to have an incredible impact here at Apple, this could be the role for you. We are an efficient organization who works closely together to establish relationships across multiple functional teams. We care deeply about getting amazing new products into our customers hands.

Develop and maintain a robust quality system to ensure regulatory compliance and continuous improvement.
Supports region specific manufacturing registrations
Guides team members on the implementation of the quality system requirements.

Establishes site specific quality objectives and plans

Maintains the quality management system processes by creating / updating standard operating procedures to support regulatory requirements and process changes.Independently supports internal audit program. Schedules audits per an approved schedule, provides objective evidence of conformance to auditors, manages audit finding remediation and closure

Supports external audits as the front room lead. Manages audit preparation and execution 

Oversees the Quality Management Review process and ensures timely execution of management reviews including follow up on action items

Regularly report the operation of the quality management system and improvement needs to the legal representative and principal person in charge of the enterprise;

Manages and supports the supplier quality program. Including but not limited to: identification and qualification of suppliers, supplier corrective actions, and supplier monitoring.

Identifies, leads development of, and participates in implementation of new processes

Maintains a quality documentation management system

Maintains site training system and ensures completion of training for required personnel 

Maintains calibration system for on site equipment / fixtures 

Ensures validation of systems and processes; as required 

Monitors changes to global regulations and ensures policies and procedures reflect applicable changes and implements quality system best practices

Oversees adverse event reporting / recalls in country 

Ensure implementation of post market surveillance systems / reporting 

Ensure product technical requirements are accurately registered and manufactured product aligns to registration 

Ensure that products meet release requirements

Implement relevant laws, regulations, rules, mandatory standards are implemented. Monitor regulatory landscape for China market and ensure revisions to product / process standards are appropriately implemented.

Cooperate with regulatory authorities in supervision and inspection, and organize relevant departments of the enterprise to make timely rectifications in accordance with requirements regarding identified issues.

Bachelor’s Degree, or equivalent experience. 
7-10 years of experience in Quality Management Systems supporting Medical Devices.
Extensive experience in managing, maintaining and implementing quality management systems 
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Strong customer service orientation and corresponding skills
Excellent interpersonal skills working across multiple divisions
Attention to detail, well organized and time efficient

Apple-200681903.title: RCC Data Scientist
Apple-200681903.description:
Imagine what you could do here! The people here at Apple don’t just create products — they build the kind of wonder that’s revolutionized entire industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. At Apple, inclusion is a shared responsibility, and we work together to foster a culture where everyone belongs and is inspired to do their best work.

Here on the Apple Store Online team, we are responsible for Apple’s largest store. Our main goal is to deliver a magical, personal digital experience where customers can shop, buy and learn everything Apple, wherever they are. Each customer should feel like they are our only customer and our job is to set the bar for the experience they receive. To run such an extraordinary store, it takes extraordinary people, and we are looking for someone to help us do extraordinary things.

We are seeking a highly motivated Senior Data Scientist to shape our innovation strategy through advanced behavioral segmentation, pilot measurement, text analytics, and AI tools integration. In this role, you will be part of Apple Store Online, with a particular focus on Retail Customer Care (RCC) performance and decision support. Using data and quantitative techniques, the decision support team acts as a consultant, providing insights and recommendations to inform the organization’s innovation strategy and to drive operational performance excellence across Apple and vendor contact center sites.

In this role, you will define how we measure the performance of our end-to-end customer interaction systems and build analytical frameworks to compare outcomes across different interaction models. Working with structured operational data and unstructured conversation data at scale, you will apply NLP, experimentation, and statistical modeling to drive decisions that directly impact revenue, cost, and the customer experience. You will be a part of the Business Operations Analytics team within the Retail Contact Center, partnering closely with a wide range of cross-functional stakeholders to measure and optimize performance across our contact center operations.

* Establish KPIs, and design and measure controlled experiments to optimize the end-to-end customer interaction systems across voice and chat channels, evaluating performance, ROI, and customer experience impact using structured and unstructured data including transcripts, logs, and feedback. Apply NLP techniques to analyze conversation data, extracting insights on customer sentiment, interaction quality, resolution effectiveness, and emerging issues to identify improvement opportunities.
* Build analytical frameworks that enable rigorous comparison of customer outcomes, cost efficiency, and experience quality across different service delivery models.
* Apply statistical and ML techniques to understand customer interaction patterns — including contact drivers, resolution effectiveness, repeat contact behavior, and the comparative economics of different service channels.
* Partner closely with cross-functional teams to measure the performance of customer interaction systems, translating analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations for senior leadership to inform strategic decisions on deployment strategy, automation approach, and operational optimization.
* Build and maintain scalable analytical pipelines, models, and tooling that enable ongoing measurement and monitoring — moving beyond one-off analysis to production-grade analytical solutions.
* Develop self-service analytical tools — including automated reporting, interactive dashboards, and curated datasets — that empower business stakeholders to access routine performance insights independently.
Apple-200681903.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, mathematics, finance, statistics, econometrics, or other quantitative field, and 7+ years of professional experience in data science, machine learning, or advanced analytics within business analytics, e-commerce, and customer analytics.
Hands-on experience with text analytics, NLP, and sentiment analysis — including working with conversation or transcript data at scale.
Experience defining and establishing performance metrics and KPIs — particularly for new programs, systems, or technologies where measurement frameworks don't yet exist.
Experience designing and analyzing A/B tests and/or experience with quasi-experimental methods (e.g. causal inference, diff-in-diff, propensity matching, synthetic controls) to measure the impacts of business interventions.
Strong programming skills in Python and SQL for large-scale data manipulation and analysis. Proficiency in data visualization tools (Tableau preferred).
Strong communication and storytelling skills — the ability to translate complex analytical findings into clear recommendations for both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Master's degree in a quantitative field preferred.
Familiarity with modern cloud data platforms, particularly Snowflake and AWS.
Deep domain experience in contact center operations, customer experience analytics, or customer interaction measurement.
Hands-on experience leveraging LLMs and Generative AI to enhance analytical productivity and generate new insights.
Proven track record of stakeholder management and large-scale cross-functional project work.
Demonstrates Apple’s values. Contributes to an inclusive environment through respecting each other’s differences and having curiosity to learn.

Using data and quantitative techniques, the decision support team acts as a consultant, providing insights and recommendations to inform the organization’s innovation strategy and to drive operational performance excellence across Apple and vendor contact center sites.

In this role, you will define how we measure the performance of our end-to-end customer interaction systems and build analytical frameworks to compare outcomes across different interaction models. Working with structured operational data and unstructured conversation data at scale, you will apply NLP, experimentation, and statistical modeling to drive decisions that directly impact revenue, cost, and the customer experience. You will be a part of the Business Operations Analytics team within the Retail Contact Center, partnering closely with a wide range of cross-functional stakeholders to measure and optimize performance across our contact center operations.

* Establish KPIs, and design and measure controlled experiments to optimize the end-to-end customer interaction systems across voice and chat channels, evaluating performance, ROI, and customer experience impact using structured and unstructured data including transcripts, logs, and feedback. Apply NLP techniques to analyze conversation data, extracting insights on customer sentiment, interaction quality, resolution effectiveness, and emerging issues to identify improvement opportunities.
* Build analytical frameworks that enable rigorous comparison of customer outcomes, cost efficiency, and experience quality across different service delivery models.
* Apply statistical and ML techniques to understand customer interaction patterns — including contact drivers, resolution effectiveness, repeat contact behavior, and the comparative economics of different service channels.
* Partner closely with cross-functional teams to measure the performance of customer interaction systems, translating analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations for senior leadership to inform strategic decisions on deployment strategy, automation approach, and operational optimization.
* Build and maintain scalable analytical pipelines, models, and tooling that enable ongoing measurement and monitoring — moving beyond one-off analysis to production-grade analytical solutions.
* Develop self-service analytical tools — including automated reporting, interactive dashboards, and curated datasets — that empower business stakeholders to access routine performance insights independently.

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, mathematics, finance, statistics, econometrics, or other quantitative field, and 7+ years of professional experience in data science, machine learning, or advanced analytics within business analytics, e-commerce, and customer analytics.
Hands-on experience with text analytics, NLP, and sentiment analysis — including working with conversation or transcript data at scale.
Experience defining and establishing performance metrics and KPIs — particularly for new programs, systems, or technologies where measurement frameworks don't yet exist.
Experience designing and analyzing A/B tests and/or experience with quasi-experimental methods (e.g. causal inference, diff-in-diff, propensity matching, synthetic controls) to measure the impacts of business interventions.

Apple-200692446.title: RFHW Systems Engineer - Connectivity/NFC
Apple-200692446.description:
The RFHW Systems Engineer, Connectivity/NFC will work on the next-generation iPhone and other innovative products. You will be part of a world-class RF Design team, acting as the team’s local technical expert at manufacturing sites in China and towards relevant module suppliers in the region - combining deep hardware engineering expertise with modern AI-assisted workflow creation to drive engineering efficiency, design quality and fast-paced root-cause isolation from early prototype through mass production.

You will collaborate across R&D departments and manufacturing sites to design, build, validate, and optimize Connectivity (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, UWB) and NFC RF hardware systems for Apple products from first prototype build to mass production, ensuring seamless integration of wireless systems into consumer products. In this role, you will leverage modern AI tools to develop agentic workflows that automate, streamline, and transform traditional RF engineering tasks. We are looking for someone with an open mindset and the technical agility to explore AI adoption, alongside driving proactive cross-functional collaboration with engineering groups such as Antenna Design, System EE, Production Test, Reliability, Thermal, and FW/SW. Domestic and international travel may be required.
Apple-200692446.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Strong RF fundamentals, including RF matching, passive/active component design, and RF system integration.
Hands-on experience with RF test equipment (e.g., radio communication testers, VNAs, spectrum analyzers, signal generators, oscilloscopes) for lab testing and characterization.
Demonstrated ability to develop tools and agentic workflows to automate design and validation processes.
Strong troubleshooting capabilities, leveraging AI tools to conduct commonality studies, analyze large test logs, and synthesize historical FA learnings to accelerate root-cause resolution.
Excellent communication and organizational skills, with the agility and flexibility to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced work environment.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Wireless Communication / Electrical Engineering or related field, with 5+ years (for Bachelor’s) or 2+ years (for Master’s) of relevant industry experience.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Be fluent in wireless communication standards and wireless transceiver. 
Hands-on design, integration, or validation experience spanning Connectivity (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, UWB) and NFC technologies.
Experience supporting high-volume consumer electronics manufacturing environments.
In-depth understanding of antenna theory and design, magnetic induction loops, desense/EMC/EMI mechanisms and practical mitigation techniques.
Knowledge of thermal analysis, power management architectures (buck, LDO), and battery/charging interactions with NFC and RF subsystems.

Apple-200694023.title: RFHW Systems Engineer Intern - Shanghai or Shenzhen
Apple-200694023.description:
Apple is a place where extraordinary people gather to do their best work. Just be ready to dream big. 

The people here at Apple don’t just build products — they build the kind of wonder that’s revolutionized entire industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that encourages the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. Join Apple, and help us leave the world better than we found it.

Imaging what you could do here. At Apple, creative ideas have a way of becoming wonderful products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there’s no telling what you could accomplish.

The RFHW Systems Engineer Intern will support RF hardware development and NPI builds across Apple’s innovative product lineup (iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, etc.), focusing on wireless connectivity technologies. As part of a world-class RF design team, you will participate in technical execution both at Apple premises and manufacturing sites in China, with the opportunity to contribute to engineering workflow innovation by bringing an open, forward-thinking mindset to how AI is transforming modern RF engineering.

In this role, you will leverage modern AI tools to develop agentic workflows that automate, streamline, and transform traditional RF engineering tasks. Working with experienced RF engineers on accelerating the design-to-production closed loop. We are looking for someone with an open mindset and the technical agility to explore AI adoption. You will also collaborate with cross-functional teams including Antenna Design, System EE, Production Test, and FW/SW. This internship offers rich, hands-on exposure to critical disciplines for next-generation RF engineers. China domestic travel is likely.

Good understanding of RF fundamentals, including matching networks, passive/active components, and RF system integration.
Demonstrated ability to develop tools and agentic workflows to automate design and validation processes.
Strong written and verbal English communication skills for effective cross-functional collaboration.
Available for a 4–6 months internship, with a minimum commitment of 24 working hours per week. Full-time employment opportunities may be considered upon successful completion of the internship. 
Pursuing a Master’s degree with a combination of Wireless Communication/Electrical Engineering background and AI/Data Science skills, demonstrated through university coursework or personal projects.

Proficiency with AI tools to synthesize engineering data - such as parsing test logs, conducting commonality studies, and archiving/retrieving scattered domain knowledge to accelerate troubleshooting.

Apple-200691870.title: RFIC Validation and Characterization Engineer
Apple-200691870.description:
The Wireless RFIC team architects, designs, and validates the radio transceivers integrated into Apple's complex wireless SoCs. Our transceivers power the wireless connectivity of Apple's products, delivering industry-leading performance in the smallest form factors and at the lowest power. As a member of the RFIC team, you will test, debug, and characterize RF SoC IP, and contribute to innovative transceiver development in close partnership with Apple's systems and product teams. Would you like to join this dynamic team?

In this role, you will be a key contributor delivering end-to-end RF integration solutions for our advanced wireless SoC products, supporting the full product lifecycle from design and development through mass production. You will own the critical first bring-up of our wireless SoC RF, lead final silicon validation, and ensure compliance with rigorous industry standards. Your work will center on hands-on bench testing, debugging, and system characterization to ensure our RF IP meets and exceeds its performance targets. This is a unique opportunity to deepen your expertise across both hardware and software — spanning wireless transceiver architecture, RF systems, DSP, embedded systems, and the full productization of world-class products.

Perform hands-on bench testing, characterization, and debugging of RF SoC IP, including transmitters, receivers, PLLs, power amplifiers, and ADCs/DACs.
Drive bring-up and functional validation of new wireless SoCs, from first silicon to final product.
Design and develop radio calibrations, including algorithm development and optimization.
Automate RF measurements and data analysis by writing robust scripts (e.g., Python) to control test equipment and the device under test (DUT).
Characterize and optimize key RF performance metrics, such as EVM, spectral mask, phase noise, sensitivity, IP3, NF, and ACPR.
Debug complex chip-level and board-level issues, including desense and EMI.
Collaborate with RF Systems, Design, and Integration teams on board layout, test methodology, and calibration programming.
Produce comprehensive RF design verification, characterization, and test reports.
Develop and support RF calibration and test routines for ATE in mass production.
Apple-200691870.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Bachelor's degree.
Proven experience in RF test development, hands-on debugging, performance characterization, and reporting.
Strong scripting and automation skills in Python (highly desired), Perl, Tcl, C++, or similar languages.
Hands-on experience with standard RF test equipment, including network analyzers, spectrum analyzers, vector signal analyzers, and signal generators.
Solid understanding of RF fundamentals, wireless transceiver architectures, and digital communication systems.
Working knowledge of RF, PLL, and wireless system measurements (e.g., IP3, NF, ACPR, phase noise, lock time).
Experience with RF PCB design, layout considerations, and debugging.
Familiarity with RFIC block-level schematics and design/simulation environments.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Master's degree with relevant industry experience.
Strong RF background and a deep understanding of RF system fundamentals.
Experience in RF PCB design, debugging, and development.
Exposure to RFIC and SoC design, simulation, and verification.

Apple-200685828.title: SAP BTP Cloud Platform Security Engineer
Apple-200685828.description:
Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, great ideas have a way of becoming great products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. By bringing passion, dedication, and technical excellence to your job, there is no telling what you could accomplish. We are establishing a centralized team to support enterprise landscape modernization, leveraging the SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP), AliCloud, and other cloud technologies to drive secure, seamless application onboarding and cloud-native integrations.
As a Cloud Platform Security Engineer, you will define baseline security controls, governance frameworks, and secure reference architectures that enable development teams to adopt cloud technologies safely. You will work closely with functional, technical, and security stakeholders to translate complex compliance requirements into automated engineering controls, ensuring a secure, compliant, and resilient cloud platform ecosystem.

This role is responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining robust security controls across SAP BTP and hybrid cloud runtimes. You will author secure reference architectures, trust-boundary diagrams, and network security topologies to safeguard enterprise integrations and microservices. Additionally, you will partner with cross-functional teams to automate security testing, support compliance audits, and drive platform security optimization.

Design and implement baseline security controls, encryption strategies (at rest and in transit), and secrets management standards across Cloud Foundry, Kyma, and multi-cloud runtimes.
Develop and maintain secure reference architectures, trust-boundary diagrams, network security zones, and traffic flow models for enterprise integrations and microservices.
Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to define API security policies, rate-limiting rules, and data architecture security standards.
Embed robust security controls and automated compliance mechanisms into platform designs to minimize risk.
Build proofs-of-concept (PoCs) and rapid prototypes to demonstrate the feasibility of emerging security and cloud technologies.
Support internal and external compliance audits, risk assessments, and vulnerability remediations.
Drive ongoing platform optimization, elevating system reliability and cloud security standards across the ecosystem.
Apple-200685828.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
Experience (5+ years) in software engineering or cybersecurity, with a focus on designing, securing, and operating enterprise cloud platform solutions.
Experience implementing secure configurations on the SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) ecosystem, including application development/extension on Cloud Foundry or Kyma runtimes.
Experience securing integration touchpoints, including API gateway security, policy enforcement, rate-limiting, and payload validation in SAP Integration Suite or enterprise API Management platforms.
Experience securing message brokers and event mesh systems (such as Advanced Event Mesh, Apache Kafka, or Solace PubSub+).
Experience translating compliance and security requirements into actionable engineering controls.
Experience collaborating with multi-functional product and engineering teams to drive security initiatives.
Other: SAP BTP Certification (such as Administrator, Security, Technology Consultant, or related).

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Experience defining and enforcing enterprise SAP security governance frameworks, secure API policies, and data classification standards.
Experience with DevSecOps practices, including integrating automated security testing (SAST/DAST, dependency scanning, secret detection) into CI/CD pipelines and SAP Cloud Transport Management (CTMS).
Experience implementing cloud observability and monitoring tools (e.g., Dynatrace, SAP Cloud ALM, Prometheus, Grafana, or Splunk) for audit logging and security event detection.
Experience applying zero-trust architecture principles and secure network topology designs across hybrid (on-premises to public cloud) infrastructures.

Apple-200685831.title: SAP Security Engineer - SAP Cybersecurity
Apple-200685831.description:
Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish. 

Apple's global SAP landscape underpins how our products are planned, built, moved, and sold worldwide. The Information Systems & Technology (IS&T) SAP Cybersecurity team is seeking a dedicated Security Engineer to serve as our regional engineering cornerstone in Greater China. In this role, you will be instrumental in designing and implementing resilient security architectures across on-premise SAP systems and SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP), establishing advanced threat detection capabilities, and ensuring our critical infrastructure withstands active cyber threats. 

As a Security Engineer within the SAP Cybersecurity Program, you will take end-to-end ownership of securing mission-critical SAP systems and hybrid cloud platforms across the region. You will partner with globally distributed engineering teams, regional infrastructure peers, and business partners to embed security controls into every layer of our architecture. From platform hardening and identity federation to threat detection and offensive validation, your work will safeguard the enterprise backbone powering Apple’s operations. 

Architect and engineer platform-level security controls for regional SAP environments (S/4HANA, HANA, RFC/gateway, Web Dispatcher, and Cloud Connector), including transport encryption, key management, host baselines, and network segmentation. 
Secure and govern SAP BTP subaccounts, implementing least-privilege access, IAS/IPS identity federation, SAML/OIDC trust configurations, and secure integration pathways. 
Develop and tune high-fidelity threat detection rules for SAP-specific attacker behavior across the Security Audit Log (RSAU), HANA audit trails, BTP audit services, and Kyma runtime telemetry. 
Lead technical incident response and forensic containment for regional SAP security events, coordinating seamlessly with global incident response teams across time zones. 
Execute offensive validation and attack-path analysis across SAP protocols, BTP configurations, and containerized workloads to identify weaknesses and translate findings into lasting engineering defenses. 
Implement technical controls aligned with regional cybersecurity regulations, data security standards, commercial cryptography requirements, and cross-border data transfer mechanisms. 
Evaluate security posture across regional cloud hosting providers, external software components, and local service partners against Apple's rigorous security baseline. 
Collaborate cross-functionally with SAP Basis, infrastructure, network, and application teams to conduct technical design reviews and integrate security smoothly into existing operating models.
Apple-200685831.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. 
Experience in hands-on security engineering for enterprise ERP or large-scale, business-critical platforms, with technical depth in both on-premise SAP (NetWeaver, HANA) and SAP BTP. 
Experience analyzing and securing SAP technical attack surfaces at the protocol and infrastructure level (RFC, SAP Gateway, ICM/Web Dispatcher, SAProuter, Cloud Connector). 
Experience designing and implementing cloud identity, federation, and authorization architectures (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, JWT validation, mTLS, and SAP Cloud Identity Services). 
Experience in at least two core security domains: security architecture design, detection engineering/SIEM development, incident response, or offensive security and penetration testing. 
Experience with Linux system administration, network architecture, and scripting (Python preferred) to build automated security tooling. 
Professional fluency in written and spoken English and Mandarin, with experience collaborating across regional and globally distributed teams. 
Ability to support an overlapping schedule with US-based teammates and participate in occasional international travel. 

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Master’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or related technical field. 
Experience securing SAP environments subject to China regulatory frameworks. 
Experience administering and securing SAP BTP within the China (Shanghai) region, including local service catalogs and regional deployment constraints. 
Experience with SAP threat detection platforms (SAP Enterprise Threat Detection, Focused Run) and modern detection-as-code or SIEM workflows. 
Experience with Kubernetes and container security applied to SAP Kyma or cloud-native microservices. 
Experience with SAP Integration Suite security architecture at scale, including keystore and certificate lifecycle management. 
Experience evaluating cloud security postures across regional public cloud providers (such as Alibaba Cloud, Tencent Cloud, AWS China, or Azure China). 
Industry-recognized security certifications (such as CISSP, OSCP, or relevant cloud/SAP security credentials).

In this role, you will be instrumental in designing and implementing resilient security architectures across on-premise SAP systems and SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP), establishing advanced threat detection capabilities, and ensuring our critical infrastructure withstands active cyber threats. 

As a Security Engineer within the SAP Cybersecurity Program, you will take end-to-end ownership of securing mission-critical SAP systems and hybrid cloud platforms across the region. You will partner with globally distributed engineering teams, regional infrastructure peers, and business partners to embed security controls into every layer of our architecture. From platform hardening and identity federation to threat detection and offensive validation, your work will safeguard the enterprise backbone powering Apple’s operations. 

Architect and engineer platform-level security controls for regional SAP environments (S/4HANA, HANA, RFC/gateway, Web Dispatcher, and Cloud Connector), including transport encryption, key management, host baselines, and network segmentation. 
Secure and govern SAP BTP subaccounts, implementing least-privilege access, IAS/IPS identity federation, SAML/OIDC trust configurations, and secure integration pathways. 
Develop and tune high-fidelity threat detection rules for SAP-specific attacker behavior across the Security Audit Log (RSAU), HANA audit trails, BTP audit services, and Kyma runtime telemetry. 
Lead technical incident response and forensic containment for regional SAP security events, coordinating seamlessly with global incident response teams across time zones. 
Execute offensive validation and attack-path analysis across SAP protocols, BTP configurations, and containerized workloads to identify weaknesses and translate findings into lasting engineering defenses. 
Implement technical controls aligned with regional cybersecurity regulations, data security standards, commercial cryptography requirements, and cross-border data transfer mechanisms. 
Evaluate security posture across regional cloud hosting providers, external software components, and local service partners against Apple's rigorous security baseline. 
Collaborate cross-functionally with SAP Basis, infrastructure, network, and application teams to conduct technical design reviews and integrate security smoothly into existing operating models.

Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. 
Experience in hands-on security engineering for enterprise ERP or large-scale, business-critical platforms, with technical depth in both on-premise SAP (NetWeaver, HANA) and SAP BTP. 
Experience analyzing and securing SAP technical attack surfaces at the protocol and infrastructure level (RFC, SAP Gateway, ICM/Web Dispatcher, SAProuter, Cloud Connector). 
Experience designing and implementing cloud identity, federation, and authorization architectures (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, JWT validation, mTLS, and SAP Cloud Identity Services). 
Experience in at least two core security domains: security architecture design, detection engineering/SIEM development, incident response, or offensive security and penetration testing. 
Experience with Linux system administration, network architecture, and scripting (Python preferred) to build automated security tooling. 
Professional fluency in written and spoken English and Mandarin, with experience collaborating across regional and globally distributed teams. 
Ability to support an overlapping schedule with US-based teammates and participate in occasional international travel. 

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Master’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or related technical field. 
Experience securing SAP environments subject to China regulatory frameworks. 
Experience administering and securing SAP BTP within the China (Shanghai) region, including local service catalogs and regional deployment constraints. 
Experience with SAP threat detection platforms (SAP Enterprise Threat Detection, Focused Run) and modern detection-as-code or SIEM workflows. 
Experience with Kubernetes and container security applied to SAP Kyma or cloud-native microservices. 
Experience with SAP Integration Suite security architecture at scale, including keystore and certificate lifecycle management. 
Experience evaluating cloud security postures across regional public cloud providers (such as Alibaba Cloud, Tencent Cloud, AWS China, or Azure China). 
Industry-recognized security certifications (such as CISSP, OSCP, or relevant cloud/SAP security credentials).

Apple is where individual imaginations gather together, committing to the values that lead to phenomenal work! Every new product we build, service we create, or Apple experience we deliver is the result of us making each otherʼs ideas stronger. Apple-200677280.title: SRE Engineer
Apple-200677280.description:
Do you want to help build some of the largest and most consequential enterprise and customer technology systems in the world? Join Apple’s Information Systems and Technology (IS&T) organization.  IS&T is the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. It’s Apple’s central nervous system. Supporting 2.5 billion active Apple devices, processing billions of secure transactions, and keeping the technology that defines modern life running flawlessly, IS&T makes the impossible feel effortless.

Do you love building solutions to handle global complexity and immense scale? Imagine what you could do here.

Customer Systems is part of IS&T and drives the technology behind Apple's customer support experience — from contact center operations to the software powering the iconic Genius Bar. The team also builds and operates AppleCare's online support platform, which handles 6 billion visits per year, delivering seamless, high-quality support to Apple customers around the globe.

As an SRE at Apple, you will be part of a team who will implement and maintain best-in-class devops practices, work on complex technical challenges related to scalability, reliability and performance of Apple B2B systems. You will be managing the lifecycle of machine learning models in production and non-production environment. You will be responsible for continuously assessing and improving system processes, detecting anomalies, identify the areas of optimization and implementing solutions to enhance system reliability and performance. You should have a passion for programming and a good conceptual understanding of the operating environment - JVM, Operating System, File Systems, Network Protocols. Technical expertise, strong communication skills and teamwork are essential requirements for this role as it involves working with both technical and non-technical groups within Apple and externally with our supply chain partners.   

We are looking for a Senior SRE Engineer who can design, build, and scale a modern SRE ecosystem from scratch.  This role requires deep hands-on expertise, strong architectural thinking, and the ability to establish GitOps-driven, cloud-native CI/CD platforms using the latest technologies. The ideal candidate will act as a foundational engineer and technical leader, defining standards, tooling, automation, and reliability practices across the organization.

Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Designing and Building DevOps platforms end-to-end along with SRE/Platform Engineering.
Proven experience in building DevOps platforms from scratch.
Applied Experience on GitOps-based deployment models (ArgoCD / Flux)
Establish Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices.
Build and operate Kubernetes platforms (EKS / AKS / GKE / OpenShift)
Experience working in large-scale, distributed systems
Strong problem-solving and architectural skills
Proficiency in one or more programming languages (eg. Python) 
Support of internet-facing production services and distributed systems via deployments, onCall and Incident Management. Lead incident response, RCA, and reliability improvements.
Proficiency in implementing and coordinating telemetry using monitoring and observability tools like Splunk, Grafana, and Prometheus, or similar.
Experience in solving and resolving issues in Kubernetes from both an operating system and application perspective.
Building and operating container orchestrating systems like Kubernetes or EKS.
Strong programming experience in Java building web, middleware or backend applications. 
Deep understanding of Oracle or similar relational databases and NoSQL databases such as MongoDB. 
Firsthand experience in performance tuning of applications and databases. 
Knowledge of HTTP/S, TCP, DNS, web application load balancing. 
Deep understanding of basic security concepts and protocols - authentication, authorization, signing, encryption, SSL/TLS, SSH/SFTP, PKI, X509 certificates and PGP.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Strong programming experience in Java for backend, middleware, or web applications
Experience with NoSQL databases (MongoDB, Cassandra, DynamoDB, etc.)
Deep understanding of relational databases (Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL, etc.)
Hands-on experience in performance tuning of applications and databases
Experience with advanced observability practices:
-Distributed tracing
-SLO/SLI design
-Error budgets
Prior experience in large-scale, highly distributed production environments
Experience with container orchestration internals (scheduler, CNI, CSI, etc.)
Knowledge of middleware platforms such as WebMethods Integration Server or similar.
Experience with multi-cloud or hybrid cloud environments
Familiarity with service mesh technologies (Istio, Linkerd, etc.)

Apple-200685609.title: SRE Manager (Traffic and Secure Networking)

The Apple Services Engineering group is looking for a Senior Manager committed to lead our Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team dedicated to our Traffic, Load Balancing and Secure Networking at Apple. Whether you're thinking Site or Service, this SRE organization has ownership of it all. The team is working very closely with the development team to create the next generation of load balancers at Apple and the securitization of all network connections. Apple is a very large company and the challenges are many working with a variety of groups at Apple all looking for the highest availability, efficiency and performance possible.

As the Senior Manager you will help shape the future of load balancing working with teams in the UK, Canada and the United States. You will have a proven ability to solve problems whether they require a rapid response or a long term strategy. You will know when to make a critical decision or gain cross functional consensus. Apple-200681908.title: SRE Software Engineering Manager - ASE Compute
Apple-200681908.description:
People at Apple don't just build products, they craft the kind of experience that has revolutionized entire industries. The diverse collection of our people and their ideas inspire innovation in everything we do. Imagine what you could do here! Join Apple, and help us leave the world better than we found it.

The Apple Service Engineering (ASE) team builds and provides systems and infrastructure that power Apple's services (such as iCloud, Apple Music, Apple Intelligence, and Maps). We are the foundation on which Apple's software developers build the products that our customers love. Our services have to scale globally, stay highly available, and "just work." If you love designing, engineering, and running systems and infrastructure that will help millions of customers, then this is the place for you!

Apple's ASE Compute team builds and operates the private cloud infrastructure that powers Apple services at massive scale. Our platform delivers bare-metal Kubernetes clusters and virtualized environments to thousands of engineers across the company. We are looking for an SRE Manager to lead a team that keeps this infrastructure reliable, performant, and ready for the next order-of-magnitude growth.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will set the technical direction for reliability and operational excellence while mentoring engineers, driving automation, and partnering closely with software and infrastructure teams to ship improvements that matter.

Lead, grow, and mentor a team of Site Reliability Engineers focused on large-scale Kubernetes and compute infrastructure
Own the reliability, availability, and performance of mission-critical cloud platform services
Drive incident response, post incident reviews, and systemic improvements that reduce operational toil
Partner with software engineering and architecture teams to influence system design for reliability, scalability, and operability
Establish and refine SRE practices including SLOs, error budgets, capacity planning, and change management
Champion AI-powered tooling and automation to improve incident triage, reduce operational toil, drive capacity efficiency, and accelerate engineering workflows
Manage on-call rotations and ensure sustainable, well-supported operational coverage
Communicate clearly across teams to build a culture of visibility, transparency, and shared ownership
Apple-200681908.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
3+ years of engineering management experience leading infrastructure or SRE teams
Deep experience operating large-scale, multi-tenant Kubernetes environments in production
Strong systems background — comfortable troubleshooting across the full stack (network, OS, container runtime, application)
Experience with configuration management at scale (Puppet, Ansible, or equivalent)
Track record of building high-performing teams through coaching, clear expectations, and psychological safety
Demonstrated ability to drive cross-functional initiatives to completion
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Education: Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, an engineering-related field, or equivalent related experience

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Experience with third-party cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
Familiarity with bare-metal provisioning and lifecycle management at datacenter scale
Experience with Java, Go, or Python services in production

Apple-200690938.title: Senior Cloud Engineer (Wallet, Payments and Commerce)
Apple-200690938.description:
Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming phenomenal products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish. Apple Pay is transforming the industry in payments, transit and identity, and we're aggressively focusing on the customer's digital wallet experience. Our scale and security demands create unique opportunities for innovative and creative solutions which contribute to millions of customer's daily interactions.

The Wallet, Payments and Commerce (WPC) Cloud Engineering team is looking for an experienced Senior Cloud Engineer to take ownership of complex, ambiguous problems and drive cross-functional solutions that scale with our growth. In this role you'll independently lead significant pieces of our cloud platform, set technical direction on project teams, and raise the bar on quality, security, and customer focus across the organization.

Own the design and delivery of platform capabilities end-to-end — from gathering requirements with product and partner teams to running them in production.
Drive technical direction on multi-quarter initiatives, framing trade-offs and aligning engineering, security, quality, and SRE partners around shared outcomes.
Architect and evolve our platform-as-a-product offerings, treating internal developers as first-class customers and reducing the friction between idea and production.
Lead the design and rollout of Infrastructure build pipelines and CI/CD releases in a platform-as-a-product environment.
Solve complex problems using a mix of open-source and in-house tooling, balancing pragmatism with the long-term health of the platform.
Scale existing technologies and introduce new ones to outpace growth projections, and shepherd them from experiment to production-grade adoption.
Represent the team in cross-organization initiatives, partnering with adjacent platform, security and developer teams to keep our technical strategy cohesive.
Evangelize next-generation cloud and DevOps practices, building the credibility and shared understanding needed to bring them to fruition across WPC.
Apple-200690938.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
8+ years of Cloud infrastructure and platform engineering experience, with a track record of owning systems end-to-end in production.
Experience building platforms, Microservices and distributed systems … Experience building APIs on Kubernetes using frameworks such as gRPC, or REST.
Kubernetes and Containers… Been there, done that, and now you're the person others come to when the cluster is on fire. You've owned multi-tenant, multi-cluster, multi-region footprints end-to-end.
Infrastructure as Code, with deep Crossplane and Terraform experience… You've designed composition and provider patterns at scale, not just consumed them. The console is for read-only.
Public cloud expertise … You know which services to use, when to use them, and — just as importantly — when not to.
GitOps and CI/CD with Flux, Jenkins, Kargo… Everything ships through pipelines, promotion is declarative, and rollback is a non-event.
Strong networking fundamentals (NATs, TCP/IP, DNS, load balancing, mTLS). Linux internals and systems-level troubleshooting… When the symptom is "it's slow sometimes," you know how to find the actual cause.
Experience with Observability stacks (Prometheus, Thanos, Grafana, Datadog).

10+ years of work experience is highly desirable.
Strong programming proficiency in Golang and Kuberentes Operator pattern
Public Cloud expertise in AWS or AliCloud
Experience with service meshes (Istio Ambient mode, Cilium)
Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers, drive technical direction across a project team, and align solutions with business objectives in ambiguous, cross-functional environments and engage with senior leadership.

Apple-200683726.title: Senior Data Services SRE - ASE Databases
Apple-200683726.description:
Apple's Services Engineering organization (ASE) is seeking experienced distributed systems and database engineers to join our Databases SRE organization in Shanghai.

The Databases SRE organization runs the data service technologies that Apple's internet services are built on, Apache Cassandra, Apache Kafka, Apache Solr, Redis/Valkey, and coordination systems such as etcd and Apache ZooKeeper. Each of these is owned by a dedicated SRE team, and this posting covers engineering roles across all of them. You will join one of these teams, matched to your background and to where the Shanghai site needs depth; you are not expected to arrive with experience in all of these technologies.

ASE Databases SRE teams develop applications and tooling that are safe, reliable, scalable, and fast. This work requires an innovative spirit and an extraordinary degree of care and rigor in engineering. Team members contribute to all major components of our data service deployment infrastructure, including maintenance automation, backup services, monitoring and alerting tooling and dashboards, deployment architecture, and upstream contributions to the open source projects we run, focused on stability, performance, and scaling.

The team's work is deployed at massive scale, serving millions of queries per second over hundreds of petabytes of data across our data centers worldwide. It also has big impact, forming the platform upon which iCloud and many other internet services at Apple are built. In ASE, your work will benefit hundreds of millions of users and is critical to the success of some of the most visible current and future Apple features.

Day to day, you will own the reliability and performance of one of these platforms at Apple scale. The problems are shared across our teams even when the systems differ: replication and consistency, capacity and cost, safe rollouts across thousands of nodes, multi-datacenter failure domains, and the long tail of performance. Engineers regularly work across team boundaries on tooling and infrastructure common to all of our data services, so depth in one system and curiosity about the others matters more than experience with any specific technology.

Own the reliability, availability, and performance of one of Apple's data service platforms: Cassandra, Kafka, Solr, Redis/Valkey, or a coordination service such as etcd or ZooKeeper
Design, build, and operate the control plane, automation, and tooling that deploy and manage these systems at scale
Diagnose and resolve production problems across the full stack: application, JVM, operating system, storage, and network
Participate in on-call rotation and incident response, and drive post-incident reviews into systemic fixes
Build monitoring, alerting, and dashboards that make the health of the service legible to engineers and customers
Lead capacity planning, performance analysis, and efficiency work as the service grows
Execute safe, large-scale changes, rolling upgrades, expansions, and platform migrations, across thousands of nodes and multiple datacenters
Contribute patches upstream to the open source projects we run, focused on stability, performance, and scaling
Collaborate across the Databases SRE teams on shared tooling and infrastructure, and partner with Core Storage and Analytics teams
Support internal platform customers with a high degree of customer focus, working effectively with colleagues in other locations and time zones
Apple-200683726.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Demonstrated expertise developing distributed systems, database systems, storage engines, streaming or messaging systems, search platforms, coordination/consensus services, or performance engineering
Depth in at least one data service technology, and the curiosity to learn others (the specific system matters less than the distributed systems fundamentals behind it)
Understanding of core SRE concepts: monitoring, alerting, and incident management
Understanding of distributed systems concepts (consistency models, replication and consensus protocols, isolation levels, crash and recovery semantics)
Proficient in one or more of: modern Java, Go (golang), Python
Operating systems concepts (process scheduling, disk and network I/O, performance)
Strong written and verbal communication skills, and the ability to work effectively with a geographically distributed team
Education: BS or MS in Computer Science / related fields or equivalent work experience

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Experience developing critical internet services and/or platform infrastructure
Performance engineering (design concepts, profile-guided optimization)
Service management and migrations across bare metal, virtualized (EC2), and containerized (Kubernetes) platforms
Experience managing services run on Kubernetes
Experience with EC2, EBS, and Terraform
Fundamentals of system-level hardware and networking components (storage devices and controllers, network interfaces, CPU and memory layout in server-class systems)
Datacenter architecture (networking topologies, host placement strategies, and failure modes); design of multi-datacenter systems; failure domains; and wide-area networking
Experience contributing to open source distributed systems projects
Prior experience with development or maintenance of distributed databases, streaming systems, or storage systems

Apple-200685576.title: Senior Engineering Manager - Apple Data Platform
Apple-200685576.description:
Help us build the Apple Data Platform in China! We are establishing a new engineering organization from the ground up to build and operate Apple's next-generation data platform for customers in China. Our mission is to deliver a secure, scalable, and high-performance platform for data, analytics, and AI workloads while meeting regional regulatory and data residency requirements. 

Working in close partnership with the global Apple Data Platform organization, you'll help bring world-class platform capabilities to China, maintain architectural consistency and operational excellence, and establish a long-term engineering presence that powers critical Apple businesses across the region.

As a Senior Engineering Manager within the Apple Data Platform organization, you will build and lead the engineering team responsible for establishing and operating the Apple Data Platform in China. This is a unique greenfield opportunity to recruit, grow, and lead a world-class engineering organization while building the platform that will power data, analytics, and AI workloads for customers in China.

Your team will be responsible for building, deploying, operating, and evolving the Apple Data Platform stack, ensuring it delivers the same reliability, scalability, security, and operational excellence as the global platform while meeting regional regulatory and data residency requirements.

Build and scale the Apple Data Platform engineering organization in China, recruiting, mentoring, and developing a high-performing team from the ground up. 
Lead the design, deployment, operation, and evolution of the Apple Data Platform for customers in China, solving large-scale distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and data platform challenges. 
Partner closely with global Apple Data Platform teams across the United States and China to deliver platform capabilities while maintaining architectural consistency and appropriate feature parity. 
Own the platform’s availability, performance, security, and operational health, driving engineering excellence across automation, observability, incident management, and infrastructure operations. 
Collaborate across engineering, infrastructure, security, product, and SRE organizations to deliver a seamless and reliable platform experience. 
Define and execute the long-term technical strategy for Apple’s data platform in China, balancing regional requirements with global platform standards. 
Help shape one of Apple’s strategic global infrastructure initiatives while fostering a culture of technical excellence, collaboration, innovation, and accountability.
Apple-200685576.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
10+ years of experience designing, building, and operating large-scale distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, or data platform technologies in production environments. 
5+ years of engineering management experience leading high-performing software or infrastructure engineering teams. 
Proven experience recruiting, mentoring, and scaling engineering organizations. 
Strong technical expertise in cloud-native platforms, Kubernetes, distributed systems, and modern infrastructure architectures. 
Experience building and operating highly available, secure, and scalable platforms serving large-scale production workloads. 
Experience leading cross-functional initiatives across software engineering, infrastructure, security, and SRE organizations. 
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence technical strategy across geographically distributed teams. 
BS or MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Experience building or operating data, analytics, or AI platforms at enterprise scale. 
Experience deploying and operating platforms across public cloud providers (Alibaba Cloud, AWS, GCP) and private cloud or on-premises environments. 
Experience with technologies such as Kubernetes, Spark, Ray, Kafka, Trino, Iceberg, or other modern data platform technologies. 
Experience building engineering organizations or leading greenfield platform initiatives. 
Experience operating services in regulated environments with data residency, security, or compliance requirements. 
Experience working with globally distributed engineering teams and delivering platforms across multiple regions. 
Passion for building world-class engineering teams and fostering an inclusive, collaborative engineering culture.

Apple-200677825.title: Senior Engineering Manager, Core Data & Intelligence
Apple-200677825.description:
Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, new ideas become extraordinary products, services and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there is no telling what you can accomplish.

The Core Data & Intelligence organization builds the data, models and services that accelerate the growth of Apple's services. We are looking for a Senior Engineering Manager based in Shanghai, China to lead data engineering and quality efforts spanning Apple Services Engineering. You will build and lead a high-performing engineering team comprising data and quality engineers, set the technical direction for large-scale data foundations, services, and automated validation platforms, and partner with cross-functional leaders to turn business needs into scalable, high-quality, privacy-first solutions.

As a Senior Engineering Manager within Apple Services Engineering, you will direct an integrated engineering team responsible for the design, development, quality assurance and operation of massive-scale data pipelines and services across multiple lines of business. Your team's work will support customer-facing features, internal reporting and analytics, and external partner integrations, all held to Apple's exacting standards for reliability, data integrity and privacy.

You will drive both software delivery and quality engineering, championing automated testing, continuous verification, and robust data reconciliation across the entire data lifecycle. You will work across Apple's engineering and business groups, influence platform and quality strategy at the executive level, and build a culture where engineers grow their expertise and impact. This is a hands-on leadership role that demands deep technical judgment, operational rigor, and the ability to recruit, develop and retain top engineering and QA talent in Shanghai.

Team Leadership and Culture: Build, lead, and mentor an engineering team in Shanghai encompassing data engineers and a dedicated QA engineer. Foster a culture of craftsmanship, technical ownership, and continuous delivery.
Architecture and Delivery: Direct the end-to-end design, implementation, and production operations of robust, highly scalable data pipelines, platforms, and supporting backend services.
Hands-on Technical Leadership: Serve as a visible technical contributor, diving deep into architecture, data modeling, test strategies, and complex technical problems alongside the team rather than directing from a distance.
Quality and Verification Strategy: Champion the end-to-end data quality roadmap. Partner directly with QA and engineering to architect automated regression suites, pipeline validation harnesses, data reconciliation, and anomaly detection systems.
Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner with engineering, product, and data science teams across Apple to align data and validation capabilities with customer-facing features, business analytics, and partner integrations. Translate business requirements into technical capabilities and roadmaps.
People Development: Recruit, mentor, and retain top engineering and quality talent, supporting career progression and developing emerging technical leaders within the Shanghai hub.
Standards and Governance: Establish and uphold engineering standards for data accuracy, pipeline reliability, CI/CD, test coverage, scalability, and Apple's privacy-by-default principles.
AI and Automation: Guide the team in building and adopting LLM-powered applications, intelligent agents, and automated validation tools at scale to eliminate routine manual verification and boost developer velocity.
Executive Alignment: Communicate data and quality strategy, program milestones, operational health, and cross-team dependencies clearly to senior leadership and global stakeholders.
Apple-200677825.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
10+ years of software or data engineering experience, including 3+ years leading engineering teams with multi-functional scope managing data engineers, software engineers, or QA engineers.
Deep architectural expertise in large-scale data systems, distributed backend services, and software engineering best practices.
Proven track record in data quality engineering, establishing test automation frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, and validation or reconciliation strategies for complex data workflows.
Strong ability to move between hands-on technical depth (code, architecture, test harnesses) and high-level strategy with equal fluency.
Solid grasp of the full data lifecycle, including lineage, governance, data integrity, privacy, retention, and anonymity.
Experience managing cross-functional or hybrid teams of developers and QA or SDET in a global, multi-time-zone environment.
Experience planning and executing large-scale platform modernization, architecture refactoring, or migration programs.
Track record of recruiting, developing, and retaining diverse engineering talent and building high-performing team cultures.
Strong cross-functional collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to influence technical direction and alignment across diverse organizations without direct authority.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent work experience.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Hands-on experience with large-scale data processing and streaming technologies such as Spark, Flink, Kafka, Apache Iceberg, and Snowflake.
Familiarity with modern data testing and observability frameworks.
Background in AI and machine learning applications within data engineering contexts, such as feature pipelines, model evaluation, or intelligent agent workflows.
Experience operating data platforms at consumer-internet scale, balancing high throughput, low latency, data quality, and privacy.
Domain background in Commerce, Payments, Digital Content, or Subscriptions.
Familiarity with Apple's privacy principles or experience designing privacy-by-default, zero-trust data architectures.
Proven experience hiring and scaling high-caliber engineering teams in the China market.

The Apple Services Engineering team is one of the most exciting examples of Apple’s long-held passion for combining art and technology. These are the people who power the App Store, Apple TV, Apple Music, Apple Podcasts, and Apple Books. And they do it on an extensive scale, meeting Apple’s high expectations with dedication to deliver a huge variety of entertainment in over 35 languages to more than 150 countries. Our Program Managers partner with engineers who build secure, end-to-end solutions.   Thanks to Apple’s unique integration of hardware, software, and services, engineers and Program Managers partner to get behind a single unified vision. That vision always includes a deep commitment to strengthening Apple’s privacy policy, one of Apple’s core values. Although services are a bigger part of Apple’s business than ever before, these teams remain small, flexible, and cross-functional, offering greater exposure to the array of opportunities here.

Our team is looking for a dynamic EPM to help build and run the foundation that services that millions of customers use every day. We are looking for star performers to drive projects for various areas of Apple Cloud Infrastructure. You’ll be partnered with a team whose mission it is to build, maintain and improve Apple’s most critical cloud services. We’re looking for hardworking, passionate people to join our amazing team where we focus on extraordinary service availability, scalability and security while defining standards, implementing standard methodologies and improving operational efficiency. If you love non-routine work that requires social intelligence, complex critical thinking and creative problem solving, we’d love to hear from you!   ABOUT YOU: You are an ambitious individual who is proactive and able to work under minimal supervision at a detailed level while taking account of interdependencies at higher levels. You have experience running a complex set of software deliverables with many interdependencies and have a successful track record being a phenomenal partner within teams and across organizations in engineering, design, and leadership. Apple-200674488.title: Senior ML Optimization Engineer, iCloud
Apple-200674488.description:
In Apple’s iCloud services organization, efficiency is not just a technical goal; it's an essential part of our commitment to environmental sustainability and optimal resource utilization. This team plays a pivotal role in ensuring that our cloud services are not only robust and reliable but also efficiently utilize resources at scale. This team also focuses on ML-driven forecasting, capacity planning, resource optimization, and the development of sophisticated cost models for iCloud's large-scale services. As a Sr. ML Optimization Engineer, you will work at the intersection of systems engineering, infrastructure strategy, applied analytics, machine learning, and large-scale optimization. You will have the unique opportunity to collaborate closely with experts, contribute to cutting-edge forecasting and optimization strategies, and directly impact millions of users globally. Our team is at the forefront of driving efficiency in one of the world’s largest cloud infrastructures, supporting billions of devices globally.

The Sr. ML Optimization Engineer will be a key player in Apple’s ongoing efforts to improve the efficiency of its cloud services. This role involves in-depth analysis of infrastructure usage patterns, and data-driven capacity planning to ensure scalability and reliability while minimizing resource wastage.

You will help optimize the design, deployment, and operation of iCloud services.
You will collaborate closely with engineering teams, data scientists, and finance experts to develop and implement strategies that align with Apple’s cloud sustainability and resource utilization principles.
You will formulate and solve large-scale optimization problems to allocate capacity, schedule workloads, and minimize cost under reliability and latency constraints.
Your work will directly contribute to optimizing iCloud’s performance and resource utilization, influencing the unit cost of services and the overall customer experience.
Apple-200674488.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
3+ years of relevant experience in large-scale cloud services or similar environments
Strong software engineering background and experience with ML-based modeling, time-series forecasting, and data-driven decision making for cloud services
Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to communicate complex ideas clearly and effectively to cross-functional teams
Hands-on experience with platform observability tools, enabling deep insights into service performance and helping to drive optimizations
Experienced in developing cost models and strategies for software services, ensuring optimal resource utilization and cost-effectiveness
Bachelor or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Experience applying classical optimization techniques to real-world systems or infrastructure problems
Demonstrable experience in capacity planning and resource optimization using machine learning and/or optimization techniques
Knowledge of machine learning pipelines and service monitoring tools a plus
PhD in CS or related field with a focus on machine learning, optimization, or large-scale distributed systems
