Apple-200685581.title: Software Engineer - Cloud Services Engineering
Apple-200685581.description:
Imagine what you could do at Apple! Here, phenomenal ideas have a way of becoming great products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. We are seeking an extraordinary Software Engineer to join us in Apple Services Engineering focusing on designing, implementing, and managing new capabilities and tools for Kubernetes across data centers, private compute, and public cloud environments. Our team is responsible for ensuring the robust and scalable Kubernetes infrastructure, supporting critical Apple services, and collaborating with diverse internal customers. If this interests your creative and development chops, come join our team!

This is a highly technical, hands-on role within Apple Services Engineering. You'll be instrumental in designing, implementing, and managing new capabilities and tools for Kubernetes across both data centers and private compute environments, as well as public cloud services. We're looking for someone with extensive and deep experience in infrastructure and application management, coupled with practical knowledge of Kubernetes, public cloud platforms, software engineering, operations, and automation. You'll be responsible for ensuring the robust and scalable operation of our Kubernetes infrastructure, supporting critical Apple services. A key aspect of this role involves building and managing relationships with a diverse set of internal customers who rely on the platform. Your ability to collaborate effectively will be critical to our collective success. You'll be joining a team of highly skilled, enthusiastic, and passionate engineers working in a leading-edge and constantly evolving space.
Apple-200685581.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
3+ YOE of strong Kubernetes knowledge
3+ YOE of proficiency with various programming languages such as Go or Python or C++ and API patterns using REST/gRPC
Experience with developer tooling and containerization.
Experience operating and developing infrastructure and services in public cloud environments
Excellent communication skills, capable of working with cross-functional technical and business teams and varying levels of management, in a professional manner.
Bachelor's in Computer Science or equivalent

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
NA

Apple-200680564.description:
Join Apple’s innovative team to shape the future of traffic and service development. In this role, you will drive the design, development, and maintenance of network services, proxies, meshes, libraries, and other critical infrastructure components that ensure secure, scalable, and transparent connectivity across Apple cloud environments.

As a Traffic Engineer, you will orchestrate the design and development of cutting-edge traffic components. Our work ranges from network proxying and load balancing to security, routing, and quality of service. These components power Apple services at an unprecedented scale for hundreds of millions of users worldwide. In this role, you'll be instrumental in enhancing our network stack for improved secure service networking and fo ingress and egress functionality, helping architect the backbone of Apple.

This position goes beyond coding. It's about pushing the boundaries of what's possible in software development by addressing challenges at an extraordinary scale and driving innovation in traffic management. You will be empowered to make the right choices for our customers. If you're passionate about shaping the future of network engineering and influencing the direction of an industry giant, this is your opportunity to shine.

Here you will find that we: 

- Have a collaborative work environment where you can choose when to socialize and when to focus
- Provide technical guidance and mentorship
- Have an encouraging and growth-focused workplace culture
- Encourage you to use accrued vacation time and maintain a healthy work-life balance
Apple-200680564.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Bachelors degree in Computer Science or related field
4+ years of experience in software engineering
Skilled with one or more advanced programming language such as Go, Java, Rust, C or C++
Experience building large scale distributed systems
Full product lifecycle ownership mindset (design → implementation → production)
Passionate about improving the team and partners you work with
A growth mindset

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Traffic and Edge: Professional expertise in Traffic/Edge Engineering or Cloud Networking
Expertise with Open Source such as Envoy, Istio, or DPDK: Experience developing and deploying components for Envoy, including but not limited to EnvoyGateway and other proxy-related services. Experience working with packet processing tools.
Proficiency in Kubernetes: Experience with Kubernetes for orchestrating microservices, with knowledge of deployments, services, network policy, ingress and custom controllers.
Experience with Cloud Platforms: Experience with one or more major public cloud providers, including provisioning, networking, load balancing, and managed infrastructure services.
Infrastructure Traffic Experience: Familiarity with traffic management patterns, including mesh, service discovery, load balancing, observability, and security in modern distributed systems.
API Design: Ability to design RESTful APIs and gRPC services for integration with internal and external systems.
Collaborative Mindset: Strong communication skills with an ability to collaborate effectively with remote teams.
Experience with Large-Scale Distributed Systems: Experience in designing and maintaining large-scale systems that handle significant volumes of traffic across complex infrastructure setups. This includes knowledge of performance tuning, resource management, and the ability to scale systems efficiently.

Apple-200690888.title: Software Engineer Intern - Core OS
Apple-200690888.description:
The people here at Apple don't just build products - they build the kind of wonder that's revolutionized entire industries. It's the diversity of those people and their ideas that encourages the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. Join Apple, and help us leave the world better than we found it.

Passion works here. Apple is a place where extraordinary people gather to do their best work. Our community is made up of every kind of individual: artists and designers, engineers and scientists, problem solvers and doers. To- gather we create things and experiences people once couldn’t have imagined — and now can’t imagine living without. So if you’re excited by the idea of making a real impact, a career with Apple might be your dream job. Just be ready to dream big.

Apple’s CoreOS organisation is looking for an exceptional engineer intern to support and develop tools. For this position you need to work with multiple software teams to make sure all the software (BIOS, FWs, Mac OS X, diags, tools, etc.) in Macintosh system (MacBook Pro/Air, iMac, Mac mini, etc.) works well in all of the developing phases, including live debug in line, working with all software related teams to root cause and fix issues, and developing debug tools and new software functionality.

Develop, debug, and optimize low-level system components
Analyze system telemetry, crash logs, and performance data to triage bugs, improve power efficiency, and enhance overall OS stability
Work closely with full-time engineers and cross-functional teams to integrate new features, participate in code reviews, and contribute to Apple's internal testing and automation infrastructure
Take end-to-end ownership of a targeted technical project, culminating in a final presentation that demonstrates your architecture decisions, implementation, and impact to the team
Apple-200690888.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Have development and debugging experience on at least one platform
Have development or debugging experience in EFI BIOS/Linux Kernel developing/EC FWs/Solari or other UNIX/Windows/Mac OS X.
Good at communication in English and Mandarin

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Have relevant work experience in PC industry (notebook, desktop, server platform or embedded system)
Ambitious and willing to take on responsibility, real passion for work is very important
Excellent teammate

Apple-200694682.title: Software Engineer Manager
Apple-200694682.description:
AI & Data Platforms (AiDP) is IS&T's engine for AI-powered innovation. The team brings together data, application development, and machine learning — including generative AI — along with data services and customer success functions, to help IS&T build solutions more efficiently and streamline the adoption and embedding of generative AI across Apple.

At Apple, extraordinary ideas have a way of becoming excellent products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish. Would you like to work in a fast-paced environment where your technical abilities will be challenged on a day-to-day basis? If so, Apples Artificial Intelligence and Data Platforms (AiDP) team is seeking an experienced Software Engineering Manager to build high quality, scalable and resilient distributed systems that power Apple's cloud analytics platforms and data pipelines.

Apple's Enterprise Data Warehouse landscape caters to a wide variety of real-time, near real-time and batch analytical solutions. These solutions are an integral part of business functions like Sales, Operations, Finance, AppleCare, Marketing and Internet Services, enabling business drivers to make critical decisions. We utilize proprietary and open source technologies, Kafka, Spark, Iceberg, Airflow, Presto, etc. If you are looking to solve infrastructure problems at scale, both on-prem or in cloud, focusing on ease of use, ease of maintenance and most importantly implement solutions that are scalable, you will have fun in AiDP! 

If you enjoy learning new technologies, solving challenges with little mentorship, and are comfortable proposing and implementing solutions, demonstrating Software Engineering standard methodologies, you will find it rewarding to work in AiDP! The ideal candidate for this position will be able to think outside of the box and should have passion for building engineering solutions to enable business in making time sensitive and critical decisions.
This position is based in Shanghai, China.

We engineer high-quality, scalable and resilient distributed systems on cloud that power data exploration, analytics, reporting and production models. Our core systems are diverse and come with an unusual intersection of high data volumes with systems distributed across cloud and on-premise infrastructure. 

On our team you will build solutions that integrate open source software with Apple’s internal ecosystem. You will drive development of new components and features from concept to release: design, build, test, and ship at a regular cadence. You will work closely with internal customers to understand their requirements and workflows, and propose new features and ecosystem changes to streamline their experience of using the solutions on our platform.  

This is a hard-core software engineering role, where a large part of an engineer's time is spent in writing code and designing/developing applications on cloud, with the remainder being spent leading and providing technical guidance to engineers on tuning and debugging codebase, supporting production applications and supporting our application end users. This role requires in-depth knowledge of cutting-edge technologies and cloud data platform with an aptitude to independently learn new technologies and contribute to the success of various initiatives. 

We are looking for a hardworking and passionate person to join this amazing team. If you feel this is you, we'd love to hear from you.
Apple-200694682.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
7 or more years experience building enterprise level applications on large-scale distributed systems with a bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience.
Knowledge of BI concepts and implementation experience on Cloud with databases like SnowFlake or Big Query or Cloudera.
Programming experience in building high quality software. Proficiency in at-least one of the following programming languages - Python, Scala or Java. 
Strong hands-on experience in designing and development of cloud-based applications that include large scale compute services, database services, APIs to design RESTful services, ETL, queues and notification services.
Experience in developing highly optimized SQLs, procedures & semantic process for distributed data applications. 
Experience in a leading software engineers, providing technical guidance and reviewing codes.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Experience in Enterprise-ready Cloud Data-Warehousing platforms like Snowflake is highly valued
Hands-on knowledge of Spark cluster-computing framework & Kubernetes or similar containerization technologies.
Experience developing Big Data applications using Java, Spark, Kafka is a huge plus
Understanding of fundamentals of object-oriented design, data structures, algorithm design, and problem solving
Cloud technology experience on platforms like AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud
Data Visualization Tools: Proficient in data visualization, with experience in software such as Streamlit, Superset, Tableau, Business Objects, and Looker
Data Insights and KPIs: Working experience on generating and visualizing data insights, metrics, and KPIs. Usage of basic ML models in the space of anomaly detection, forecasting, GenAI. 
Experience in people development and/or mentoring technical engineers

Apple-200677378.title: Supplier Quality Engineer - Lens/Optical
Apple-200677378.description:
Imagine what you could do here! At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish. The people here at Apple don’t just build products — they build the kind of wonder that’s revolutionized entire industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that encourages the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts.   

Apple module engineering and quality team is looking for a motivated, technical oriented supplier quality engineer to manage Lens(optical part) module quality at suppliers. 
He / She will be responsible for developing and implementing quality processes and tools for all aspects of module quality during development and mass production, working with Apple cross functional teams and suppliers to ensure high quality product. 

Provide direction to suppliers, developing quality programs to ensure highest level of quality and reliability is consistently delivered.
Work with teams and lead suppliers for inspection system DFM and qualification, and OK2send processes at new product development phases.
Work with lens optical engineering/TPM to define quality specification as necessary.
Define quality specification (SOP, cosmetic spec, etc) as necessary
Set up incoming material inspection, testing and sampling plan to ensure robust incoming quality control at suppliers
Work with TPM and suppliers to set up CTQ process control in manufacturing line, take actions to drive continuous process improvement
Establish OQC inspection and testing process through guard band and tester correlation to ensure out-going parts quality
Interface with suppliers in resolving complex manufacturing process, quality and reliability issues, utilizing DOE and statistical approach
Develop robust processes for FA on customer returns in order to synthesize voice of customer into process changes and product development cycles to impact current and future products.
Publish reports on supplier performance based on production line statistics, system level data and address these issues
Regular process audits to ensure vendor comply with POR process parameters and achieve expected results
Build up data digitalization system with quality sense and computer science.
Good at lens optical process and knows how to do good quality control at molding/lens assembly/lens optical testing

Apple-200685593.title: Systems SRE - Shanghai - Tech Lead Manager
Apple-200685593.description:
People at Apple don't just build products — they craft the kind of experiences that have revolutionized entire industries. The diverse collection of our people and their ideas inspire innovation in everything we do. Imagine what you could do here! Join Apple, and help us leave the world better than we found it.

The Apple Services Engineering (ASE) team builds and provides systems and infrastructure that power Apple's services (such as iCloud, Apple Music, Apple Intelligence, and Maps). We are the foundation on which Apple's software developers build the products that our customers love. Our services have to scale globally, stay highly available, and "just work."

We are looking for a hands-on SRE Manager to build and lead a multi-disciplinary infrastructure team in China. The team covers three foundational areas:

* Developer Productivity: the source control, artifact management, and build platforms (GitHub, Artifactory, CI/build systems) that Apple engineers rely on every day.
* Fleet Management: lifecycle of bare-metal infrastructure across Apple data centers, including provisioning, hardware validation, firmware, OS deployment, and configuration management.
* Security SRE: foundational security services such as host access, disk encryption, identity, and authentication, which protect Apple's fleet and its most critical data.

This is a player-coach role. The team is small and spans several domains, so you will lead from the front: debug production issues, review designs and code, and build automation alongside your engineers while hiring, growing, and managing them. You will be the local leader for Apple's infrastructure presence in China, partnering with the US, and European teams that own each domain's roadmap, and making sure work in China is well-scoped, well-supported, and delivered to the same reliability and security bar.

You will own operational excellence across all three areas: SLOs, incident response, on-call health, change safety, and steady reduction of toil through software. You will also be the link between the China team and the domain leaders for each area, balancing priorities across them and raising risks early.

This is a foundational role. The team will start small, and we expect it to grow as Apple's infrastructure investment in China expands. You will play a key role in shaping its scope, hiring, and culture as it grows.

Hire, lead, mentor, and grow a team of SRE and infrastructure engineers across Fleet Management, Developer Productivity, and Security SRE.
Stay hands-on: troubleshoot across the full stack (hardware, firmware, OS, network, application), review designs and code, and help with automation and tooling.
Own the reliability, availability, and performance of the services the team supports, including SLO definition, monitoring, alerting, and capacity planning.
Run incident response and post-incident reviews, and drive systemic fixes rather than one-off remediations.
Set up a sustainable on-call model that fits well with global follow-the-sun coverage.
Drive safe change management and staged rollouts for infrastructure that the rest of Apple builds on.
Work with domain leaders and partner teams in the US and Europe to align priorities, plan execution, and keep visibility high in both directions.
Promote security-by-default practices across the team, including host hardening, access controls, and secure packaging.
Use AI-assisted tooling to speed up triage, operational workflows, and engineering productivity.
Apple-200685593.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
10+ years in SRE, production engineering, or infrastructure roles operating large-scale distributed systems, including 3+ years managing engineers.
Hands-on technical depth: able to debug production issues and write and review code in at least one of Python, Go, or Java.
Strong Linux and systems fundamentals: OS internals, networking, storage, performance, and systems management.
Solid understanding of SRE principles: SLOs and error budgets, monitoring and alerting, incident management, fault analysis, and capacity planning.
Experience with configuration management and infrastructure as code (Puppet, Ansible, Chef, Terraform, or similar).
Experience with Kubernetes and containerization.
Track record of leading a team across more than one technical domain or service area.
Excellent written and spoken English and Mandarin, and the ability to communicate clearly with global teams across time zones.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Experience with bare-metal provisioning and hardware lifecycle at data center scale (PXE/iPXE, BMC/Redfish, firmware management, OS imaging).
Experience operating developer platforms such as GitHub Enterprise, Artifactory or Nexus, and CI/build systems (Jenkins or similar).
Knowledge of Linux security primitives: SELinux, PAM/SSH access controls, disk encryption, identity and authentication systems, and container security.
Experience operating infrastructure as an internal managed service with defined SLAs.
Observability experience (Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, or similar).
Experience operating infrastructure in China, including local cloud providers (e.g., Alibaba Cloud), cross-border connectivity, and local compliance and data-residency requirements.
Experience building a new team or site from the ground up.

Apple-200681912.title: Tag Management & Infrastructure Analyst
Apple-200681912.description:
Imagine what you could do here! The people here at Apple don’t just create products — they build the kind of wonder that’s revolutionized entire industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. At Apple, inclusion is a shared responsibility, and we work together to foster a culture where everyone belongs and is inspired to do their best work. 

Here on the Apple Store Online team, we are responsible for Apple’s largest store. Our main goal is to deliver a magical, personal digital experience where customers can shop, buy and learn everything Apple, wherever they are. Each customer should feel like they are our only customer and our job is to set the bar for the experience they receive. To run such an extraordinary store, it takes extraordinary people, and we are looking for someone to help us do extraordinary things. The Retail Online Analytics team is seeking a Tag Management & Infrastructure Analyst with deep expertise in tag management, Adobe Analytics, and Adobe Experience Platform to lead the design and implementation of scalable, privacy-centric measurement solutions across Apple’s web and native app ecosystem.

To ensure compliance, we are transitioning from a single global reporting suite (hosted on AWS) to a localized data architecture. We are seeking a skilled, China-based resource to lead the configuration, implementation, and alignment of a brand-new local instance of Adobe Analytics and Adobe Target.
This role is critical in bridging localized compliance requirements with global data consistency and ensuring our analytics teams have the high-quality, aggregated data they need for business decisions.

This role is ideal for an individual contributor who is technically strong, hands-on, and comfortable partnering with engineering, product, privacy, and data science teams. You will define data architecture, implement data collection standards and post processing, and ensure high-quality data collection that powers critical business KPIs for apple.com, the Apple Store app, and future digital initiatives. 

Local Implementation & Configuration: Lead the technical configuration and deployment of a net-new local instance of Adobe Analytics and Adobe Target in China, working closely with cross-functional teams.
Variable Mapping & Consistency: Partner with business teams on localized variable mappings (eVar, prop, events) to drive maximum consistency between local reports and our global AWS-hosted reporting suites.
Data Engineering & Architecture Collaboration: Play a pivotal role with Business Process Re-engineering (BPR) teams to design and build the optimal levels of data aggregation within Snowflake to support downstream analytics and reporting.
Data Collection: Partner with Privacy and Legal teams to ensure privacy-by-design data collection, consent management, and regulatory compliance.

Strong expertise in configuring and maintaining Adobe Analytics and Adobe Target (SDKs, launch tags, mapping).
Experience with Snowflake or similar cloud data warehouses, with a focus on data modeling and aggregation.
Familiarity with China privacy guidelines regarding local data residency.
Excellent cross-functional communication skills to align local implementations with global business standards.
Design, implement, and govern end-to-end digital analytics measurement architecture across web and native app platforms.
Architect and support Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) integrations, data flows, and downstream data consumption.

8 years of digital analytics implementation and architecture experience for large-scale consumer web or commerce platforms
6 years of hands-on Adobe Analytics experience, including complex implementations and operational ownership
Working knowledge of Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) concepts, data ingestion, and integrations
Excellent understanding of privacy principles, consent frameworks, cookies, and local storage protocols
Experience working with raw clickstream data, data feeds, and analytics validation/debugging tools
Strong communication skills with the ability to influence technical and non-technical partners

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
10+ years of digital analytics implementation and architecture experience for large-scale consumer web or commerce platforms
8+ years of hands-on Adobe Analytics experience, including complex implementations and managing data feeds

Apple-200676249.title: Technical Operation Engineer
Apple-200676249.description:
Do you want to help build some of the largest and most consequential enterprise and customer technology systems in the world? Join Apple’s Information Systems and Technology (IS&T) organization.  IS&T is the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. It’s Apple’s central nervous system. Supporting 2.5 billion active Apple devices, processing billions of secure transactions, and keeping the technology that defines modern life running flawlessly, IS&T makes the impossible feel effortless.Do you love building solutions to handle global complexity and immense scale? Imagine what you could do here.

Customer Systems is part of IS&T and drives the technology behind Apple's customer support experience — from contact center operations to the software powering the iconic Genius Bar. The team also builds and operates AppleCare's online support platform, which handles 6 billion visits per year, delivering seamless, high-quality support to Apple customers around the globe.

The Technical Operations Engineer will support and improve business-critical Customer Systems services used across Apple’s global customer-support organizations. The role combines advanced production support, automation, reliability engineering and Operational Excellence.

The engineer will be responsible for service health, incident response, root-cause analysis and continuous improvement of operational processes, tooling and platform reliability.

Operate globally distributed, business-critical customer-support applications and platforms.
Monitor service availability, latency, capacity, throughput and error rates.
Lead troubleshooting of complex application, infrastructure, database, integration and
network issues.
Participate in or lead major-incident response, service restoration and stakeholder
communication.
Perform root-cause analysis and drive permanent corrective actions.
Identify recurring incidents, operational gaps and reliability risks, and convert them into
improvement initiatives.
Build automation, diagnostics and self-service tools to reduce manual operational work.
Develop dashboards, health checks, actionable alerts and automated remediation.
Drive Operational Excellence across incident, problem, change, release and capacity
management.
Deﬁne and track service metrics, operational KPIs, SLIs and SLOs.
Support Java applications, REST APIs, microservices and asynchronous integrations.
Coordinate production releases, conﬁguration changes, deployment validation and rollback
planning.
Lead production-readiness and operational-readiness reviews for new services and major
changes.
Partner with software engineering teams to improve application operability, resilience and
supportability.
Maintain runbooks, troubleshooting guides and service documentation.
Support capacity planning, resilience testing and disaster-recovery exercises.
Participate in on-call rotations and support critical launches and business events.
Mentor junior engineers and promote a culture of ownership and continuous improvement.
Apple-200676249.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Experience in using AI and Large Language Models (LLMs) to enhance operational efficiency through tasks such as model training, optimization (including areas like Model Context Protocol or similar methods), and designing effective model utilities.
Understanding of standard networking protocols and components such as: HTTP, DNS, TCP/IP, ICMP, the OSI Model, Subnetting and Load Balancing is a plus

Apple-200668745.description:
When was the last time you enjoyed a box as much as the product inside? At Apple, every customer interaction is an opportunity for surprise and delight! This philosophy extends beyond the product to its packaging, where every detail is thoughtfully considered.

The Packaging PD team is a diverse group of people responsible for the design and execution of structural packaging for all Apple products, from shippers to finished goods boxes. Our packaging delivers an outstanding customer experience while protecting products throughout the shipping environment and advancing Apple’s sustainability goals. We collaborate with a wide range of teams, including Industrial Design, Marketing, Environmental, Operations, and many others, during the design process.

We are seeking people who will approach problem-solving with passion, creativity, and curiosity. Apple’s approach to packaging is unique, so we value people who are eager to learn new skills and further improve their knowledge of packaging design, manufacturing processes, and sustainable materials. We welcome fresh influences from outside the standard packaging industry to promote innovation in creative ways.

Apple-200628100.title: Thermal Engineer
Apple-200628100.description:
The people here at Apple don't just build products - they build the kind of wonder that's revolutionized entire industries. It's the diversity of those people and their ideas that encourages the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. Join Apple, and help us leave the world better than we found it.

Join Apple's Thermal Product Design group as an experienced Thermal Engineer in Asia!

Responsibilities and activities for this position include the following:

Serve as Apple’s in-region thermal expert for passive devices by applying deep technical knowledge of system-level and module-level thermal design, testing, and validation. 
Collaborate with in-region and US-based Thermal Engineers on technology evaluation, design investigation and process development for new passive products.
Drive and execute thermal testing at OEM and supplier factories, including data deduction and analysis, summarizing thermal findings, and delivering comprehensive assessments.
Manage technical engagements with thermal module and component vendors; evaluate emerging technologies and drive supplier roadmaps to meet Apple product requirements.
Take the leading role in suggesting or adopting ideas for improving productivity and quality of thermal solutions.
Provide in-region expertise for root cause and corrective action of system thermal failures and defective thermal parts/materials.
Train engineers at OEM and vendor factories to produce high quality products using well-defined specifications, advanced production processes and up-to-date validation tools and codes.
Apple-200628100.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
BS or MS in Mechanical Engineering or related field. 
Experience in Thermal design for passive devices, with a solid understanding of thermal systems/components and their manufacturing processes. 
Direct, hands-on experience with thermal characterization equipment (e.g., DAQ, TCs/RTDs, IR thermography, DC power supplies, Thermal chambers).
Strong cross-functional communication and presentation skills in both English and Mandarin, with the ability to convey critical Thermal findings and bridge design teams, OEMs, and external vendor partners.
Solid domain expertise in passive Thermal solutions, specifically Graphite, Vapor Chamber (VC), and Thermal Interface Materials (TIM).

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Frequent domestic travel is required. 
Scripting proficiency (Python, Perl, Bash, etc.) is a plus.
Proficiency in statistical analysis tools (JMP, Tableau) is a plus.
Experience in Thermal CFD tools (Icepak, Flotherm, etc) is a plus.

Apple-200662569.title: Thermal Manufacturing Quality Engineer
Apple-200662569.description:
Apple is where individual creativities gather together, committing to the values that lead to great work. Every new product we build, service we create, or Apple Store experience we deliver is the result of us making each other’s ideas stronger. That happens because every one of us shares a belief that we can make something wonderful and share it with the world, changing lives for the better. It’s the diversity of our people and their thinking that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do. When we bring everybody in, we can do the best work of our lives. Here, you’ll do more than join something — you’ll add something!

Our quality engineering team enables the mass creation of impossible products. We work in tandem with Apple's world-class designers to develop measurement technologies, control strategies, information systems, and manufacturing methods that achieve visionary specifications at massive production scale. We lead a network of supplier factories worldwide, with responsibility for our partners' delivery to aggressive schedules. Our focus is on elegant execution of extraordinary battery designs, resulting in products that thrill our customers.

Thermal Module Quality Engineers will be fearless leaders capable of working with multi-functional teams to identify risks, explore solutions, reach consensus and execute mitigations as quickly and efficiently as possible. You will evaluate dimensional, functional, and cosmetic challenges through statistical analyses to make data-driven decisions as well as:
•	Plan DOEs to resolve impacts on process capability and cell performance, summarize data findings, and implement changes to meet specification standards.
•	Drive qualification efforts in a wide variety of areas such as metrology, function inspection, cosmetic  during module assembly.
•	Perform failure analysis to understand thermal failure modes and implement preventive measures.
•	Lead quality related functions for a program and serve as a project manager to push efforts at supplier locations.
•	Write, assess, and audit validation tests both internally and at the vendors.
•	Drive vendor process performance improvements through objective measurements using yield gap analysis.

MS degree in Mechanical/Materials/Data Engineering is required, MBA / PhD degree is a plus.
Experience with mechanical part development, design, and qualification
Knowledgeable about current state-of-art production processes of module assembly and inspection
Hands-on experience with performance characterization techniques and reliability testing 

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Experience developing processes quality plans, supplier quality deliverables, inspection solutions , and driving corrective actions/failure analysis efforts
Familiarity with GD&T practices, Metrology, PFMEA and tolerance analysis 
Project management experience and a deep understanding of problem solving tools including design of experiments, FA, and statistical tools.
Strong communication skills and passion to learn and adapt to a dynamic environment.
Strong big data analysis skill with multiple tools like JMP/Python/Tableau
Knowledgeable about heat transfer theory, acoustics analysis, module assembly, stamping, CNC, testing, SMT, AL/ML will be a plus

Apple-200602108.title: Tooling Engineer - iPhone
Apple-200602108.description:
We live in a mobile and device driven world where knowledge of the physical world around us is needed. We rely on this knowledge to get around, to learn about our environment and to enable spectacular new features for custom applications. Apple is meeting those needs as robustly and as creatively as possible and is interested in people who want to help meet that commitment. 

At Apple, we believe our products begin with our people! By hiring a team with varied strengths, we drive creative thought. By giving that team everything they need, we drive innovation. By hiring incredible engineers, we drive precision. And through our collaborative process, we build memorable experiences for our customers!

These elements come together to make Apple an amazing environment for motivated people to do the greatest work of their lives. You will become part of a hands-on development team that sets the standard in cultivating excellence, creativity and innovation. Will you help us design the next generation of revolutionary Apple products?

To work on new tool & process development, ensure the tools meet the product specifications, performance and cosmetics requirements, within the project schedule.

To work closely with Product Designer, Supply Management, Quality & Manufacturing Engineering and other cross-functional teams, to deliver best-in-class parts & products. 
Serves as the subject matter expert for the Tooling & Molding aspect.
Frequent travel within the region may be required.
Apple-200602108.requirements:

Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Precision Engineering, Polymer Technology or equivalent.
Minimum  8 years experience in plastic tool design, mold making or injection molding industry.

Apple-200685016.title: Tooling Engineering Intern - iPhone
Apple-200685016.description:
At Apple, we believe extraordinary products start with extraordinary design and manufacturing innovation. The iPhone Tooling Engineering team operates at the intersection of mechanical product design, precision tooling architecture, and advanced manufacturing processes. We turn ambitious industrial design concepts into millions of flawless parts, pushing the boundaries of what is possible in tooling technology, materials processing, and dimensional precision.

As a Tooling Engineering Intern on the iPhone team, you will collaborate with seasoned tooling engineers, product designers, and cross-functional operations teams. You will dive into real-world engineering challenges—ranging from high-precision mold design analysis and simulation to advanced manufacturing trials and root-cause troubleshooting. This internship is designed to give you hands-on exposure to world-class manufacturing engineering while helping you build a solid foundation for your engineering career.

In this role, you will assist the tooling team in evaluating tooling designs, running engineering simulations, and analyzing manufacturing trial data for iPhone components. You will gain comprehensive exposure to precision mold structures, tooling fabrication methods, and scientific molding/forming processes while supporting cross-functional investigations on dimensional and cosmetic challenges.

Support tooling engineers in reviewing 3D/2D tooling designs, identifying potential manufacturing challenges, and proposing design-for-manufacturing (DFM) optimizations.
Conduct computer-aided engineering (CAE) simulations (such as Moldflow analysis) and compare simulation predictions against actual trial data to help calibrate process parameters and tooling designs.
Collect, organize, and analyze metrology and inspection data (CMM, optical, CT scan) from engineering builds to identify dimensional and aesthetic trends.
Participate in root-cause failure analyses and troubleshooting for tooling and molding/forming defects during prototype iterations.
Prepare structured technical reports, trial summaries, and cross-functional presentations to clearly communicate engineering findings.
Collaborate with cross-functional partners, including Product Design, Material Science, and Operations, to track tooling milestones and technical deliverables.
Apple-200685016.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s, Master’s, or Ph.D. degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Materials Science, Tooling & Mold Design, or a related engineering field.
Experience using 3D CAD modeling software (such as NX, Creo, SolidWorks, or CATIA) to create, modify, and interpret mechanical components and engineering drawings.
Experience applying fundamental engineering principles, such as statics, dynamics, fluid mechanics, heat transfer, and strength of materials.
Proficiency in written and spoken English with strong technical communication skills.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Experience with plastic injection tooling design, stamping dies, or precision machining fixtures.
Exposure to injection molding flow simulation tools (e.g., Autodesk Moldflow, Moldex3D) or structural/thermal FEA tools.
Familiarity with polymer materials, metal forming, or precision manufacturing processes (e.g., CNC, EDM, wire EDM, grinding).
Understanding of Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T) principles and basic metrology/measurement systems.
Experience using data analysis or scripting tools (such as Python, MATLAB, JMP, or Excel) to analyze experimental data.
Demonstrated curiosity, structured problem-solving skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively in a dynamic, multidisciplinary team environment.

Apple-200684744.title: Touch HW EE Validation Engineer
Apple-200684744.description:
The touch technology team develops pioneering touch solutions and technologies that are central to Apple’s products, including iPhones, iPads, Apple Watch, and more. Bring devices to life and enable them to interact with users and the environment in ways never imagined before. The key goal of the touch technology team is to design the world’s best multi-touch user-experience. Join us in developing solutions for next-gen touch technologies. The team features a collaborative and hands-on environment that fosters engineering excellence, creativity, and innovation. An engineer in this role develops strategies and solutions to ensure that Apple products meet the exact touch performance standards in terms of hardware and user experience.

The role involves development and execution of validation and characterization methodologies for Apple’s touch solutions, from proof-of-concept to mass production. The engineer acting as a Direct Responsible Individual will be responsible for:
-  Leading the development and execution of engineering validation and characterization methodologies for Apple’s touch solutions across different products
-  Driving strategies with multi-functional teams, including test, firmware, software, mechanical design and reliability engineering to deliver groundbreaking touch solutions
-  Designing metrics and figures-of-merit to guide touch design and performance tracking
-  Architecting and designing HW & SW infrastructure with pioneering robotics for innovative test solutions
-  Managing vendors to implement validation tools, plans and infrastructure at vendor sites
-  Performing failure mode analysis with advanced analysis tools to drive root cause diagnosis and system-level problem solving
-  Authoring reports and communications pertaining to key results and checkpoints
-  Business travel (Primarily within China. To a lesser extent USA)
Apple-200684744.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
PhD/MS/BS in Electrical Engineering with 3 years of industry experience
Strong electrical engineering background in analog/mixed-signal testing methodologies with prior proven experience in owning validation/test efforts on products
Proficient in high-level programming languages for test automation
Experience in Design of Experiments (DoE), FA/CA (Failure Analysis / Corrective Action)

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Experience with Python is a major advantage
Proficient in data visualization and statistical analysis tools such as Tableau, SpotFire, JMP, Python or Matlab or similar
Excellent project management skills, written/verbal communication skills and solid people skills
Experience with touch technology is a plus

Apple-200674535.title: Voice Engineer
Apple-200674535.description:
Do you want to help build some of the largest and most consequential enterprise and customer technology systems in the world? Join Apple’s Information Systems and Technology (IS&T) organization. IS&T is the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. It’s Apple’s central nervous system. Supporting 2.5 billion active Apple devices, processing billions of secure transactions, and keeping the technology that defines modern life running flawlessly, IS&T makes the impossible feel effortless. Do you love building solutions to handle global complexity and immense scale? Imagine what you could do here.

Customer Systems is part of IS&T and drives the technology behind Apple's customer support experience — from contact center operations to the software powering the iconic Genius Bar. The team also builds and operates AppleCare's online support platform, which handles 6 billion visits per year, delivering seamless, high-quality support to Apple customers around the globe.

The Information Systems & Technology (IS&T) Customer Systems team delivers many of the key global applications used in Apple’s sites, including the Contact Centre Voice Platform and it’s integrations with other Contact Centre tools. This role is part of the Contact Centre Technology (CCTech) function within the Asia Pacific IS&T Customer Systems team. Overview of the Role: The role is either based in Apple Shanghai office. You will have a strong technical background in SIP, be committed to customer experience, be a strong leader and advocate for the Asia Pacific region, and thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment tobe qualified for the role.

You will act as the technical CCTech Voice Lead for Asia Pacific, including Session Border Controller, SIP Routing, SIP Endpoint, and the tools to monitor, alert, and troubleshoot the solutions. 
You have the ownership and management of the Asia Pacific CCTech environment to ensure application and hardware deployment is optimised for the region. 
You hold the accountability for CCTech environment readiness for the region, ensuring the platform is appropriately scaled to meet business need. 
You will run or support CCTech initiatives in Asia Pacific as they relate to the Voice platform, working with the global and regional business owners to identify and define opportunities and the work you're doing. 
You will be the Tier 2/3 Operational support of the end-to-end Contact Centre Voice solution, taking ownership of mitigation, resolution and followup for impactful P1/P0 incidents and lower priority recurring issues, as part of a 24*7 global support team. 
Tier 2/3 Operational support of the Call Recording solution in Asia Pacific. - Engagement management with key stake holders and partners, including global product owners, regional business and IS&T partners. 
Identifying system and process improvements relating to the Contact Centre Voice Platform, recommending new solutions and system utilization. - Representing Asia Pacific in global IS&T and business forums.

Experience in large enterprise & global SIP engineering, development, deployments and support

Extensive experience with Kamailio (or OpenSIPS) for SIP routing, load balancing, and proxy functions
Strong experience with FreeSWITCH or other Contact Center Voice solutions
Expert knowledge of SIP, RTP, TCP/IP, NAT, WebRTC and packet analysis
Software development experience integrating SIP with desktop applications
Extensive experience with network and voice analysis tools, like NetScout or similar tools
Extensive experience with SIP, VoIP & TDM co-environment
Expert with network and common data centre infrastructure
Working knowledge of Session Border Controller
Proficient with developing VoIP/SIP application security
Proficient with writing support and procedure diagrams, graphs and documentation
Expert Layer 3 and QOS Experience
Expert with Rules Engines, Session Management, Route Plans, and Traffic Management 
Working experience with Linux OS & ISO images
Experience with Voice over TLS and Security Certificates is desirable

Familiarity with Mac and macOS is desirable
Prior experience in working on China / Japan related projects and understanding of the complexities of the environments / platforms used in these countries, will be an advantage.

Apple-200692146.title: Wireless Firmware Engineer
Apple-200692146.description:
Would you like to join Apple’s growing Wireless Connectivity Silicon team? Our wireless System on a Chip (SoC) organization is responsible for all aspects of wireless silicon development with a particular emphasis on highly energy efficient design and new technologies that transform the user experience at the product level, all of which is driven by a world-class vertically integrated engineering team spanning RF/Analog architecture and design, Systems/PHY/MAC architecture and design, VLSI/RTL design and integration, Emulation, Design Verification, Test and Validation, and FW/SW engineering. In this highly visible role, you will be at the center of a silicon design group with a critical impact on getting functional wireless products to hundreds of millions of customers! Responsible for crafting and implementing embedded firmware for SoC bring up and wireless connectivity enablement. You will work closely with product software and manufacturing teams to enable RF and PHY calibrations, algorithms and testing to enable productization of the silicon / system.

As an Embedded FW Engineer, the individual will be a core member of a Wireless SoC firmware team, with emphasis on PHY bring up, RF calibrations, signal processing algorithm implementation and performance tuning 
Work closely with product SW and manufacturing teams to provide system-level API and firmware functionality to meet productization needs. Develop SoC test and calibration capabilities for wafer, module, and system factories. 
Collaborate with RF/Radio design, DVT, PHY and System engineering teams to architect, define and implement innovative algorithms, calibrations and protocols. 
Debug realtime systems with limited visibility, working hands-on with development boards and lab equipment. 
Support pre-silicon validation efforts, including simulation, emulation, and FPGA prototyping. 
Support post-silicon bringup, validation, performance characterization, system integration and debug.
Apple-200692146.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
BS and 3+ years of relevant industry experience
Embedded systems knowledge including:
multi thread environment
Interrupt thread processing/latency 
Multi core environment
HW/FW semaphores/resource management

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Strong background in embedded FW development using C and assembly languages, familiarity with ARM CPUs and its internals.
Good understanding of embedded wireless communication systems, Radio and PHY fundamentals and key RF performance metrics. Familiarity with digital signal processing algorithms
Understanding python match library like numpy/SciPy and how to convert it to embedded C.
Understanding difference between fix point and floating points and how to make arithmetic tradeoff and simplify embedded usage.
Experience with low-level hardware interfaces, register and interrupt programming, bare-metal software development, clock and power management.
Solid understanding of basic embedded concepts such as RTOS, concurrency, multi-processor systems.
Fluency in using lab equipment such as logic analyzers, oscilloscopes, network analyzers, spectrum analyzers, signal generators, power meters etc.
Experience implementing diagnostics, manufacturing tests, and protocol compliance software.
Knowledgeable of industry standards for wireless communications such as Bluetooth, WLAN, Zigbee, UWB is a plus.
Proficient in at least one of the scripting languages such as Python, Perl, or Tcl
Excellent communication skills – both written and oral.

Apple-200681668.title: iCloud Data Scientist
Apple-200681668.description:
At Apple, we have phenomenal ideas that have a way of becoming great products, services, and customer experiences. We are seeking an iCloud Data Scientist to join a team passionate about Data Science & Analytics for Apple Services to support transaction and subscription businesses across App Store, iCloud, Apple Music, Apple TV, Apple Arcade, Apple One, and other services.

You will play a key role in understanding and optimizing the businesses under Apple Services as a part of the Subscriptions & Commerce Data Science team with a focus on the iCloud business in China. As a member of this team, you will help us to grow the financial, transaction, and subscription health of iCloud by sizing, measuring, and recommending impactful initiatives. Responsibilities will include understanding the impact across acquisition, subscription renewals, tier upgrades, payment authorizations, user behavior, and operational costs.

As a data scientist on the Subscriptions & Commerce Data Science team, you’ll establish, enhance, and socialize top-line and operational metrics that accurately represent the business state of health; craft deep dives in large-scale data to identify key insights that inform business strategy and product improvements; and develop, improve, and execute on experimental measurement plans for new subscriptions and commerce products and features.

Identify key insights and recommendations for the growth of the China business through analyses of local user behaviors, insights into local product offerings, and data engineering solutions to abide by local regulations
Employ sophisticated analytic tools such as causal modeling and A/B testing and to accurately understand the effect of multiple and often interrelated initiatives
Collaborate with business, marketing, finance and executive teams to generate regular presentations for C-level executives
Build and maintain positive relationships with key partners across the company to successfully deliver everything from data instrumentation from engineering to actionable insights for business
Coordinate with data and platform engineers to develop scalable solutions that abide by privacy, legal, and regulatory policies and guidelines
Apple-200681668.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
5+ years of professional experience in data science, machine learning, or digital product analytics
3+ years of data engineering experience in data pipeline development, data model design, and aggregation strategies
Mastery in SQL-based languages and proficiency in large-scale data languages such as PySpark
Proven record measuring user experience behavior, customer engagement, and business impact using sophisticated and appropriate analytic tools
Strong proponent of experimental test and design, and practical experience with interpreting observational results
Demonstrated experience with data engineering tools and concepts with querying, manipulating, and analyzing internet-scale data structures and very large datasets specifically to address complex business or product challenges
Excellent communication and presentation skills with meticulous attention to detail with the ability to communicate effectively between business and analytics teams
Strong verbal and written communication and presentation skills across both technical and non-technical audiences
Fluent in both Mandarin and English
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Economics or a related field

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Experience in a digital subscription business or for an e-commerce platform
Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Economics or a related field

Apple-200680031.title: iOS Full-Stack Software Engineer
Apple-200680031.description:
At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming great products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job, and there's no telling what you could accomplish. Do you love solving problems and thinking beyond the obvious solution? Do you thrive in ambiguity and enjoy turning complex business needs into intuitive software experiences?

The Greater China Channel Sales DMP team is dedicated to digital transformation. We are looking for an enthusiastic iOS full-stack software engineer with strong native application development experience, keen attention to detail, and the ability to learn quickly and deliver with limited direction. Your primary focus will be building high-quality iOS and iPadOS applications, while independently taking ownership of selected backend services and APIs that support them. The solutions you build will support critical channel sales workflows and help teams make informed decisions and improve business performance.

We don't believe in limiting our engineers. We are looking for a cross-functional individual who can independently own projects, communicate directly with business stakeholders, and help shape products from initial concept through production. You will take responsibility for the full delivery lifecycle, from requirements and experience design to technical architecture, implementation, testing, release, and continuous improvement, working closely with product, design, and engineering partners. Experience using AI-assisted development tools to improve engineering productivity and quality is a plus.

As an iOS Full-Stack Software Engineer, you will:

- Engage directly with business stakeholders to identify opportunities, clarify requirements, and translate complex workflows into intuitive native application experiences and maintainable technical solutions.
- Design, develop, and maintain production-quality iOS and iPadOS applications using Swift, SwiftUI, and UIKit where appropriate, with reusable UI components and business logic that support long-term product evolution.
- Define client architecture across navigation, state management, modularization, networking, caching, and local persistence, with clear boundaries between presentation, business logic, and data access.
- Independently design, develop, and test selected backend services and RESTful APIs using technologies such as Python, Java/Spring Boot, or Node.js, defining
reliable, evolvable service contracts and integrating them into native applications.
- Build resilient client-server workflows, including authentication, data synchronization, offline and degraded-network behavior, and recovery from application and service failures.
- Optimize application responsiveness, launch time, memory usage, and network efficiency; diagnose issues across UI rendering, application lifecycle, API integration, and supporting services.
- Deliver secure, privacy-conscious, accessible, and localized experiences across supported devices and operating-system versions, in accordance with applicable Apple requirements and platform guidelines.
- Develop automated unit, UI, integration, and API tests; apply test-driven and behavior-driven approaches where appropriate, and contribute to code reviews and continuous-integration workflows.
- Own release readiness and production support for assigned features, using crash reporting, structured logging, and performance instrumentation to monitor quality and drive continuous improvement.
- Evaluate new platform capabilities, frameworks, and development tools; build focused proof-of-concept solutions and bring validated ideas into production, including AI-powered features where they deliver meaningful user value.
Apple-200680031.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
3+ years of professional software engineering experience with a strong focus on native iOS application development.
Strong proficiency in Swift and hands-on experience delivering and maintaining production applications using SwiftUI and/or UIKit.
Strong software engineering skills across application architecture, implementation, testing, debugging, performance optimization, release, and maintenance.
Experience designing modular, testable native applications with clear separation of UI, business logic, and data access responsibilities.
Solid understanding of Swift Concurrency, asynchronous programming, thread safety, memory management, and application lifecycle behavior.
Hands-on experience with client networking, RESTful API integration, local persistence, caching, and data synchronization, including error handling under unreliable network conditions.
Hands-on experience with at least one server-side language and framework, such as Python, Java/Spring Boot, or Node.js, with the ability to independently deliver well-scoped backend APIs and services.
Experience with automated testing, Git-based collaboration, and continuous integration, together with an understanding of secure authentication, authorization, and sensitive-data handling in client-server applications.
Ability to work through ambiguous requirements, independently drive projects with limited direction, and communicate technical decisions clearly to business stakeholders and cross-functional partners.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Demonstrated experience delivering an end-to-end feature spanning a native application and its supporting backend services.
Familiarity with domain modeling and Domain-Driven Design (DDD) principles for translating complex business workflows into well-defined software modules.
Knowledge of relational databases such as MySQL or PostgreSQL, data modeling, and caching technologies such as Redis.
Familiarity with cloud infrastructure such as AWS or Alibaba Cloud, containerized deployments, and CI/CD pipelines for supporting backend services.
Experience with Instruments, crash analysis, and production monitoring, as well as internal or enterprise application signing, provisioning, and distribution.
Experience building accessible and localized applications for users across multiple markets; familiarity with web technologies such as TypeScript, React, or Vue is also a plus.
Experience integrating AI-powered capabilities into user-facing applications or using Apple approved AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity and code quality, in accordance with applicable security and privacy requirements.

Apple-200639223.title: iPhone System Hardware Validation Engineer-Shenzhen
Apple-200639223.description:
At Apple, we don’t just create products — we craft the kind of wonder that has revolutionized entire industries. It’s the diversity of our people and their ideas that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. Join Apple, and help us leave the world better than we found it.

As a Hardware Validation Engineer, you will apply your expertise in electrical engineering and HW validation, collaborating with our global System EE team to directly impact the experience of millions of iPhone users worldwide. We are a collaborative and passionate team, dedicated to creating products that delight our customers.

In this role, you will be responsible for planning, executing, and managing the electrical validation of iPhone hardware, from the earliest prototypes through to mass production and launch. You will collaborate closely with the global System EE team and lead our Contract Manufacturing (CM) hardware validation partners to ensure our products meet the highest standards of quality.

Lead and support New Product Introduction (NPI) builds on-site at our manufacturing factory.
Execute comprehensive validation of iPhone hardware, covering functional, electrical, and system-level integration.
Lead and mentor the CM validation team, review test plans and results, and communicate validation progress to project team.
Triage, root-cause, and drive resolution for the most critical issues found during validation, working closely with Directly Responsible Individual (DRI) to define clear mitigation paths.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate their feedback and requirements into the validation plan.
Proactively identify and drive improvements to our validation methodologies, tools, and processes to increase efficiency.
Apple-200639223.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field.
Proficiency with lab equipment such as oscilloscopes and logic analyzers, with a deep understanding of best practices for test setup and signal/power integrity measurement.
Experience in validating high-speed serial interfaces (e.g., PCIe, DisplayPort) and low-speed interfaces (e.g., I2C, SPI).
Experience with power validation, including DC-DC power solutions and power management systems.
Strong hands-on lab skills for debugging complex hardware issues.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in both English and Mandarin.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
2+ years of direct experience in a hardware validation role.
Strong fundamentals in electrical engineering and system integration, with experience in consumer electronics, mobile phones, or other embedded systems.
A curious and detail-oriented mindset with a passion for problem-solving.
Proven ability to learn quickly and thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
A genuine passion for shipping high-quality products at scale.
Scripting or programming skills (e.g., Python, C, Lua, MATLAB) for test automation and data analysis is a significant advantage.

Apple-200664633.title: Advanced Manufacturing Engineer, Core Tech
Apple-200664633.description:
Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish!  

The people here at Apple don’t just build products — they create the kind of wonder that’s revolutionized entire industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. Join Apple, you will help us leave the world better than we found it. 

As an Advanced Manufacturing Engineer in the Core Tech team, you will be at the forefront of bringing Apple's next-generation products to life. You will lead the end-to-end development of highly automated, complex manufacturing processes—from early concept and Design for Manufacturability (DFM) through to mass production. By leveraging your expertise in advanced robotics, machine vision, and precision process engineering, you will bridge the gap between innovative product design and scalable, world-class manufacturing, ensuring our products are built with unprecedented precision and quality.

Automation Design for Manufacturability: Provide early and ongoing automation & manufacturing involvement to ensure new products are mechanically manufacturable and repeatable. Include machine DFM review, set up SOP document creation and FAT/SAT automation line qualification standard.  
Product Engineering: Works all phases of a product from concept, to repeat automation manufacturing, to end of life. Provides production support engineering with respect to technically sophisticated testing methods, procedures and failure analysis. Include Geometry Dimensional & Tolerance Analysis knowledge. Enable the product design assembly via fully automation development.  
Process Engineering: Designs and develops technically complex processes to improve product quality and automation equipment efficiency. Include machine/process parameter set up skills. Understood several automation manufacturing process such as glue dispense, laser welding, etching, active alignment, etc.  
Failure/Data Analysis/Validation Result: Plans, develops, and implements technically complex procedures for the testing and evaluation of soon to be released products. Specifies tests to be performed, compiles data, and makes recommendations for product design changes and final assembly standards. This will include the use of Failure Analysis & Corrective Action & Validation Result (FACAVR), Design Experiments (DOE) and statistical analysis using Six Sigma & Monte Carlo tool principles.
Apple-200664633.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
BSME or equivalent (MSME, MSIE desired), with 5 plus years in an automation engineering role with experience in automation equipment design (product design add on) as well as design for manufacturability and advanced manufacturing engineering.
Proven working knowledge of DFM (automation equipment design review).
Confirmed ability in automation engineering & manufacturing process field with relevant design technical expertise.
Fluent in written and spoken Mandarin and English.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Knowledge of optics principles as they relate to CCD cameras, 3D, 2D and 1D lasers, and their use for positioning and critical alignment fixtures.
Basic understanding of glue adhesive dispense, PSAs and VHBs, or coils winding processes, sensing camera processes, glass or lens lamination processes.
Understanding of pneumatics, servo motors, 4axis and 6axis robots, PLC and PC-based control systems a plus.
Understand and create tolerance analysis stack ups for assemblies and part level datums reference.
Knowledge of AI technology or machine learning, adapt to automation development working principle
Understanding of AVI, automation visual inspection technology, include HW/SW/Vision development
Knowledge of GD&T principles a plus.
X2, NX4, or Validated Work CAD experiences a plus. JMP, Minitab, and Six Sigma experience a plus.
Communicate effectively in a worldwide environment.
A passion and dedication in cost reduction, project management and automation engineering design.
Strong work ethic with a high degree of flexibility.

Apple-200684051.title: Audio Product Design Engineer (Mechanical Engineering)
Apple-200684051.description:
Why Apple? We live in a mobile and device driven world where knowledge of the physical world around us is needed. We rely on this knowledge to get around, to learn about our environment and to enable spectacular new features for custom applications.   Apple is meeting those needs as robustly and as creatively as possible and is passionate about people who want to help meet that commitment. The success we are striving will be the result of very skilled people working in an environment which cultivates creativity, partnership, and thinking of old problems in new ways. If that sounds like the kind of environment that you find intriguing, then let's talk.

We invent the next generation of the world's finest consumer electronics. As a member of our Audio Product Design team, you would conceive, design, test, solve problems, and bring into production products that re-define the music experience. We work closely with many different multi-functional teams including Industrial Design, Audio Engineering, Radio Frequency, Safety, Hardware Engineering, EMC, Operations and Marketing. Expertly integrating so many different pieces into brand-new products means every single day is different.

- Support build activities including finding root cause for failures and solutions for issues that impede build progress.   

Building prototypes to validate function, manufacturability, and reliability.   
Analyze data generated from builds and design of experiments.   
Participate in design reviews to generate and receive constructive feedback.   
Perform tolerance analyses to predict performance of mechanisms, sensors, and cosmetic.   
Create specifications, detailed design and 2D documentation of parts and assemblies.   
Work with operations teams to evaluate and develop supply chains capable of manufacturing new subsystems and products.   
Interacting with vendors to develop manufacturing processes and tooling concepts.

Knowledge of finite element analysis (FEA) theory and general mechanical engineering analysis.
Ability to travel to vendors during weekdays.
Fluent Mandarin and English communication skills.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Experience of working with many different international teams or OEM/ODM vendors.
Hands-on experience of solving problem with engineering knowledge (material mechanics, statics, fluid dynamics…etc) and tools.
Deep understanding of engineering fundamentals and ability to apply concepts to new problems not listed in engineering textbooks.
Strong analytical skills and ability to apply statistical tools and techniques into real-world problem solving.
Post-processing knowledge for plastic and metal part, including assembly and fixture design.
Industry experiences from medical, consumer electronics, automotive, aerospace and other fields with relevant technology and development models.

Apple-200688759.title: Baseband Hardware Design Engineer
Apple-200688759.description:
The Baseband Hardware Design Engineer will work on the next generation iPhone and other innovative products. You will be part of a world-class hardware design team, acting as the team's local technical expert at manufacturing sites in China - combining deep hardware engineering expertise with modern AI-assisted workflow creation to drive engineering efficiency, design quality and fast-paced root-cause isolation from early prototype through mass production.

You will collaborate across R&D departments and manufacturing sites to design, build, validate and optimize baseband hardware circuits and complete baseband subsystems for Apple products from initial prototype build through mass production. This role requires proactive cross-functional cooperation with other engineering groups (Silicon, PMIC, Firmware, RF, Production Test, and Quality/Reliability) while designing and leveraging AI tools and data-driven automation across the engineering workflow (domestic and international travel is likely).

Lead and participate in prototype PCBA bring-up, power-on sequencing, clock validation, and initial functional sanity checks.
Utilize lab bench instrumentation (high-bandwidth oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, spectrum analyzers, DMMs and power supplies) to troubleshoot and isolate signal integrity, power delivery, and functional interface issues. 
Develop and apply modern AI tools to develop agentic workflows to streamline data parsing, automated log analysis, script generation, engineering documentation, correlate failure signatures, test logs and historical FA learnings to accelerate root-cause resolution.
Execute comprehensive test plans against design specifications across power distribution networks (Buck/LDO), high-speed interfaces (PCIe), and peripheral buses (I2C, SPMI, RFFE, UART). 
Collaborate closely with cross-functional partners (Silicon, Firmware, Software, Test, and Product Design) on system-level validation, margin testing and performance characterization.
Develop, enhance, and maintain automated test scripts to control test equipment, evaluate physical units, verify validation results and synchronize evolving hardware definitions into validation frameworks.
Apple-200688759.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Solid fundamentals in electrical engineering, including analog and digital circuit analysis, power distribution networks (Buck/LDO), clocking architectures, and basic signal/power integrity (SI/PI).
Proven track record in testing, debugging and failure analysis of complex multi-rail embedded hardware subsystems and communication interfaces.
Knowledge and experience in developing, customizing, and using AI/ML workflows for hardware failure analysis or test automation.
Hands-on proficiency with bench test equipment (high-bandwidth oscilloscopes, power supplies, logic analyzers, DMMs).
Good written and verbal communication skills in English and Mandarin. Strong analytical mindset, curiosity to explore cutting-edge technologies, and ability to collaborate effectively in a fast-paced team environment.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field, with 5+ years (for Bachelor’s) or 2+ years (for Master’s) of relevant industry experience.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Experience supporting prototype builds (NPI / SMT / FATP) at manufacturing sites, particularly in rapid board-level failure triage, root-cause isolation, and factory test yield improvement.
Knowledge/experience of wireless communication systems (Cellular, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth) is a plus, especially when combined with data-driven system analysis and cross-domain issue correlation.
