Apple-200691796.title: Camera Hardware Design and Simulation Engineer
Apple-200691796.description:
Why Apple? At Apple we believe our products begin with our people. By hiring a diverse team we drive creative thought. By giving that team everything they need we drive innovation. By hiring incredible engineers we drive precision. And through our collaborative process we create memorable experiences for our customers. These elements come together to make Apple an amazing environment for motivated people to do the greatest work of their lives.  Do you love crafting sophisticated solutions to highly complex challenges? Do you intrinsically see the importance in every detail?At Apple, quality is built into our DNA. As part of our Camera Technologies group, you’ll be in-charge of design the innovative technology that allows each generation of Apple products to produce photos even more incredible than the last. You’ll design and develop groundbreaking ideas for everything involved in our camera systems, from sub-components to Camera module. You’ll collaborate with teams across Apple to research, design, develop, test, and qualify camera hardware for Apple products. Together, we’ll craft a magical photography experience that redefines what millions of customers can expect from their cameras. The Camera Hardware Engineering group is responsible for the design, development, , innovation and testing of camera technologies for all related Apple products. Our target is to deliver superior camera hardware to enable outstanding camera user experience.

The Camera EE Design and Simulation Engineer is responsible for the design and simulation of camera module electrical hardware. Key responsibilities include:
Investigate and establish electrical solutions for camera modules, driving end-to-end (E2E) sub-system integration from development boards to final system integration.
Act as the primary in-region interface, collaborating closely with camera module vendors on EE design, simulation, and troubleshooting.
Participate in early-stage product scoping, technology development, and board/sub-system bring-up using prototype hardware and mock-ups.
Liaise with in-region cross-functional partners to execute camera debugging and failure analysis (FA).
Conduct comprehensive data analysis and strictly document test results.
Apple-200691796.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or industrial experience equivalent.
Good EE fundamentals and excellent critical thinking skills.
Experience in signal integrity or power integrity, including modeling, simulation, and analysis (e.g., Ansys, Cadence, LTSpice).
Hands-on experience operating lab equipment for high-speed IO characterization and debugging (e.g., Oscilloscope, Spectrum Analyzer, Logic Analyzer, Power Supply, DMM).
Excellent English interpersonal and communication skills.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Strong EE fundamentals including analog and high speed digital design.
Solid understanding of system or camera architecture and circuit design.
Hands-on experience characterizing high-speed and low-speed interfaces.
Proficiency with data analysis and visualization using scripting languages is a plus.
Experience with Camera technology is a plus.

Apple-200675577.title: Car Experience Partner Engineer  - Embedded systems, Wireless Tech and Ecosystems
Apple-200675577.description:
At Apple, great ideas have a way of becoming great products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. The Car Experience team sits at the intersection of consumer electronics and the automotive industry, transforming how iPhone users interact with their vehicles. By seamlessly integrating iOS features like CarPlay and Digital Car Key, we empower millions of users to stay connected, entertained, and safe on the road. We work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment where innovation and attention to detail are at the core of everything we do.
We are looking for a highly motivated systems engineer with strong interactional skills, a problem solver who will effectively and proactively work with developers during bring-up of automotive systems with Apple integration components. In this role, you will be the critical link between Apple’s engineering teams and our automotive partners to integrate CarPlay and other iOS car integration features into their systems, ensuring the highest level of end-customer quality. If you are passionate about embedded systems, driven to solve complex code-level challenges, and excited to guide global automakers from initial concept to production launch, this team provides the perfect platform to make a meaningful impact.

As a Car Experience Partner Engineer (embedded systems), your essential function is to ensure the flawless technical integration of Apple’s automotive technologies into next-generation vehicles. You will balance hands-on embedded software development with external partner management, acting as the technical authority for automotive developers.

Integration and debugging support of Apple’s embedded software libraries and integration SDKs.
Guidance for system bring-up on automotive Linux and/or Android platforms.
Driving joint initiatives with automotive partners, including system design reviews, requirement alignments, and hands-on debugging workshops.
Providing technical integration directions, clarifying specifications, and handling critical development escalations from OEMs.
Assessing external usability concepts, providing constructive design feedback, and championing Apple's standards for great user experiences.
Contributing to technical requirements and integration guidelines to scale our partner support.
Regular travel to partner engineering centers and testing facilities may be required to support integration milestones.

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.
5+ years of experience in embedded software engineering, SDK development, or automotive systems integration.

Experience troubleshooting complex embedded systems, ideally in areas of automotive systems.
Experience analyzing complex communication logs and reproducing network or interoperability issues.
Experience using agentic AI in code development, issue analysis, and reporting.
Experience utilizing audio and video media codecs, handling streaming content, or routing audio/video inside embedded systems.
Experience taking end-to-end ownership of a feature, product, or protocol from design to release.
Experience engaging directly with external vendors, clients, or cross-functional teams to drive technical initiatives.
Proficiency in written and spoken English and Mandarin.

Hands-on experience integrating and certifying CarPlay (wired / wireless) or Digital Car Key (UWB vehicle access).
Experience working within an automotive OEM or Tier 1 supplier environment.

Experience navigating ambiguity, multitasking effectively, and consistently prioritizing tasks in a fast-paced environment.

Apple-200615795.title: Embedded Software Engineer
Apple-200615795.description:
Are you a big-picture thinker who loves setting ambitious goals? Do you have a passion for understanding how each line of code affects all the others? In the Core Operating Systems group we ensure the OS is inseparable from each device’s identity as a whole. We work on a core technology that is committed to building fully integrated operating systems which combines hardware, software, and apps into a single Apple experience. Your dedication to cross-disciplinary collaboration will help develop groundbreaking technologies, such as iOS, macOS, watchOS, tvOS and visionOS. By crafting these distinct and holistic user experiences, you’ll continue to uphold and advance the excellence people expect from Apple devices.

The CoreOS Asia team within Apple's CoreOS organization is looking for an extraordinary software engineer to work on state-of-the art technology, bring-up and triage of next generation Apple devices under rapid product iteration. In this role you will have the opportunity to make a major impact in the way that Apple develops and ships our products. We strive to create and foster a friendly environment that welcomes innovation and liberating amount of autonomy.

-You will support product requirements for iPhone/iPad/Mac/Apple Watch/AppleTV/Apple Vision Pro - Bring-up, verification, and triage of new hardware platforms - Work cooperatively with other parts of Apple to diagnose and triage new product introduction (NPI) issues in factory.
-You will work with cross-functional teams and help delivering high quality software at fundamental layer of operating system including frameworks, daemons, drivers for both factory and consumers.
-You need to keep security and performance in mind, enabling key features while protecting privacy and preventing fraudulence.
-Working on technology you will have the opportunity to have a major impact on the implementation and quality of Apple's next generation products.
-Up to 10-20% travel.

Bachelor’s/Master's degree or equivalent experience in computer science or a related field
Highly proficient in C/C++ and object oriented programming
Profound understanding on Operating System concept
Experience with programming on embedded system
Fluent in both oral and written English

5+ years' work experience as a system or embedded software engineer
Experience with operating systems design and kernel/bootloader development
Experience with platform bring-up or porting of operating systems

Experience with coding on server client mode software with enhanced security
Extensive knowledge of hardware platforms & processor architectures
Proven creative, critical logical thinking and troubleshooting skills
Highly self-motivated and capable of finishing tasks alone
Strong communication and interpersonal skills
Abilities to work in a fast paced environment

Apple-200644032.description:
The System Firmware and Diagnostics team is looking for an enthusiastic embedded software engineer to join our team. You’ll have the opportunity to work on core technologies to make a major impact in the way that Apple develops, test and manufactures its products. Our environment encourages product innovation, rapid product iteration, collaboration and a liberating amount of autonomy

Apple-200663484.title: Failure Analysis Engineer - Electrical Engineering
Apple-200663484.description:
At Apple, we don’t just build products—we create the kind of wonder that revolutionizes entire industries. It is the diversity of our people and their ideas that fuels the innovation running through everything we do, from groundbreaking technology to industry-leading environmental initiatives. Join us, and help leave the world better than we found it.

In this role, you will help bring our revolutionary technology to the world by ensuring its excellence. Collaborating closely with global teams, you will dive deep to uncover the root causes of complex product challenges. We will empower you with every resource you need to push the boundaries of what is possible—and to do the best work of your life.

Working in a lab environment, you will leverage your scientific and engineering knowledge, along with cutting-edge equipment, to take on the following responsibilities:
 
Understanding the failure background and designing creative investigation plans.
Conducting the investigation, including but not limited to operating a variety of advanced electrical fault isolation tools.
Reporting your findings and engaging in discussion and debate with colleagues on next steps, conclusions, and corrective actions.
Presenting data in global meetings and/or executive reviews.

Execute system bring-up, debugging, failure analysis, and triage.

Apple-200691530.title: Hardware System Engineer – iPhone System Technologies — SoC
Apple-200691530.description:
People here at Apple don’t just build products – we build the kind of wonder that has revolutionized entire industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. Join Apple, and help us leave the world better than we found it. 

Join our cutting-edge iPhone Hardware Engineering team as a System Hardware Engineer and help shape the future of iPhone technology. We are looking for a self driven, solution-oriented engineer who is passionate about advancing SOC system technologies. 

You will lead the development of complex iPhone SoC and system validation strategies and advanced debugging. You will play a pivotal, global role from architecture definition to mass production, directly influencing SoC system design and quality to deliver optimal solutions for iPhone’s overall success. This position requires collaboration with cross-functional teams and includes opportunities for domestic and international travel.

Lead system-level SoC bring-up, functional validation, and stress testing on iPhone hardware platforms from early prototypes to mass production.
Perform deep hardware/software debug and root cause analysis to resolve complex silicon and system issues efficiently.
Develop and execute comprehensive system SoC validation plans, leveraging deep understanding of SoC architecture, feature definition, and system design.
Analyze factory and validation data to identify and resolve silicon/system issues, informing strategic design and system optimization efforts.
Drive power, performance, and thermal characterization and optimization to deliver industry-leading user experiences.
Collaborate closely with cross-functional hardware, software, and silicon teams across global sites to define validation strategies and meet critical product milestones.
Apple-200691530.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.
3+ years of industry experience in system-level SoC bring-up, validation, and debugging.
Strong understanding of SoC architecture (e.g., ARM-based systems), including hardware/software interaction, boot flows, and low-level debug techniques.
Hands-on experience with hardware lab tools such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, power meters, and thermal chambers for SoC characterization and debug.
Proficiency in scripting and programming languages such as Python, TCL, or similar, to develop test plan, enable test automation and data analysis. Experience with automation testing infrastructure development would be a plus.
Self-motivated and able to work independently in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
Excellent communication, collaboration, and interpersonal skills, with experience working across global, cross-functional teams.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Proven experience with kernel- and device driver–level debugging, including use of relevant debug and validation tools.
Strong familiarity with mobile hardware platform design, including power delivery systems (PDN, PMIC) and high-speed, low-speed, and debug interfaces such as USB, MIPI, UART, and JTAG.

Apple-200683452.title: Hardware System Integration Engineer - AirPods
Apple-200683452.description:
At Apple, new ideas have a way of quickly becoming extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences. Sound is an essential and compelling facet of the customer experience. Apple is assembling a world-class team of engineers who obsesses over the delivery of products that enables our customers to experience music with delight and communicate with clarity. The AirPods System HW team consists of outstanding electrical engineers who own and deliver electronic solutions by closely collaborating with multi-functional teams such as industrial design, product design, technologies and manufacturing. The small form factor of these products enables us to innovate in every aspect of product development that includes areas like advanced physical architectures, new RF technologies and highly power-optimized IC development. We are a diverse team of electrical engineers with a passion for audio, music and product development.

Seeking hardworking engineers who have passion on hardware, you will be responsible for owning aspects of system HW development from HW design to build in the factory, like PCB/flex design, crafting optimized system validation plans, owning manufacturing test requirements, prototype bringup and testing, data analysis and issue debug. 

Key parts of the responsibilities will be that work with manufacturing factory's EE team in the factory on tool design, testing, failure analysis, validation and other HW related cross team support. Travel to factories in other cities and countries might be needed. 

Experienced team members will get to influence future AirPods architectures based on learnings from successfully executing their programs.

EE tasks in the factory including HW testing(coverage, debugging and data review), HW validation, failure analysis, and cross-team support for HW issues.
Design tasks including development board, main board, flex and misc HW modules.
Management and training of manufacturers’ EE team for above tasks.
Apple-200683452.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Bachelors or Masters degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent.
2+ years relevant industry experience in designing electronics and/or embedded systems, or fresh graduate worked as key contributor on HW projects in university.
Strong Electrical Engineering fundamentals (analog/digital design, signal/power integrity, etc.)
Hands-on experience in prototyping, bring-up, debug and validation.
Comfortable in a lab environment using oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, frequency counters, etc.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Experience with high volume products / consumer electronics from proof of concept to mass production; prior experience in working with contract manufacturers highly desirable.
Expertise in board and flex designs including schematic and layout with strong abilities to implement to a timeline and deliver high quality designs.
Knowledge in one or more of the following areas: CPU/SOC, power(DC-DC converters, battery, power management, low power design), inductive power, analog circuits, audio, RF integration and measurement, sensor design and integration, ESD safety.
Python/scripting experience.
Design validation including bench analysis for proving performance to factory test for guaranteeing quality.
Experience working with mechanical design, software, reliability, manufacturing, and operations organizations is desirable.
Experience with challenging and multi-disciplinary failure analysis.
Excellent written skills for clear reporting of data analysis and conclusions.

Apple-200581775.title: In-Region Product Design Engineer - ( Mechanical)
Apple-200581775.description:
Imagine what you could do here! At Apple, creative ideas have a way of becoming wonderful products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish.
We are looking for a Product Design Engineer to join the Mac team. As a Macintosh Product Design Engineer you will be responsible for designing the next generation of Apple computers, both portable and desktop. You will drive the development of the product in a dynamic and fast-paced engineering environment by partnering with cross-functional groups such as industrial designers and product marketing, as well as a slew of hardware engineering teams. We have a firm
dedication to fairness and diversity, recognizing that our culture is strengthened through the wealth of perspectives contributed by each employee; we seek to tap into this extraordinary resource and incorporate it into how we do business. Come join us and be empowered to do the best and most impactful work of your life.

In this highly visible role, you will utilize your mechanical design engineering skills to bring products to the market. Your responsibilities as Mechanical engineers is to design next generation of input device products, portable and desktop computers, and modules to support the Mac and iOS product lines. Your responsibilities will span from technology development, concept generation to detailed design, analysis and testing through mass production ramp. 

developing initial product layouts and new technology concepts
detailed design of mechanisms and sensors
support technology investigations and development
building prototypes to validate function, manufacturability, and robustness
perform FEA or coordinate FEA activities to evaluate and optimize design concepts
analyze data generated from builds and lab experiments
participate in design reviews to generate and receive constructive feedback
perform tolerance analyses to predict performance of mechanisms, sensors, and cosmetic
create specifications, detailed design and 2D documentation of all parts and assemblies
work with operations teams to evaluate and develop supply chains capable of
manufacturing new subsystems and products
interacting with vendors to develop manufacturing processes and tooling concepts
define testing requirements and equipment and analyze the data produced
support build activities including finding root cause for failures and solutions for issues that impede build progress
Apple-200581775.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
BS and above in Mechanical engineering or 3+ years of experience in mechanical design
fundamentals of engineering: strength of materials, material science, statics, heat transfer
good knowledge in design skills: tolerance analysis, mechanism design 
design validation skills: identifying critical requirements and test methods to evaluate designs against them, strong failure analysis skills
computer aided design (CAD) skills: 3D CAD experience required(NX preferred), 2D drafting and GD&T
excellent communication skills: both written and verbal communication

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
creative problem solving, diligence in finding the best solution for each design challenge, excellent spatial reasoning skills, attention to detail
good knowledge in design skills: design for assembly/manufacturability, simple fixture design, design considerations for high volume manufacturing, understanding of Statistical Process Controls (SPC), understanding of metrology (basic knowledge of measurement systems)
broad range of materials and processes: metal machining basics, plastic injection/compression molding basics, designing with metals, designing with polymers, sheet metal design, material finishing basics
familiarity with electrical engineering fundamentals and interconnect technologies is preferred
design validation skills: Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (FMEA), large data set analysis and computer-aided data analysis, Design of Experiments (DOE), Finite Element Analysis (FEA), and mechanical prototyping
computer aided design (CAD) Skills: data exchange and working with printed circuit board (PCB) and flexible printed circuit (FPC), eCAD, electrical mechanical control outline (MCO) generation
build support experience in factory
experience working in a team environment and be self motivated to identify and close design issues
proficiency with high volume manufacturing processes is desired strong consideration will be given to those with a proven track record in precision mechanism and sensor design
industry experiences from medical, consumer electronics, automotive, aerospace and other fields with relevant technology and development models

Apple is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to inclusion and diversity, and thus we treat all applicants fairly and equally. Apple is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to applicants with physical and mental disabilities.

Apple-200683720.title: Instrument Hardware Develop Intern
Apple-200683720.description:
Apple is a place where extraordinary people gather to do their best work. Our community is
made up of every kind of individual: artists and designers, engineers and scientists, thinkers and
doers. Together we create things and experiences people once couldn’t have imagined — and
now can’t imagine living without. So if you’re excited by the idea of making a real impact, a
career with Apple might be your dream job. Just be ready to dream big.
In this role, you will collaborate with extraordinary engineering teams to integrate hardware,
software, and AI technologies into cutting-edge electrical test systems, delivering industry-
leading test solutions for Apple products.

As a Hardware Systems Engineer Intern, you will develop customized electrical test systems for
Apple products. This role requires an EE with strong AI skills who, above all, enjoys building and
shipping real, working systems rather than just designing on paper.
You will be responsible for designing precision functional circuits (e.g., low-noise analog front-
ends, precision AD/DA, and high-speed digital systems), performing simulations, executing
system validation, and troubleshooting. You will also drive hardware/software integration, build
tools to automate data analysis, and creatively push for continuous design improvements.
Apple-200683720.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
BS/MS EE or related field.
Design experience in analog, power, high-speed digital, or MCU systems.
Hands-on experience with electrical lab test equipment (e.g., oscilloscope, DMM).
Ability to handle multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
Strong problem-solving skills and curiosity to learn.
Practical experience with AI/ML development.
Fluent and effective communication skills in both English and Chinese.
Availability to commit to a full-time internship for at least 3 months.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Experience in embedded systems hardware/software design.
Experience in FPGA development and RTL programming.
Proficiency in at least one programming language (e.g., Python, C/C++, Lua, Swift, Obj-C).
Excellent interpersonal skills and a collaborative mindset.

Apple-200674741.title: Mac Hardware Systems Engineer
Apple-200674741.description:
The people here at Apple don't just build products - they build the kind of wonder that's revolutionized entire industries. It's the diversity of those people and their ideas that encourages the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. Join Apple, and help us leave the world better than we found it.

We are searching for self-driven, hardworking electrical engineers to provide design, test, characterization, failure analysis and manufacturing support to our product. Our products are on the groundbreaking in every way: usability, integration, connectivity, power consumption, fabrication, reliability, manufacturing scale. The candidate will play a meaningful role in the development of Apple products, collaborating with multi-functional design team in the process.

You will take ownership of sophisticated characterization and debugging frameworks for Mac platforms. Operating on a global scale, your expertise will bridge the gap between initial hardware architecture and final mass production, directly optimizing the quality of Mac systems. Expect to work closely with diverse, cross-functional engineering teams, with potential travel required to support worldwide operations.

You will participate in design and development of next generation mobile Mac products from concept to mass production.
You will support all EE characterizations at local site, analyze test report, address the conclusion and perform lab analysis.
You will participate online/offline software development, to further optimize workflow, boost efficiency and improve work result
You are the technical contact at OEM site to support various engineering activities. Represent the EE team in a multi-functional team environment. Helping factory with EE related issues and driving post ramp quality issue.
You will manage vendor EE resources for better technical support.
Apple-200674741.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in EE related majors
Must have hands-on EE lab experience, be familiar with lab equipments like oscilloscope, power source, E-load, TDR etc., aware of EE lab activities such as board/system bring up or issue debug, and sensitive to circuit behaviors.
Programming or scripting skills (e.g., Python, Shell) to automate laboratory setups, program test instruments, parse engineering data, and streamline repetitive tasks.
Must have a proven understanding of EE knowledge in at least one of below fields: power design, EMC, signal/power integrity, industry standard protocols (DP, USB, I2C/SPI, SDIO, SPMI etc.)
Outstanding interpersonal skills in both English and Chinese.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Direct experience in high volume consumer electronics like smart phone, laptops, drones, wearable devices etc.
Familiarity with building and deploying web tools. Knowledge of databases (e.g., SQLite, PostgreSQL) and web frameworks (e.g., Django, Flask, React) is a strong plus.
Experience leveraging AI tools and frameworks (e.g., LLMs, machine learning algorithms) to automate tasks, analyze engineering data, or enhance daily workflows.
Highly proactive, with the ability to drive tasks independently and adapt quickly to fast-moving project schedules.
Strong leadership and team collaboration spirit to drive test coverage enhancements and test method optimization.

Apple-200633028.title: Manufacturing Design Engineer
Apple-200633028.description:
Imagine what you could do here! At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. We bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish.

In this highly visible role, you will lead selection, implementation & optimization of iPhone manufacturing processes for mechanical enclosure machining, surface treatment. Lead team to design outstanding process based on product drawing and cosmetic requirements; mapping out proper process flow and ERS which includes selecting processing equipment, designing corresponding fixtures, initiating DOEs to find out the best recipe. 

Apply your Mechanical Engineering experience and work multi-functionally with Product Design Engineering and Industrial Design to assess product features for manufacturability, and recommend capable production processes and equipment. 

With multiple material machining experience, have expertise in CNC process development, assess CNC machining process flow, review CNC fixture design DFM and drive improvement, apply proper datum to minimize tolerance stack-up, scope machining program to improve process capability and optimize c/t, develop advanced cutters with proper coating for some special use such like high shinny surface, fine texture surface, minimize burrs by cutter improvement. 

Lead the machine calibration criteria setup and implementation, figure out how to recover the machine accuracy by maintenance and or retrofit, down-select machine base on machine capability and process requirement, work with vendor to develop brand-new equipment from RFQ to machine validation, finally qualify machine and implementation to fulfill process requirement. 

Working with suppliers to define and refine mechanical tool and fixtures, which can secure the dimension and cosmetic requirement, establish process capability and readiness.

Lead the c/t reduction in the NPI stage to hit the MP target. 

Review/define vendor’s in process control spec base on downstream process and 2D drawing requirement, define part tolerance and specifications by demonstrating process capability to Product Designers and Industrial Designers.

Identify, research, develop, and qualify premier equipment manufacturers and suppliers to develop sophisticated equipment for special process use and fulfill supply chain requirement. 

Provide leadership at manufacturing sites during development and product production ramp.

Coordination of activities and direction through clear communication between Asia and US-based teams, and vendors is a necessity.

Work closely with Manufacture Design Engineers in the development of above said processes. 

Work with Global Supply Managers to assess facility, floor layout, provide engineering support to secure deliver material to downstream CM vendor on time and on cost. 

Work with Manufacture Quality Engineers to drive yield improvement through SPC, Pareto data review to take activities accordingly.
Apple-200633028.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
-  BS or equivalent experience or above in Mechanical / Industrial Engineering and/or relevant manufacturing work experience.

-  5+ years relevant hands-on experience and technical knowledge in fixture design, CNC process and cutter design in consumer electronics industry.

-  Familiar with CAD/CAM/JMP software and GD&T to make data driven decisions.

-  Good written and oral communication skills, proficient in both English and Mandarin. 

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
-  Has experience in either Titanium or metal components manufacturing processes including MIM, additive manufacturing (e.g. LPBF, DMD).

-  Other process knowledge such as raw material, assembly, testing, and experiences in developing customized machine (non-standard machine) are preferred.

-  Experience in AIML and lean factory.

-  Familiar with FEA tools such as SEM, XRD, MTS, XPS, FTIR, RIB, TEM, etc.

-  Familiar with Phyton/C++/SQL software.

-  Familiar with CAE or simulation tools.

-  On-site build support; must be willing to work from OEM factories. 

-  A great teammate who is self-motivated, results oriented and detailed oriented. 

-  Ability and willingness to work independently and travel frequently in Asia.

Apple-200662478.title: Manufacturing Design Engineer
Apple-200662478.description:
Imagine what you could do here! At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. We bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish.

In this highly visible role, you will lead selection, implementation & optimization of iPhone manufacturing processes for mechanical enclosure machining, surface treatment. Lead team to design outstanding process based on product drawing and cosmetic requirements; mapping out proper process flow and ERS which includes selecting processing equipment, designing corresponding fixtures, initiating DOEs to find out the best recipe. 

Apply your mechanical engineering expertise and work cross-functionally with Product Design and Industrial Design to assess product features for manufacturability, and recommend capable production processes and equipment. You will provide critical leadership at manufacturing sites during development and product production ramps. Coordination of activities and direction through clear communication between Asia- and US-based teams, and vendors is a necessity. 
You will also work closely with fellow Manufacture Design Engineers in the development of these processes.

Drive development of manufacturing processes—including CNC, laser, assembly, and automation—by assessing process flows, reviewing fixture design for manufacturability (DFM), and applying proper datums to minimize tolerance stack-up.
Scope machining programs to optimize cycle times, and develop advanced cutters with specialized coatings to achieve highly shiny or fine texture surfaces while minimizing burrs.
Establish machine calibration criteria, down-select equipment based on capability, and work with vendors to develop, validate, and qualify brand-new equipment from RFQ to implementation.
Collaborate with suppliers to define and refine mechanical tools and fixtures, establishing process readiness to secure dimensional and cosmetic requirements.
Lead cycle time reductions in the NPI stage to hit mass production targets, and review vendor in-process control specifications based on downstream processes and 2D drawings.
Identify, research, and qualify premier equipment manufacturers and suppliers to develop sophisticated equipment that fulfills supply chain requirements.
Partner cross-functionally with Global Supply Managers to assess facilities, and with Manufacture Quality Engineers to drive yield improvements through SPC and Pareto data reviews.

Apple-200681096.title: Manufacturing Design Engineer
Apple-200681096.description:
Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, innovative ideas have a way of quickly becoming extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences. This is where individual imaginations and experiences gather together that leads to great work. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish!

The people here at Apple don’t just create products — they create the kind of wonder that’s revolutionized entire industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that encourages the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. Join Apple, and help us leave the world better than we found it!

In this highly visible role, you will manage selection, implementation & optimization of manufacturing processes for mechanical enclosure subassemblies for our legendary products.

You will apply your Mechanical Engineering experience and work cross functionally with Product Design Engineering and Industrial Design to assess product features for manufacturability, and recommend capable production processes and equipment.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

Collaborate with US-based MDEs counterpart in the development of mechanical processes.

Collaborate with Global Supply Managers to develop new equipment from RFQ through factory implementation, and manufacture and deliver material to downstream supply chain nodes on time and on cost.

You will work with Mechanical Quality Engineers to drive yield improvement through analyses of part quality, defect Pareto, and SPC.

A heavy emphasis will be on working with suppliers to define and refine mechanical tooling and fixtures, and establishing process capability and readiness.

Coordination of activities and direction through clear communication between the Asia and US-based teams, and vendors is a necessity.

You may audit supplier secondary processes as well as support product phase builds from prototype through ramp and mass production.

Provide leadership at manufacturing sites during development and product production ramp, and drive engineering issues to resolution

Use data to drive process decisions, basic data analysis, DOEs, SPC, etc.

Design best-in-class process based on cosmetic and drawing requirement, mapping out and document process flow and details which includes selecting processing equipments, designing fixtures/automations, initiating DOEs to find out the best process and parameters, and finalizing the process solution from prototype stage to mass production stage.

Define part tolerance and specifications by demonstrating process capability to Product Designers and Industrial Designers. Lead process development/have expertise in assembly - develop automation/fixture for assembly, bonding process (glue, welding), laser process(welding/cutting/etch/surface treatment) etc. Own yield improvement actions and process change decisions based on statistical process control (SPC) data analysis.

Identify, research, develop, and qualify premier equipment manufacturers and supplier
Apple-200681096.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Bachelor degree in Mechanical, Manufacturing or Industry Engineering, Master or Ph. D is a plus, proven track record of outstanding academic performances is preferred.

Proficient in English as a working language (verbal and written)

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Cross disciplinary knowledges like mechatronics, control theory, machine learning are considered plus. 

A standout teammate and self starter with innovation, integrity and attention to details.

Ability to work on manufacturing sites independently and willingness on over 50% travel frequently (mainly in Asia).

Action oriented, is able to manage the challenges and proactive to provide solutions.

Vendor management experience, be good handling the conflicts and command vendors to implement actions and deliver results.

Quick learner, capable to quickly pick up process knowledge and make design influence, meanwhile be innovative to process engineering.

Apple-200669096.title: Manufacturing Design Engineer - Powder Materials & Atomization Process
Apple-200669096.description:
Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish.

The people here at Apple don’t just build products — they craft the kind of wonder that’s revolutionized entire industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that encourages the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. Join Apple and help us leave the world better than we found it!

The Apple Manufacturing Design Materials Process Engineer is accountable for leading the development, qualification, and high-volume deployment of advanced metal powder manufacturing processes across Apple’s worldwide supply base. In this critical, hands-on role, you will specialize in Aluminum (Al) and Titanium (Ti) powder synthesis, gas atomization, powder characterization, and recycling pipelines destined for additive manufacturing process.

You will collaborate directly with Apple cross functional teams, as well as our international powder suppliers. You are empowered and expected to bring deep metallurgical creativity, process rigor, and data-driven problem solving to pioneer sustainable, high-yield powder supply chains for Apple products.

You will own the end-to-end process development, qualification, and scaling of high-performance Aluminum and Titanium alloy powders. You will bridge the gap between upstream raw material sourcing / atomization and downstream component fabrication to guarantee that our powder feedstock delivers unmatched cosmetic, dimensional, and mechanical performance.

You will be expected to:

Partner with Product Design and Industrial Design to translate mechanical, environmental, and cosmetic goals into strict powder-level raw material specifications.
Identify, audit, and validate global atomization partners, melt equipment, and classification systems capable of producing ultra-clean, spherical Al and Ti powders.
Establish comprehensive process parameter windows (melt superheat, gas-to-metal ratio, nozzle geometry, atomization gas purity, cooling rates) to control yield curves, particle morphology, and minimize satellites/hollow particles.
Define strict inert handling, packaging, storage, and traceability protocols to mitigate moisture pickup, pyrophoric risks, and ambient contamination.
Drive DOEs to analyze the impact of raw material inputs (sponge Ti, virgin Al ingot, post-industrial scrap, master alloys) on final powder purity and mechanical/cosmetic consistency.
Lead root-cause failure investigations (FA/RCA) on powder defects causing downstream component porosity, inclusion-driven cosmetic streaks, or anodizing inconsistencies.
Collaborate with Global Supply Managers to drive technical roadmaps, cost reduction, capacity planning, and yield optimization across the powder supplier matrix.
Provide on-site technical leadership during development phases (Proto, EVT, DVT, PVT) and mass production ramp at international supplier facilities.

You may be asked to lead development in one or more of the following areas:

Scaling EIGA, VIGA, or Plasma Atomization processes for proprietary Titanium and Aluminum formulations.
Development of closed-loop Titanium and Aluminum powder recycling and rejuvenation cycles (evaluating multi-generation reuse effects on interstitial pick-up and sphericity).
Implementing advanced in-line/real-time quality monitoring systems (acoustic emission, optical pyrometry, automated PSD sensing) for continuous atomization runs.
Engineering tailored PSD fractions (e.g., $15–53,\mu\text{m}$ for LPBF, fine cuts for Binder Jetting or MIM) to optimize packing density and surface finish.
Standardizing custom chemical clean-room procedures and cross-contamination prevention guidelines between reactive (Ti, Al) and non-reactive metal lines.
Correlating melt-source chemistry and atomization dynamics to downstream surface cosmetics (e.g., grain structure, anodizing response, bead-blast texture).
Apple-200669096.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
BS, MS, or PhD in Materials Science and Engineering, Metallurgical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline. Advanced degree preferred.
Hands-on experience in metal atomization, powder metallurgy, materials characterization, and manufacturing process engineering with a strong emphasis on Titanium and Aluminum alloys.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Deep industry expertise in gas atomization technologies (e.g., Vacuum Induction Gas Atomization [VIGA], Electrode Induction-melting Gas Atomization [EIGA]).
Comprehensive knowledge of powder lifecycle & post-processing, including inert classification, sieving, air classification/cyclone separation, blending, degasification, and safe handling/passivation of reactive metal powders.
Expertise in powder characterization methodologies and standards (ASTM/ISO) covering:
Particle Size Distribution (PSD via laser diffraction, dynamic image analysis).
Powder morphology (SEM, circularity, sphericity, satellites, internal porosity via micro-CT/cross-sectioning).
Rheology and flowability (Hall/Carney flowmeter, Freeman FT4 powder rheology, tap/apparent density).
Interstitial and trace chemistry control ($O, N, H, C, S$ via inert gas fusion / LECO; ICP-OES/MS for alloy constituents).
Strong background in circular metallurgy and sustainable feedstocks, including re-atomization of manufacturing scrap/swarf, powder rejuvenation/reuse loops, and minimizing carbon footprint to support Apple’s 2030 carbon neutrality goals.
Demonstrated mastery of Design of Experiments (DOE), Statistical Process Control (SPC), Gauge R&R, and data-driven process optimization.
Practical understanding of downstream interactions—how powder characteristics (interstitial oxygen pick-up, PSD skewness, flowability) directly influence build density, mechanical properties, and final cosmetic anodization/polishing yields.
Robust project management skills with the ability to lead technical initiatives and manage schedules independently across global time zones.
Comfort and proficiency working on the production floor at partner atomization plants and test laboratories worldwide.

Apple-200683731.title: Manufacturing Design Engineer, Brittles
Apple-200683731.description:
Imagine what you could do here! At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish. 

The people here at Apple don’t just build products — they craft the kind of wonder that’s revolutionized entire industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. Join Apple, and help us leave the world better than we found it! 

We are seeking a highly versatile and motivated Manufacturing Design Engineer (MDE) to lead the development of manufacturing processes and equipment for precision brittle products (e.g., glass, ceramics, crystals).

We are open to candidates who specialize in custom equipment development (automation, CNC, processing). In this role, you will bridge the gap between product design and mass production, acting as a deep technical expert to ensure our complex components can be manufactured at scale with exceptional yield, performance, and quality.

Process & Equipment Development: Lead the architecture, design, and qualification of custom manufacturing equipment or end-to-end processes for brittle materials. This includes driving solutions for CNC machining, polishing, Ion Exchange (IOX), pad printing, and precision assembly.

External Vendor Management: Act as the primary technical point of contact for external Equipment vendors (driving design, URS, FAT/SAT) and Contract Manufacturing (CM) vendors (driving factory bring-up, high-volume integration, and continuous improvement).

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Navigate a complex internal matrix to bring products to life:
- Partner with Product Designers (PDs) on Design for Manufacturability (DFM).
- Collaborate with Manufacturing Quality Engineers (MQEs) to establish robust quality control plans and inspection criteria.
- Align with Global Supply Managers (GSMs) and Capex GSMs on commercial strategies, equipment budgets, and vendor selection.

Advanced Problem Solving: Utilize Design of Experiments (DOEs), failure analysis, and data-driven root cause analysis to resolve complex manufacturing defects, improve yields, and stabilize processes.

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Physics, Materials Science, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

Experience: 5+ years of hands-on working experience in manufacturing process engineering, and custom equipment development.

Domain Expertise: Deep technical knowledge in the handling and processing of brittle materials, accompanied by expert-level proficiency in the following areas: Custom equipment design and process parameter optimization for CNC, polishing, IOX, pad printing, and assembly.

Partnership: Proven track record of successfully managing external equipment suppliers and CM partners.

Communication: Excellent communication skills to effectively collaborate with highly technical design teams (PD), quality/operations teams (MQE), and business/sourcing teams (GSMs).

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Higher education background (Master or Ph.D.) is highly preferred.
Prior experience successfully scaling early-stage hardware technologies into high-volume consumer electronics mass production.
Ability to travel internationally to CM and vendor sites as required to support equipment bring-up and qualification.

Apple-200665228.title: Manufacturing Design Opportunities
Apple-200665228.description:
How do you build a great idea? With more great ideas — the kind of thinking that transforms the work of our industrial designers into the devices that enrich the lives of our customers. Join this team to develop manufacturing engineering solutions that deliver our products with outstanding precision at an unprecedented scale. You’ll help design and customize equipment, build manufacturing processes, refine tooling, identify suppliers, and work with key operations partners to optimize capacity and cost — without losing sight of our incredibly high standards for quality!

Global Supply Manager 

Apple GSMs own the commercial relationship with our enclosure manufacturing partners and are responsible for cost negotiations, continuity of supply, risk management, driving operational and cost efficiencies through process or design change, as well overall project execution. GSMs sit at the intersection of Apple's business activities and engineering communities, and effectively balance the needs of both groups to ensure successful product launches. Enclosure components (such as the housing) define the look, feel and expression of Apple’s globally recognized industrial and product design. GSMs work in concert with operations, manufacturing quality, and manufacturing design engineers as well as Apple’s Product Design and Industrial Design teams. Together, these teams execute and scale both new and existing manufacturing processes, materials, technologies, finishes and form factors.

Manufacturing Design Engineer 

The Apple Manufacturing Design Engineer (MDE) is accountable for leading the development and implementation of high precision mechanical manufacturing processes across Apple’s worldwide supply base. In this highly visible hands-on role, you will have direct frequent communication and collaboration with Apple Industrial Design, Product Design, and Manufacturing Design partners, as well as our worldwide suppliers. The MDE role is empowered and expected to bring creativity to Apple’s manufacturing approach, enabling us to deliver our best work to as many customers as possible. You will be a part of collaborative environment contributing to the creation, evaluation, and implementation of end-to-end manufacturing solutions for Apple's hardware enclosures. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional stakeholders in Quality Engineering, Global Supply Management, Product Design, and Industrial Design in order to ensure our manufacturing solutions meet our product quality, cost, yield, capacity, schedule, and environmental goals.

Manufacturing Design Program Manager

The Manufacturing Design Program Manager (MDPM) is responsible for managing and guiding development activities of highly skilled process development, operations, and quality teams within Apple’s Manufacturing Design group. The MDPM will lead the team to develop processes for building extraordinary products from existing and new ideas based on business needs. The MDPM should possess a blend of business and technical knowledge, allowing for big-picture vision and the ability to dive deep into specific challenges. MDPM team members operate autonomously, demonstrate strong leadership capabilities, and juggle competing priorities with ease.

Manufacturing Quality Engineer 

Manufacturing Quality Engineers work in tandem with Apple's world-class designers to develop measurement technologies, control strategies, information systems, and manufacturing methods that achieve visionary specifications at massive production scale. We lead a network of supplier factories worldwide, with responsibility for our partners' delivery to aggressive schedules. Our focus is on elegant execution of extraordinary designs, resulting in products that thrill our customers.

New Product Operations Program Manager

We are the primary operations interface to the core product development team and Module Engineering team within Apple. As the owner of the program, through direct involvement and/or influence, you will ensure the successful launch of the product towards meeting it’s stated Cost, Quality, Schedule, Availability and Customer Experience goals. Apple-200662097.description:

The people here at Apple don’t just build products — they build the kind of wonder that’s revolutionized entire industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that encourages the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. Join Apple, and help us leave the world better than we found it.

Imaging what you could do here. At Apple, creative ideas have a way of becoming wonderful products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there’s no telling what you could accomplish.

The enclosure team plays an integral part of the product development process. Working in tandem with renowned designers to develop manufacturing methods and measurement control plans that achieve visionary specifications at massive production scale. The focus is on elegant execution of industrial designs that continue to stretch conventional beliefs and at times appear to border on the impossible, resulting in products that delight our customers. The primary role of the team is to support and lead a network of supplier factories worldwide, with responsibility to deliver extraordinary quality on-time to aggressive schedules.

-  Target Setting: Collaborates multi-functionally to assess the current state of the plant’s operation, establish continuous improvement target, develops future state vision and implementation plan. 

-  CI Project Implementation: Implements and monitors CI(continuous improvement) projects, and facilitates multi-functional team to drive breakthrough or best-in-class performance in equipment, people, quality, material flow and cost. Coach vendor teams to use tools such as 8D, 5S, Kaizen, Six-Sigma (DMAIC), VSM and SPC for process improvement. 

-  CI Project Tracking and Reporting: Uses standard tracking and reporting systems, drives project performance, and assures accurate completion and achievement of process, quality and cost saving goals. 

-  Efficiency Improvement: Performs analysis on equipment and work force utilization, space requirements, workflow and layout of equipment and workspace for maximum efficiency. 

-  Lean Strategy: Support to form and implement a Lean strategy for selected major vendors, leads programs of benchmarking and VSM to drive improvement systemically cross projects and vendors, study critical areas impacting on productivity and yield such as man-machine coordination, robot efficiency and container design.

-  Supplier Coordination: Acts as liaison between supplier and internal departments, identifies barriers to project success and solicits help from champions when needed. 

-  Best Practice Sharing: Coordinates multiple engineering projects and summary reporting, identifies and aims to implement model Lean lines/cells, and then extends to whole and other suppliers and projects.

Lean Six-Sigma certified and familiar with CI Tools

Ability to travel domestic and internationally

Ability to interface effectively with all levels of employees, management and diverse audience, including suppliers and internal customers

Knowledge of AI or ML adapt to manufacturing is a plus

Apple-200607703.title: Mechanical Design Engineer-Beats Accessories
Apple-200607703.description:
Apple is where individual imaginations capture together, committing to the values that lead to great work. Every new product we build, service we create, or Apple Store experience we deliver is the result of us making each other’s ideas stronger. That happens because every one of us shares a belief that we can make something wonderful and share it with the world, changing lives for the better. It’s the diversity of our people and their thinking that encourages the innovation that runs through everything we do. When we bring everybody in, we can do the best work of our lives. Here, you’ll do more than join something — you’ll add something.

Our Beats Accessories team is looking for a Mechanical Design Engineer(MDE) to lead a project team of Process, Test, DFX, and SQE Engineers to develop and launch high-quality accessories. You will act as the primary technical operations leader, ensuring a smooth transition from design to mass production(MP).

-  Technical Liaison: Bridge communication between Apple Design and suppliers.

-  NPI Input: Provide early and ongoing manufacturing feedback to Apple Design.

-  Supplier Assessment: Evaluate and select manufacturing partners based on technical capabilities.

-  Process Development: Define and optimize manufacturing and test processes.

-  Quality Assurance: Develop and implement quality control measures.

-  Risk Management: Identify, mitigate, and resolve technical risks.

-  Issue Resolution: Lead troubleshooting of complex technical problems.

-  Collaboration: Partner with Engineering and Operations teams.
Apple-200607703.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Bachelor degree in Mechanical, Manufacturing or Industrial Engineering or related major.

Minimum 6 years of hands-on experience in design / manufacturing process development.

 Proficient in both written and oral English, can use it as a working language.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Expertise in accessory design and manufacturing with emphasis in at least two of these categories:

-  Assemble core technology (Gluing/Soldering/Welding and so on). 

-  Soft-good assemble process

-  Over-molding, insert molding, injection molding processes.

-  Hands-on experience and technical knowledge in fixture design and various production processes such as CNC (milling, lathing), surface finishing (polishing, blasting, lapping, anodization), coating (ink, paint),

-  Mechanical or electrical testing including fixtures involved: Flex, Pull, Bending.

Proven track record of managing a cross-functional team in order to achieve new product objectives inclusive of quality, yield and cost.

Skilled in communicating sophisticated analytics, making data-driven insights accessible and actionable.

Design or development experience along with operations experience.

Proven bottom line project management experience (Planning, Cost & Delivery).

Apple is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to inclusion and diversity, and thus we treat all applicants fairly and equally. Apple is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to applicants with physical and mental disabilities.

Apple-200605593.title: Mechanical Systems Design Engineer
Apple-200605593.description:
The people here at Apple don’t just create products — they create the kind of wonder
that’s revolutionized entire industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas
that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing
technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. Join Apple, and help us leave the
world better than we found it. Are you up for the challenge?

Apple’s Measurement R&D group is recruiting Mechanical Systems Design Engineers
with mechanical and automation design experience, strong communication and
technical leadership skills.

You will brainstorm, design, develop and characterize metrology equipment used to
calibrate and test Apple’s new groundbreaking technology and products. Your design
work will range from lab scale systems-- understanding and characterizing tool
capability at sub-micron mechanical tolerances, to developing automated mass-
production measurement tools, where balancing the engineering tradeoffs between
precision, costs, lead-time and throughput is critical. With great diversity of the problem
space, you will rely on your engineering background to architect the optimal solution for
the problem at hand, leaning on the fundamentals of materials science, structural and
thermal analysis, machinery design, automation and manufacturing processes.

You will work collaboratively with a creative and diverse team of experienced engineers
from all disciplines including instrumentation, core technology, product design and
operations teams developing state of the art measurement systems for Apple.

Automated measurement system development and optimization from ideation to deployment.
Detailed mechanical design of manual and automated measurement and calibration systems (including component and materials selection, 3D/2D CAD, mechanism design, FEA)
Collaboration with vendors to develop measurement systems and improve manufacturing and metrology capabilities and processes
Management of vendor prototyping schedule and manufacturing plan
Support new product failure analysis and continuous improvements in product manufacturability and performance, contributing to the production of the highest quality products available
Support new vendor development to expand Apple’s vendor base with regards to capability, capacity, and geographical influence
Requires China domestic and international travel to support equipment design, deployment, and validation

You know 3D CAD modeling systems and workflow
You can apply GD&T (ASME Y14.5) principles and drafting standards
You love stress-strain relationships, static mechanics (determinate and indeterminate systems)
You get excited about kinematics and mechanism design

High volume electronics manufacturing equipment design, including structures, sheet metal, plastics, fixture/mechanism design, robotics, probe design, plating materials and thermal design is a plus
UG NX experience preferred
FEA (stress analysis) highly desirable, ANSYS preferred
Plastic part design, molded part design highly desirable
Metal and plastic materials science, tribology and wear principles highly desirable
Project and product management experience strongly preferred

Apple’s Measurement R&D group is recruiting Mechanical Systems Design Engineers
with mechanical and automation design experience, strong communication and
technical leadership skills.

You will brainstorm, design, develop and characterize metrology equipment used to
calibrate and test Apple’s new groundbreaking technology and products. Your design
work will range from lab scale systems-- understanding and characterizing tool
capability at sub-micron mechanical tolerances, to developing automated mass-
production measurement tools, where balancing the engineering tradeoffs between
precision, costs, lead-time and throughput is critical. With great diversity of the problem
space, you will rely on your engineering background to architect the optimal solution for
the problem at hand, leaning on the fundamentals of materials science, structural and
thermal analysis, machinery design, automation and manufacturing processes.

You will work collaboratively with a creative and diverse team of experienced engineers
from all disciplines including instrumentation, core technology, product design and
operations teams developing state of the art measurement systems for Apple.

Automated measurement system development and optimization from ideation to deployment.
Detailed mechanical design of manual and automated measurement and calibration systems (including component and materials selection, 3D/2D CAD, mechanism design, FEA)
Collaboration with vendors to develop measurement systems and improve manufacturing and metrology capabilities and processes
Management of vendor prototyping schedule and manufacturing plan
Support new product failure analysis and continuous improvements in product manufacturability and performance, contributing to the production of the highest quality products available
Support new vendor development to expand Apple’s vendor base with regards to capability, capacity, and geographical influence
Requires China domestic and international travel to support equipment design, deployment, and validation

Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
You have an engineering background (Mechanical / Aerospace / Mechatronics)
You’re motivated with the dream and ability to become an integral part of Apple’s talented, highly creative and dynamic engineering team
You have excellent communication and interpersonal skills
You know 3D CAD modeling systems and workflow
You can apply GD&T (ASME Y14.5) principles and drafting standards
You love stress-strain relationships, static mechanics (determinate and indeterminate systems)
You get excited about kinematics and mechanism design

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
High volume electronics manufacturing equipment design, including structures, sheet metal, plastics, fixture/mechanism design, robotics, probe design, plating materials and thermal design is a plus
UG NX experience preferred
FEA (stress analysis) highly desirable, ANSYS preferred
Plastic part design, molded part design highly desirable
Metal and plastic materials science, tribology and wear principles highly desirable
Project and product management experience strongly preferred
People management experience a plus

Apple-200493381.description:
We live in a mobile and device driven world where knowledge of the physical world around us is needed. We rely on this knowledge to get around, to learn about our environment and to enable spectacular new features for custom applications. Apple is meeting those needs as robustly and as creatively as possible and is interested in people who want to help meet that commitment. 

At Apple, we believe our products begin with our people! By hiring a team with varied strengths, we drive creative thought. By giving that team everything they need, we drive innovation. By hiring incredible engineers, we drive precision. And through our collaborative process, we build memorable experiences for our customers!

These elements come together to make Apple an amazing environment for motivated people to do the greatest work of their lives. You will become part of a hands-on development team that sets the standard in cultivating excellence, creativity and innovation. Will you help us design the next generation of revolutionary Apple products?

We are looking for someone who is passionate about engineering and thrives on innovation to help build the tooling for the world’s most innovative mobile devices.  

- Lead the development of new plastic tooling projects to meet wide range of product performance and cosmetic requirements for iPhone tooling. 
- Troubleshooting issues in scientific approach with the use of engineering tools/techniques such as decoupled molding, scientific molding approach, Tolerance Analysis, SPC, DOE, and Six Sigma techniques.
- Serve as Apple’s internal expert for the molding process by leveraging a
thorough understanding of various material properties and tool component
fabrication techniques.

BS/MS in Engineering, Plastics Technology, Polymer Science, or equivalent.
With hand-on molding process experiences, and able to setup, optimize the molding process independently.
Well-trained in scientific injection molding, e.g RJG certified master molder training 
Familiar with issue troubleshooting, such as cosmetics, dimensions, and deformation etc. Systematic and strong logical sense
Strong communication skills - written presentation and verbal
Frequent travel within the region is required

Experience in developing plastic processing parameters with hands-on experience in mold setup, process optimization, and problem-solving.

 Good knowledge of geometric dimensioning.
 Good knowledge of hot runner systems application and scientific molding technique.
  Experience in managing and developing precision parts, high-pace, and mass-volume products with multiple vendors in parallel.
 Excellent in written, presentation, and oral communication
 Systematic, analytical & strong troubleshooting skills

Apple-200573544.title: Product Design Engineer - iPhone (Mechanical)
Apple-200573544.description:
Passion works here. 

Apple is a place where extraordinary people gather to do their best work. Our community is made up of every kind of individual: artists and designers, engineers and scientists, thinkers and doers. Together we create things and experiences people once couldn’t have imagined — and now can’t imagine living without. So if you’re excited by the idea of making a real impact, a career with Apple might be your dream job. Just be ready to dream big.

Apple is looking for a Product Design Engineer to be part of Apple’s Product Design Group in Shanghai or Shenzhen in China. 
We are looking for someone who is passionate about engineering and thrives on innovation. 
The role will require the ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously with demanding schedule requirements across a large cross functional team. A proven ability to deliver solid design solutions while balancing multiple priorities is key. Experience closely working with suppliers & cross function team is important as well. The engineer in this role will be very comfortable with applying scientific method and have be able to apply or create the process through which they can solve complex problems.

Design and develop tight-tolerance mechanical components for iPhone product systems.
Create and implement test and validation infrastructure for DOE plans.
Characterize mechanical components and manufacturing assembly processes.
Support new product engineering builds by driving on-site issue resolution.
Conduct failure analysis on build issues to identify root causes.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams and vendors to implement effective corrective actions for build issues.
Apple-200573544.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Bachelor’s or Masters degree in mechanical engineering or related discipline
High degree of motivation, curiosity, passion, creativity
Proficient English communication skills in both written and verbal
Engineering fundamentals: statics, strength of materials, material science, heat transfer
Computer aided design (CAD) skills: 3D CAD experience required (NX preferred)
Design intelligence: mechanical intuition, creative problem solving, spatial reasoning, diligence in finding the best solution for each design challenge, attention to detail
Interested in traveling up to 50% throughout a year

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Basic design skills: tolerances analysis, design for assembly (DFA), design for manufacturing (DFM), simple fixture design, understanding of Statistical Process Controls (SPC), understanding of metrology (basic knowledge of measurement systems)
Experience in design cycle from concept through manufacturing and a history of engaging with vendors to yield successful parts/assemblies
Experience in designing mechanical components for high volume manufacturing - injection molded parts, sheet metal components, die-cast and machined parts
Experience in team work with Contract Manufacturing Partners
Familiarity with AI application, programming and app development is a strong plus.

Apple-200675419.title: Touch Integration Electrical Engineer
Apple-200675419.description:
The people here at Apple don't just build products - they build the kind of wonder that's revolutionized entire industries. It's the diversity of those people and their ideas that encourages the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. Join Apple, and help us leave the world better than we found it.  

Design, develop, and launch next-generation Touch Technologies in Apple products. The Touch Technology team develops cutting-edge Touch solutions and technologies that are central to Apple’s products, including the MacBook Pro, MacBook Air, MacBook Neo, AirPods, HomePods, AppleTV and more. The key goal of the Touch Technology team is to enable the world’s best touch user-experience. New challenges arise every day that require the sharp problem-solving skills of hardworking and smart individuals. The team features a collaborative and hands-on environment that fosters engineering excellence, creativity, and innovation.   

Come, join us in crafting outstanding solutions!

- Touch sensor design and integration from proof of concept to mass production. 
- Schematic design of boards and flexible assemblies. 
- Touch ASIC system-level bring-up and integration. 
- Touch subsystem modeling and prototyping. 
- Failure mode analysis, root cause diagnosis, and system-level problem solving. 
- Design analysis, characterization, and validation. 
- Support factory prototype builds.
- Touch technology scoping and proof-of-concept investigations. 
- Business travel to support product development.
Apple-200675419.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
M.S or above in Electrical Engineering with 3+ years of relevant experience.
Strong electrical engineering background in analog or mixed-signal design (e.g. Op-Amp, feedback, filter, ADC/DAC or signal processing, etc.)
Hands-on experience in module- or system-level design in one or more phases including hardware design, fabrication, testing, validation and mass production
Scripting (e.g. Python, MATLAB, LabView or JMP) capability to enable data collection and analysis
Excellent written and verbal communication skills and proven teamwork and leadership skills

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Proficiency in COMSOL, SPICE or similar simulation and modeling tools is a plus
Experience with Touch or capacitive sensing technology is a plus
