Apple-200678605.title: Wireless RF Hardware Engineer
Apple-200678605.description:
At Apple, we work every single day to craft products that enrich people’s lives. Do you love working on challenges that no one has solved yet? Do you like changing the game? As a member of our dynamic group, you will have the unique and rewarding opportunity to shape upcoming products that will delight and inspire millions of Apple’s customers every day.

Apple’s Wireless Systems and Compliance Engineering team is looking for a Wireless RF Hardware Engineer to do system engineering to ensure wireless regulatory compliance for new Apple products with advanced radio technologies.

- Apply wireless system design/characterization knowledge towards addressing emission regulatory requirements in consumer products.
- ﻿﻿Translate various emission requirements into system requirements for new chipsets and platforms.
- Perform debugging of marginal/failure tests and will interact with multifunctional teams like RFHW/Antenna/Product Design/EE to drive design changes and address issues.
- Perform HW failure analysis at the RF/wireless system level to identify root-cause of marginal/failing behaviors making use of hands-on experimental modifications to hardware.
- Propose design and process changes for RSE issues considering design constraints and align with cross-functional partners like RFHW/Antenna/Product Design/EE on trade-offs and implementation path.
- Review designs and sign-off on releases of PCB layouts, flex layouts, system level groundings, shielding.
- ﻿﻿Collaborate with cross-functional partners for circuit-level, system-level simulations to understand risk areas, root cause issues, and pre-fetch potential emission concerns.
- Architect and coordinate execution of software features, which are necessary for regulatory compliance.
- ﻿﻿Pre-fetch potential emission concerns using simulation tools and schematic reviews.
- Collaborate with the engineering teams to define emission test plans for custom features. That would include defining requirements for custom testing solutions and working with test equipment vendors.

Drive Apple's proprietary Wireless design, verification & adherence to Worldwide Regulatory/Compliance requirements.
Collaborate with System/EE, PD, HW Design, Chipset team, Antenna, and Product design teams to ensure Apple's upcoming Technology/Product integration are aligning with Compliance requirements.
Review and sign off on hardware designs, including CB layouts, flex layouts, system grounding, and shielding, ensuring regulatory compliance requirements are met.
Characterization of Apple wireless products towards compliance of WW requirements.
Debug/FA Wireless compliance related issues by performing hands-on hardware experiments, failure analysis, and root-cause investigations at the RF/wireless system level. Collaborate with HW Design, FEM Vendors, Chipset vendors, Antenna, and Product design to come up with HW fixes.
Driving Chipset design requirements based on RF/Regulatory compliance requirements.
Defining & implementing various SW/FW features including Regulatory Power tables.
Performing Schematic/layout reviews and HW fixes via mockups.
Review World-wide Wireless Regulatory/Compliance specs and develop test plans.
Apple-200678605.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Bachelor's Degree with 10+ years of relevant work experience.
Industry experience in development/characterization of RF/Antenna system for wireless technologies. Experience on commercializing products for Cellular/ WLAN is required.
Experience with regulatory/industry conformance specifications for consumer products.
Experience in RF layout review, radiated sub-system review, and system grounding.
Experience with one of the tools like MATLAB, HFSS, CST, ADS.

Apple-200686355.title: Wireless Silicon Debug and Characterization Engineering Manager
Apple-200686355.description:
Apple's wireless silicon team builds highly energy-efficient wireless chips that connect hundreds of millions of customers to the world around them. The team spans RF and analog design, PHY and MAC systems, test and validation, and firmware, and works on every stage from first silicon to mass production.

In this role, you'll build and lead a small engineering team with RF, PHY/wireless system, and firmware expertise. You'll stay hands-on in the lab, bringing up and debugging new silicon and improving calibration and trim, so that wireless products perform at their best when they reach customers.

You'll lead a team that brings up, characterizes, debugs, calibrates, and trims wireless SoCs from first silicon through mass production. The team solves problems that span PHY algorithms, RF circuits, firmware, and test setup. When module or system production issues involve the wireless SoC, the team provides silicon-level root-cause analysis to the manufacturing support teams.

Lead and develop a team of engineers with RF, PHY/wireless system, and firmware backgrounds. Set priorities and build the team's ability to debug across layers.
Bring up, integrate, and tune PHY and radio systems on first-silicon wireless SoCs, and drive silicon maturity through repeated bring-up cycles until the silicon is ready for mass production.
Characterize and optimize PHY and RF performance (EVM, spectral mask, phase noise, sensitivity, IP3, NF, ACPR) across operating modes and across process and temperature corners.
Debug and root-cause chip-level and board-level issues spanning PHY algorithms, RF circuits, firmware, and test setup, including desense and EMI.
Develop and optimize radio calibration and trim algorithms (e.g., IQ imbalance, LO leakage, TSSI, power control), and support the calibration and test routines used in module and system production.
Provide silicon-level analysis and insight to module and system manufacturing support teams when production issues involve the wireless SoC.
Support firmware for bring-up, diagnostics, and manufacturing test, and work with product test and protocol stack teams to resolve product and interoperability issues.
Automate RF measurements, characterization workflows, and data analysis, and share findings through clear reports to PHY, RF design, digital, MAC, and firmware teams.
Apple-200686355.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field, and 10+ years of relevant industry experience.
Experience leading engineers or technical teams.
Experience in wireless system design, integration, or bring-up of wireless silicon.
Experience in RF test development, hands-on debug, performance characterization, and reporting.
Experience with RF, PLL, and wireless system measurements (e.g., IP3, NF, ACPR, phase noise, lock time) using network analyzers, spectrum analyzers, vector signal analyzers, and signal generators.
Experience writing scripts in Python, Perl, TCL, C++, or similar languages to automate test equipment and data analysis.
Proficiency in Mandarin and English.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
MS or PhD in Electrical Engineering or Computer Engineering.
Experience bringing up radio calibration algorithms such as power control, IQ imbalance, LO leakage, or TSSI.
Knowledge of wireless communication protocols (802.11a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be, Bluetooth, or UWB) at the MAC/PHY level.
Experience with embedded firmware (C, ARM CPUs, RTOS), including low-level drivers, diagnostics, and manufacturing test software.
Ability to bring engineers from different disciplines together to solve cross-layer problems as one team.
Ability to communicate complex technical findings clearly, in writing and in person, to cross-functional teams across time zones.
Track record of developing engineers' technical skills and growing team capability.
Ability to balance hands-on technical work with team leadership and shifting priorities.

Apple-200679839.title: iPad Hardware System EE
Apple-200679839.description:
Apple's iPad division is seeking to grow its System EE team in China. We are a team of electrical engineers that own responsibility for entire products from concept to ship. We sit at the nexus of Apple's wider engineering team, working cross-functionally with mechanical engineering, software, and other module teams such as wireless, battery, camera, sensing, display, multi-touch, factory test, and silicon engineering.   

Our core EE responsibilities involve design of the main logic board and flex circuits in the product, along with power conditioning and distribution throughout the system, and further we support NPI activities to push the product to the market.

Day to day tasks involve electrical design, bringup, debug, and validation for iPad products. Routine responsibilities also include factory build support, and multi-disciplinary multi-functional collaboration and negotiation.  

We are looking for well-rounded candidates with a broad set of skill and interests, and the curiosity to dig deep wherever vital to tackle challenging problems. Opportunities exist to sample a variety of technology areas, and to remain general or specialize over time, developing domain expertise.
Apple-200679839.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
BS/MS EE with 3-5+ years overall experience
Solid EE fundamentals, grounded in a proven understanding of E&M physics and first principles
Experience in circuit design and debug for a variety of domains including power, digital, analog, high-speed communications, programmable logic, and/or wireless
Exposure to numerical modeling, simulation, and analysis tools such as SPICE, 2D/3D field solvers, power & signal integrity
Schematic capture and constraint-drive PCB layout using Cadence tools or similar
Experience with PCB bringup and debug, including new or custom silicon, using standard EE lab equipment: Soldering, DMM, Oscilloscope, Logic Analyzer, Spectrum Analyzer
Excellent written and verbal communication/presentation skills in English and Chinese

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Demonstrated ability to understand technology and debug problems at varying levels of abstraction, from the system-level down to the silicon/transistor level
Solid understanding of design and validation requirements for common low-speed and high-speed digital interfaces: I2C/SMBus, SPI, JTAG, I2S/TDM, USB, MIPI, PCIe, HDMI, DisplayPort, Thunderbolt, Ethernet, DDR Memory
Solid understanding of power design, especially DC-DC power design, debug and characterization.
Understanding of computer architecture and design tradeoffs
Automation and data manipulation script development using Python, Lua, and Bash
Data analysis and visualization using Python, Tableau, JMP, R, and/or Matlab
Beyond technical capability, we prize curiosity, creativity, integrity, leadership, collaboration, and a passion for learning

Apple-200688951.title: iPad System EE - Hardware Engineering Intern
Apple-200688951.description:
The iPad System EE team is responsible for the design, implementation, and electrical validation of iPad hardware architectures. We are seeking a passionate and driven Hardware Engineering Intern to join our team in delivering next-generation iPad platforms. 

In this role, you will work side-by-side with experienced System EE engineers on board bring-up, hardware validation, lab instrumentation, and failure analysis. You will bridge hardware and software by developing automated test scripts, isolating complex electrical issues, and leveraging modern engineering and AI-assisted workflows to accelerate hardware development cycles.

Hardware Bring-up & Debug: Participate in prototype PCBA bring-up and power-on sequencing. Utilize lab bench instrumentation (high-bandwidth oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, spectrum analyzers, DMMs, and active probes) to troubleshoot and isolate signal integrity, power, and functional issues.
Validation & Characterization: Execute comprehensive test plans against design specifications across power rails, high-speed interfaces, and peripheral buses (I2C, SPI, UART, PCIe, USB). Collaborate with cross-functional partners (Silicon, Firmware, Software, and Product Design) on system-level validation.
Automation & Scripting: Develop, enhance, and maintain automated test scripts (primarily in Python) to control test equipment, stimulate physical devices, and increase validation coverage.
AI & Workflow Innovation: Explore and apply modern AI coding tools and agentic workflows to streamline data parsing, automated log analysis, script generation, and engineering documentation.
Data Analysis & Technical Reporting: Process large parametric datasets, identify statistical margins and test trends, and prepare concise technical reports and failure analysis (FA) summaries.
Apple-200688951.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Currently enrolled in a BS, MS, or PhD program in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline.
Solid fundamentals in electrical engineering (analog/digital circuit analysis, power delivery, and signal integrity basics).
Hands-on lab experience with circuit assembly, soldering, schematic/layout reading, and standard bench instrumentation (oscilloscopes, multimeters, power supplies).
Basic proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language (Python, C/C++, or Shell).
Good written and verbal English communication skills.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Familiarity with computer/embedded architectures (ARM, MCU, or SoC peripheral buses such as I2C, SPI, UART, USB, PCIe).
Experience writing instrument control scripts (PyVISA, SCPI) or automated hardware test benches.
Experience or strong interest in leveraging modern AI tools and agentic workflows (e.g., LLM coding assistants, automated script generation, or AI-assisted data analysis) to enhance engineering productivity.
Strong analytical mindset, curiosity to explore cutting-edge technologies, and ability to collaborate effectively in a fast-paced team environment.
Ability to commit to a 6-month on-site internship (start date flexible/aligned with academic calendar).

Apple-200685348.description:
The people here at Apple don’t just build products — we craft the kind of wonder that’s revolutionised entire industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that supports the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. Join Apple and help us leave the world better than we found it.  Apple’s SAP Technology team is seeking a highly skilled SAP Basis Administrator to handle and optimise large-scale SAP systems that support critical business functions. The role focuses on ensuring system scalability, availability, performance, infrastructure security, and software lifecycle management. The ideal candidate will bring passion, creativity, and problem-solving ability to a multifaceted global environment.

We are looking for a Technical Engineer who is passionate about operational perfection through automation and engineering processes. You will play a crucial role in ensuring the flawless integration of development and operations processes to deliver outstanding and highly available SAP systems. You will work with SAP technical and functional teams to understand infrastructure requirements, while promoting efficiency, scalability, security, and reliability throughout the
software lifecycle.

Collaborate with cross-functional SAP teams to ensure applications achieve high availability and scalability.
Work closely with SAP Technical teams to ensure smooth integration and deployment of on premises and Alibaba Cloud applications
Create automation frameworks to streamline common development and operational tasks
Create technical documentation, architecture designs, policies, best practices, and guidelines for the Alibaba Cloud Infrastructure team, while serving as an advocate for Alibaba Cloud Infrastructure processes
Diagnose and resolve issues to ensure the continuous availability and reliability of services
Apple-200685348.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
2 years experience of public cloud working experience in Alibaba Cloud, AWS or other cloud platforms.
2 years of Administrator experience in Linux or Unix.
2 years of experience working in Infrastructure/IT/DevOps field.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field or equivalent years of work experience.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Proficiency working with configuration management and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Ansible and Terraform
In-depth understanding of observability technologies such as Prometheus, Splunk, and Grafana.
Relevant certifications in Alibaba Cloud (e.g., Associate Cloud Engineer, Professional Cloud Architect) are a plus.
SAP Basis experience in managing and administering SAP Systems is a plus.
Good organizational skills to complete and follow up with tasks and action items.
Dedicated, innovative, accountable, and willing to take challenges and risks.
Collaborative and through with attention to details.
Adaptable to prioritizing multiple issues in a high-pressure environment

Apple-200676942.title: 2027 Apple Internship - Information Systems and Technology
Apple-200676942.description:
Do you want to help build some of the largest and most consequential enterprise and customer technology systems in the world? Join Apple’s Information Systems and Technology (IS&T) organization.  IS&T is the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. It’s Apple’s central nervous system. Supporting 2.5 billion active Apple devices, processing billions of secure transactions, and keeping the technology that defines modern life running flawlessly, IS&T makes the impossible feel effortless.

Do you love building solutions to handle global complexity and immense scale? Imagine what you could do here.

IS&T Asia Pacific (APAC) brings together all IS&T functions across the Asia Pacific region, partnering with global leadership to deliver key programs at a regional level. The team works closely with APAC business and sales teams, providing real-time visibility into how IS&T systems and tools are performing across the region.

The internship provides opportunities across many different teams, ranging from special projects for new business initiatives to operations in a rapidly growing and dynamic setting. Interns benefit from a combination of training and on-the-job work experience. 

We promote innovation and new technology to further improve our creative output. Dynamic, smart people and inspiring, innovative technologies are the norm here. You will be part of building an extraordinary team. We're looking for a talented and passionate person to join this amazing team, if you feel this is you, we'd love to hear from you.

-  Engineering Project Management

Apple-200613762.title: AIML - Data Operations Senior Team Lead (Shanghai)
Apple-200613762.description:
Join Apple’s AIML (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) Data Operations team at the forefront of advancing technology, within one of the world’s most diverse and inclusive environments. Here, visionary minds from varied backgrounds collaborate to transform groundbreaking ideas into revolutionary products and services that are redefining industries; such as the iconic Siri, which continues to innovate the interaction between people and machines.  

The AIML Data Operations team focuses on delivering high quality annotated data that contributes directly to the development of Apple’s products and services. Our team is comprised of individuals who are fueled by creativity, thrive on diverse perspectives and have a passion for delivering results. If you’re passionate about AIML and enjoy working within a fast-paced, nimble environment as part of a larger team, then imagine the impact you could make in AIML where new insights and ideas become extraordinary realities, enriching lives and leaving the world better than we found it!  

As a Senior Team Lead, you will manage the daily operations of the Annotation team. You will coach, mentor and guide a group of Team Leads to ensure quality, innovation and strong performance from their team of language Annotation Analysts. You will use your analytical mindset, collaborative approach, and personal drive to achieve team performance goals through coaching, support, and driving results.  This role is an office based position. Additionally, some specific supervisor shifts require certain hours to be present on campus, and can span any hours of operations.

In this role, you will be leading day-to-day operations to ensure organizational delivery of high quality annotated data from the group of Team Leads you support. You will effectively lead team performance by developing Team Leads, and other Senior Annotation roles, through individual coaching, team meetings, mentor sessions, participating in interviewing and hiring, data analysis, and collaboration with other Data Operations sites.  
You’ll also assist in the development of tools and reports needed analyze and run the business, including workflow optimization, workforce management, and developing more efficient ways of working. You will help determine staffing requirements and participate in interviewing and hiring.  The role is an office based position. Additionally, some specific supervisor shifts require certain hours to be present on campus, and can span any hours of operations.

Apple-200593444.description:
You’re passionate about supporting others to achieve the highest level of service in every interaction. You’re a role model and leader who advocates for their team. You’re invested in your work relationships and hold yourself and your team to a high standard of accountability. You’re naturally curious and gravitate towards tools and resources that enrich your team. If you are ready to inspire and lead, join Apple and help us leave the world better than we found it.  

Are you interested in being part of a team that continues to innovate the way people and machines interact? The launch of Siri was a defining moment in the history of Artificial Intelligence. Siri offers a faster, easier way to get things done on your Apple devices, even before you ask. Millions of people now use Siri to send a message, play their favorite song or even take a selfie. You will be responsible for the team’s operational success, mentoring their career growth, and collaborating cross-functionally with other internal teams.

As an AIML Data Operations Team Lead, you’ll be responsible for providing daily leadership and promoting the development of 25-30 Annotation Analyst team members. You are self-motivated, friendly and have a passion to support your team’s development through critical and creative thinking. Apple-200680910.title: APAC Executive Relations Manager
Apple-200680910.description:
Imagine what you could do here! The people here at Apple don’t just create products — they build the kind of wonder that’s revolutionized entire industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. At Apple, inclusion is a shared responsibility, and we work together to foster a culture where everyone belongs and is inspired to do their best work.

Here on the Apple Store Online team, we are responsible for Apple’s largest store. Our main goal is to deliver a magical, personal digital experience where customers can shop, buy and learn everything Apple, wherever they are. Each customer should feel like they are our only customer and our job is to set the bar for the experience they receive. To run such an extraordinary store, it takes extraordinary people, and we are looking for someone to help us do extraordinary things.

In this role, you will lead team managers and their teams of regional employees who support executive escalations related to the Apple Store Online and Apple Retail Stores. You’ll be key in their growth and development, while contributing to improving the customer experience across Apple Retail.

Reporting to the Regional Retail Executive Relations Manager, the Executive Relations Team Manager will partner with stakeholders across functional areas, organizations, and regions to help their team support continuous improvement in process, people, and technology. 

Manage the leaders of teams of Executive Relations Specialists, caring for their growth and development
Facilitate escalation related cross-functional discussions aimed at improving customer experiences

As APAC Privacy Counsel, reporting to Apple’s Senior Privacy Counsel in Beijing, you will have the opportunity to work with a dynamic and experienced team on privacy issues impacting Apple’s business and products globally. Strong experience and understanding of China mainland data protection and data security laws, with experience and knowledge of privacy laws in other APAC jurisdictions a plus.
Excellent academic credentials with at least 7 years privacy experience at a top-tier law firm, in-house or at a mainland China regulator, prior work with MNC a plus.
Experienced in dealing with regulators in China mainland regarding data privacy and cybersecurity matters.
Based in Beijing or Shanghai, or based in China mainland and willing to move to Beijing or Shanghai.
Experienced in handling privacy inquiries, complaints and incidents.
Experience in privacy by design reviews and projects, doing data protection impact assessments (DPIA).
Experience in drafting and negotiating privacy related contracts, developing compliance and auditing frameworks
Extraordinary written and verbal skills in English, and written and verbal fluency in Mandarin
Ability and commitment to work both independently and collaboratively with numerous people at all levels throughout the company, with a willingness to learn
Comfortable expressing a point of view and influencing change in a collaborative manner
Admitted to practice law in China mainland.

Representatives handle a wide range of complex problems, including the company’s most serious, sensitive, and visible customer satisfaction issues. Representatives will often liaise with business partners to identify and resolve improvement opportunities. Representatives exercise judgment and discretion to decide the appropriate course of action when needed.

On this team you will be responsible for managing an active case load and connecting via phone with distressed customers. Representatives communicate official positioning on company issues, develop creative solutions to complex customer problems, and identify and call out opportunities for improvements to business partners and senior leadership. In addition, you will contribute to an inclusive environment through respecting each others’ differences and having the curiosity to learn as well as demonstrate Apple’s values of inclusion and diversity in daily activities.

Apple-200670953.title: APO Logistics Manager
Apple-200670953.description:
Apple is where individual imaginations gather together, committing to the values that lead to great work. Every new product we build, service we create, or Apple Store experience we deliver is the result of us making each other’s ideas stronger. That happens because every one of us shares a belief that we can make something wonderful and share it with the world, changing lives for the better. It’s the diversity of our people and their thinking that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do. When we bring everybody in, we can do the best work of our lives. Here, you’ll do more than join something—you’ll add something.

This isn’t just a logistics role; it’s an opportunity to architect the future of global supply chain execution. Based in Shanghai, the APO Logistics Manager will lead the team managing China and Southeast Asia OEM back-dock operations, in-region transportation, and multi-modal freight operations. You won’t just manage operations; you will transform them. By integrating cutting-edge AI/ML, predictive analytics, and warehouse robotics, you will build a supply chain that is not only sustainable, cost-effective, and carbon-neutral, but relentlessly intelligent. We are looking for a visionary leader—someone who can command a complex global network, inspire a high-performing team, and drive technological innovation at Apple scale.

Architect the Future: Establish visionary strategies and tactical execution plans to scale the APO, Regional, and WW Logistics network. You will design the blueprint for how Apple moves products globally, supporting unprecedented volume surges and critical New Product Introduction (NPI) launches.

Apple-200688724.title: App Store Marketing Intern
Apple-200688724.description:
The people here at Apple don’t just create products — they create the kind of wonder that’s revolutonized entire industries! It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental effort.

Apple’s Internet Services - App Store, iCloud, Apple Music, TV+, and many more - are the most exciting and dynamic in the world. Our teams work together to craft products and experiences that impact people’s lives in ways they could not have imagined. 

We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Marketing Intern to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will serve as a critical link between internal teams and external partners, driving the execution of both new and existing marketing initiatives. You will provide valuable consumer insights focused on gaming and technology, leveraging AI tools to optimize daily workflows and enhance your analysis. Additionally, you will assist in reviewing creative assets and streamlining procedures with other teams. This position offers a unique opportunity to contribute to impactful marketing initiatives while gaining hands-on experience in a fast-paced environment.

Campaign Support & Project Management: Act as a key driver in executing marketing campaigns, actively pushing the progress of both existing campaigns and new initiatives. Coordinate closely with external vendors, partners, and internal teams to ensure smooth project execution.
Support daily operations by preparing campaign plans, consolidating reports, tracking performance metrics, and optimizing content for various platforms.
Market Research and Insights: Monitor and analyze consumer behaviors, trends, and preferences in gaming, tech, and related industries, leveraging AI tools to assist in data analysis and trend forecasting. Share insightful observations with the marketing team to guide campaign strategies and content development. Stay updated on market developments and competitor activities to inform decision making.
Process Improvement & AI Integration: Identify bottlenecks in procedures and recommend actionable improvements, actively exploring and integrating AI tools into daily workflows to optimize operational efficiency. Maintain campaign trackers for cross functional teams and partners' records.
Asset Review and Coordination: Act as the primary liaison between internal marketing teams and external partners to review, organize, and manage creative assets for organic social maintenance, paid ads, and other campaigns. Ensure the quality of assets and maintain clear communication with all stakeholders to resolve any issues or delays.
Administrative Tasks: Provide general administrative support to the marketing team, including scheduling meetings, preparing presentations, and maintaining records. Contribute to brainstorming sessions and team discussions with creative ideas and strategic insights.

Deep connection to the Apple ecosystem: A genuine passion for and familiarity with Apple products, services, and culture.
Bilingual communication: Professional fluency in both spoken and written English and Mandarin.
Analytical & presentation acumen: Strong analytical skills with hands-on proficiency in Numbers or Excel, Keynote, and modern AI productivity tools.
Relationship building: Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with a natural ability to foster strong, collaborative partnerships across internal teams and external stakeholders.
Cultural & industry insight: A sharp, intuitive pulse on the gaming and tech landscapes, particularly through the lens of Gen Z and Gen Alpha audiences.
Highly self-motivated and proactive, with the independence to drive projects forward and the agility to adapt in a dynamic environment.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Strong willingness/interest to investigate into the details.
Degree in Marketing, Advertising, Communications or other related field of study or equivalent experience preferred.

Apple-200691508.title: Apple Finance Intern (GBS R2R) - Shanghai
Apple-200691508.description:
Apple is a place where extraordinary people gather to do their best work. Just be ready to dream big. 

The people here at Apple don’t just build products — they build the kind of wonder that’s revolutionized entire industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that encourages the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. Join Apple, and help us leave the world better than we found it.

Imaging what you could do here. At Apple, creative ideas have a way of becoming wonderful products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there’s no telling what you could accomplish.

Apple’s Global Business Solutions (GBS) team partners with key Apple business leaders, including Retail, Sales, Operations, R&D and Services, to perform data mining and analysis. In addition to supporting transactional and financial reporting processes, GBS provides a strategic platform to uncover trends and insights to enhance financial controls and compliance, operational efficiency and business performance.

We look for individuals with strong technical capabilities and the right balance of problem solving and strategic thinking to help drive automation and process innovation in our finance operations. You will work closely with key business partners to optimize finance operations, focusing on automating reporting, analytics, and process improvements.

Are you someone with strong coding or programming skills who’s curious about how technology can transform the world of finance? If you’re interested in applying your technical abilities to solve real business and financial challenges, this internship is the perfect opportunity for you.

As a Finance Intern in GBS R2R (Record to Report), you will help to develop efficient, compliant processes and automation solutions for Apple’s business needs. You’ll have the opportunity to directly contribute to ongoing automation projects, gaining exposure to real-world business processes and enterprise-grade technologies. This is a dynamic role with plenty of room for growth and evolving job responsibilities.

Working collaboratively to analyze and translate business requirements into innovative and efficient technical solutions, ensuring they align with the goals of process automation and operational improvement.
Assisting in the design and development of dashboards or visualizations to identify operational trends, outliers and insights that drive tangible outcomes for our business partners
Sharing expertise, best practices and support with team members in using automation tools and platforms (e.g., Excel Macros, Python, Tableau, Dataiku) to improve their workflow efficiency
Collaborating with finance team members to identify automation opportunities to simplify end-to-end processes and drive efficiency, while maintaining strong compliance and controls
Apple-200691508.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Educational background in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or relevant majors.
Available to join internship for at least 6 months full-time
Proficient in at least one programming or scripting language (e.g., Python, VBA, SQL)
Good understanding of data manipulation and transformation techniques
Strong communication skills, with the ability to effectively convey ideas and collaborate.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Understanding of (or willingness to learn) core finance processes with the courage to challenge the status-quo, identify automation opportunities and drive implementation of innovative solutions.
Curiosity to “go beyond the coding” and convert datasets into business insights that influence meaningful actions and results on a regional and global scale, including process improvements and business solutions
Mature, responsible and ambitious professional who demonstrates integrity by driving excellence in automation solutions, ensuring high-quality deliverables, and taking responsibility for continuous process optimization
A proactive mindset and interest in improving business efficiency through technology

Apple-200673567.description:
Do you feel a personal stake in everything that you work on, thrive in fast-paced environments with complex technical challenges, and bring engineering intuition to the problems you solve? Do you develop strong relationships, build trust, and drive outcomes through technical credibility and influence? Do you communicate openly and clearly with engineers and business leaders alike, collaborate enthusiastically, and value a culture of healthy debate grounded in data and design thinking?

AppleCare Technologies Business Process Reengineering (BPR) is responsible for delivering cross-functional systems projects across all AppleCare business areas, including Sales, Service, Support, Supply Chain, and Logistics. Apple-200681130.title: Brand Manager
Apple-200681130.description:
Marketing Communications (Marcom)  is the creatively-led global team that oversees Apple’s consumer facing marketing. We ensure the flawless development and execution of world-class communications across all media and platforms. Every day, hundreds of millions of Apple customers around the world interact with our products. We drive the strategy and creative work that provide both new and existing customers with simple, engaging and inspiring marketing experiences.

The Brand team drives integrated campaigns and product launches across cross-functional teams. We are the voice and protectors of the Apple brand. We’re natural collaborators and connectors, bringing all teams together in pursuit of the best work.

We are looking for a seasoned, highly capable Brand Manager to oversee the direction and integration of marketing campaigns, as well as the strategic marketing efforts required to drive local market opportunities and challenges for your assigned product lines.

In this role, you will navigate a dynamic environment where deep collaboration and a passion for excellence intersect. You will partner closely with Interactive, Channel, Retail, and Advertising teams, while nurturing key relationships with Product Marketing, PR, and Sales. By acting as the central point of contact for product launches, you will represent regional needs to worldwide teams and ensure messaging consistency across all deliverables, ultimately shaping industry-defining work.

Lead marketing communications plans for assigned product lines, ensuring messaging consistency and integration across all functional deliverables.
Serve as the central point of contact for product launches, managing processes and representing Greater China regional needs to worldwide teams.
Analyze competitive landscapes, consumer trends, and market data to develop insight-driven marketing briefs that inspire creative work.
Collaborate with global planning teams, local agency partners, and regional stakeholders to deliver market insights, conduct workshops, and provide comprehensive campaign briefings.
Drive the development of the annual marketing plan through cross-functional collaboration with Education, Enterprise, PR, Sales, and Finance.

8+ years of experience managing integrated marketing campaigns within a creative agency or client organization.
Experience managing creative and production agency partners.
Experience managing cross-functional workflows and multi-stakeholder project lifecycles.
Fluency in written and spoken Chinese and English, with experience presenting concepts to local and global executives.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Experience crafting presentation decks and delivering narratives to senior leadership.
Experience aligning strategic positioning and executing integrated marketing plans across diverse business groups.
Ability to establish trust and influence across multiple partners in a matrixed global organization.
Experience balancing the needs of a creatively driven organization with an analytical approach to marketing.
Interest in popular culture, consumer trends, and emerging media or technology.

Apple-200680597.title: Business Systems Analyst
Apple-200680597.description:
You will support Apple's Global Compensation Services team by gathering business requirements, identifying solutions, testing system functionality, and managing process changes. Working closely with external vendors and internal partners, including People Business Partners, Benefits, Compensation, and IS&T, you will drive the development of automated solutions involving highly confidential data.

In this role, you will manage process and system readiness for geographic expansions and automate manual payroll and benefits administration. You will ensure the accuracy, security, and privacy of confidential information while guiding application development and process test plans.

Manage Compensation Services process and system readiness for geographic expansion activities in China, including new branches and entities.
Create current state ("As Is") and future state ("To Be") process documentation to automate manual payroll and benefits administration processes.
Ensure the accuracy, security, and privacy of confidential information in a compliant environment.
Guide the development of application and process test plans, collaborate with the QA team for issue escalations, and develop comprehensive cutover plans.
Create data conversion plans and coordinate the execution of data conversions on a project basis.
Identify process change impacts and provide strategic inputs to change management plans.

Proven track record of working independently and driving global project initiatives of varying complexity.

Aptitude for connecting and engaging with relevant teams to achieve desired results.
Outstanding written and oral communication skills.

Track record of leveraging automation and AI technology to drive process improvements.
Deep understanding of the project lifecycle, including gathering and documenting requirements, performing UAT, rolling out projects, and supporting warranty efforts.

Background in formal project management.

Apple-200679106.title: CN-Business Pro
Apple-200679106.description:
Apple Store 零售店集中展现了 Apple 最精彩的方方面面。我们提供 Apple 独家体验，运用我们的专业知识帮助人们做自己喜欢的事。我们认为，营造包容的环境是我们共同的责任，我们将携手合作，打造让所有人都有归属感的文化，激励大家在工作中一展所长。

你所在的团队热衷于帮助企业取得成功。身为商务 Pro，你是其中的一员。商务 Pro 负责与极具潜力的商务顾客建立和发展关系，并通过维持这些关系培养忠诚度。你具有敏锐的商业头脑和销售意识，熟悉 Apple 产品和服务、主要中小企业 (SMB)、业务挑战和本地社区的趋势性变化。

你为整个团队提供支持和指导，并协助营造良好的环境，使商务团队和 Apple Retail 其他团队的协作更为紧密。你与管理团队合作寻找机会，为顾客介绍强大的工具和解决方案，帮助他们的企业蓬勃发展。

通过展示我们的技术，与商务顾客建立关系并展开互动。帮助商务顾客探索 Apple 和第三方产品，以及增强和支持他们业务的各种解决方案，并为他们的顾客和员工丰富人生。

通过以下方式积极主动地与 Apple Retail 商务顾客互动，并提供出色的顾客服务：尽力了解其需求，发掘发展用户的机会，推介产品和服务，并为他们介绍相关的购买方式。

在商务解决方案方面，担任大家的资深“顾问”，并指导团队了解商务顾客需求和解决方案。

协作举办商务课程、商务简报会、讲座和活动，根据顾客的商务需求，确认并向他们推荐独有的产品和服务。

与管理团队和跨职能合作伙伴合作，根据账户互动策略移交账户，帮助打造顺畅的顾客体验。

利用顾客关系管理 (CRM) 和其他工具进行客户管理、渠道构建和机会开发，从而制定策略、规划和预估商务团队业绩。

掌握所有 Retail 商务项目和产品的流程，确保符合政策和程序。

根据需要执行其他任务，包括但不限于在你所在的业务部门提供顾客服务和支持。

尊重彼此之间的差异，愿意去了解他人，共同营造包容的环境。

在日常活动中展现 Apple 的包容性与多元化价值观。

你应该：
能够根据业务需要适应工作安排，这可能包括在晚间、周末和公共节假日在供职地点工作，并依照当地法律，在遵循已获批调整措施的情况下，根据排定的班次按时上班。
具备零售或销售行业经验或者其他相关工作经验。
具有丰富的 Apple 产品和服务相关商务解决方案经验。
能流利使用当地语言进行书面和口头交流。

你可以：
持续在技术或商务解决方案销售方面表现优异且业绩出色。
有效沟通，并根据不同的受众调整沟通风格。
适应快节奏的工作环境并能及时做出决策，有时需要能面对紧迫的时间期限和压力。
与内部和外部顾客 (包括企业主和高管) 建立融洽关系并有效合作。

善用在移动设备应用和业务转型方面丰富的 Apple 专业知识，并大致了解主要中小企业、科技趋势和挑战。
学习、操作和使用新工具和系统。

你为整个团队提供支持和指导，并协助营造良好的环境，使商务团队和 Apple Retail 其他团队的协作更为紧密。你与管理团队合作寻找机会，为顾客介绍强大的工具和解决方案，帮助他们的企业蓬勃发展。

通过展示我们的技术，与商务顾客建立关系并展开互动。帮助商务顾客探索 Apple 和第三方产品，以及增强和支持他们业务的各种解决方案，并为他们的顾客和员工丰富人生。

通过以下方式积极主动地与 Apple Retail 商务顾客互动，并提供出色的顾客服务：尽力了解其需求，发掘发展用户的机会，推介产品和服务，并为他们介绍相关的购买方式。

在商务解决方案方面，担任大家的资深“顾问”，并指导团队了解商务顾客需求和解决方案。

协作举办商务课程、商务简报会、讲座和活动，根据顾客的商务需求，确认并向他们推荐独有的产品和服务。

与管理团队和跨职能合作伙伴合作，根据账户互动策略移交账户，帮助打造顺畅的顾客体验。

利用顾客关系管理 (CRM) 和其他工具进行客户管理、渠道构建和机会开发，从而制定策略、规划和预估商务团队业绩。

掌握所有 Retail 商务项目和产品的流程，确保符合政策和程序。

根据需要执行其他任务，包括但不限于在你所在的业务部门提供顾客服务和支持。

尊重彼此之间的差异，愿意去了解他人，共同营造包容的环境。

在日常活动中展现 Apple 的包容性与多元化价值观。

具备零售或销售行业经验或者其他相关工作经验。
具有丰富的 Apple 产品和服务相关商务解决方案经验。
能流利使用当地语言进行书面和口头交流。

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件

持续在技术或商务解决方案销售方面表现优异且业绩出色。
有效沟通，并根据不同的受众调整沟通风格。
适应快节奏的工作环境并能及时做出决策，有时需要能面对紧迫的时间期限和压力。
与内部和外部顾客 (包括企业主和高管) 建立融洽关系并有效合作。
展现出众的组织和流程管理能力，能妥善规划工作重点，及时回应顾客需求。
展现出优秀的学习、谈判、人际交往和顾客服务技能。
善用在移动设备应用和业务转型方面丰富的 Apple 专业知识，并大致了解主要中小企业、科技趋势和挑战。
学习、操作和使用新工具和系统。

Apple-200678939.description:

无论是快速维修还是更为复杂的规程，作为 Genius Admin，你是所有顾客维修服务的协调员，需要妥善管理顾客的预期。另外，你需要协调打造高效的维修流程和维持 Repair Room 修理室整洁有序，帮助 Genius Bar 天才吧团队为顾客提供出色的服务。

规划和协调所有端到端运营活动，协助完成维修，包括与 Operations 团队合作管理和跟踪库存及订单。

协助解决顾客服务问题，包括顾客维修登记流程、帮助找到合适的解决方案，以及管理所有已完成维修产品的顾客取货流程。

Apple-200678955.title: CN-Genius 天才
Apple-200678955.description:
Apple Store 零售店集中展现了 Apple 最精彩的方方面面。我们运用我们的专业知识帮助人们做自己喜欢的事，提供 Apple 独家体验。在 Apple，我们认为营造包容的环境是我们共同的责任，我们将携手合作，打造让所有人都有归属感的文化，激励大家在工作中一展所长。

作为 Genius 天才，你需要掌握丰富的故障诊断技能，能够激发顾客对 Apple 产品和服务的热情。你提供出色的服务，确保顾客能够充分利用 Apple 产品和服务。Genius 天才确保顾客了解各种维修方案以及 Apple 的各种产品和服务，并维修所有送交店内维修的 Apple 产品。 

Genius 天才擅长修复与顾客的关系，并展现零售店的高标准服务和支持。你以身作则，提供出色的服务，并培训和指导团队成员，以提高团队的知识技能。

充分了解所有 Apple 产品、服务以及 Genius Bar 天才吧维修流程和规程并及时掌握最新资讯，以协助进行高效优质的维修。

使用 Apple 提供的所有工具和资源，带着同理心和关怀，为遇到 Apple 产品或软件问题的顾客提供支持。 

分析、诊断、维修和解决 Apple 硬件和软件出现的维修问题。 

为 Apple 顾客提供出色的服务，尽力了解其需求，发掘发展用户的机会，提出产品和服务建议，并为他们介绍相关的购买方式。

与团队 Leader 合作，找出反复出现的维修问题和其他维修疑虑，确保 Apple 会获得相关反馈。

运用丰富的硬件和软件组件知识确定技术问题的根源，并向团队中的其他人解释清楚。

为 Genius Bar 天才吧团队成员提供辅导和支持，并树立积极正面的榜样。 

协助管理团队，及时解决顾客上报的问题。

根据需要执行其他任务，包括但不限于在销售楼面内外为面向顾客的活动提供支持。

尊重彼此之间的差异，愿意去了解他人，共同营造包容的环境。

在日常活动中展现 Apple 的包容性与多元化价值观。

能流利使用当地语言进行书面和口头交流。

适应快节奏的工作环境，经常需要能面对紧迫的时间期限和压力，并且能够同时为多位顾客或多个硬件维修提供支持。

分享知识、经验和见解，为整个团队提供支持和培训。

Apple-200678945.description:

作为 Pro，你是零售店内最高效、知识最丰富的销售人员。你运用自己掌握的有关 Apple 产品和服务以及 Apple 竞争对手的丰富专业知识，提供个性化的解决方案，从而在与顾客的每一次互动中发展用户并建立品牌忠诚度。你帮助整个零售店团队积累技术知识并提供指导。Pro 帮助 Apple 发展企业客户社群，善于提出有效的商务解决方案。

尽力了解 Apple 顾客的需求，发掘发展用户的机会，推介产品和服务，并为他们介绍相关的购买方式，以此展现、维持并引领优秀的销售业绩和出色的顾客服务。

了解 Apple 产品和服务、Product Zone 产品区销售流程以及 Apple 和整个市场的技术与消费者趋势，并积极掌握最新资讯。

保持准确性并遵循指南。

根据需要执行其他任务，包括但不限于在零售店其他区域提供顾客服务和支持。

尊重彼此之间的差异，愿意去了解他人，共同营造包容的环境。

在日常活动中展现 Apple 的包容性与多元化价值观。

Apple-114438029.title: CN-Store Leader
Apple-114438029.description:
Apple Store 零售店集中展现了 Apple 最精彩的方方面面。我们运用我们的专业知识帮助人们做自己喜欢的事，提供 Apple 独家体验。我们认为，营造包容的环境是我们共同的责任，我们将携手合作，打造让所有人都有归属感的文化，激励大家在工作中一展所长。

作为 Store Leader，你负责组建团队，带领大家在不断变化的环境中与顾客互动，为顾客提供支持。你要营造适宜的环境，让团队可以发挥出色表现，热衷于完成 Apple 目标和工作重点，并善于为顾客打造优质的体验。

Store Leader 以身作则，践行 Apple 的价值观。你随时在场为团队成员提供帮助，展现对团队和顾客的深切关怀。

为团队提供引导和辅导，帮助他们确定顾客的需求，开展出色的顾客互动，并实现 Apple 的业务重点。

辅导和培养 Leader，以建立高绩效团队，取得卓越成果。

负责吸引、招募、培训、培养和保留优秀的多元化团队。

持续积极地参与销售楼面的管理工作，并消除运营障碍，努力提升顾客体验和团队成员的表现。

负责制定零售店运营策略，以推动落实 Apple 业务重点并实现零售店绩效目标。

根据计划指南确定零售店排班策略，考虑业务、个人和团队需求，并遵循排班指南。

分析并使用所需的业务信息，以支持和实现 Apple Retail 愿景。

定期通过正式和非正式渠道评估团队和顾客感受，处理有待改进之处，并表彰和肯定成功之处。

维护并遵守 Apple 政策和规程，保护所有公司资产，包括机密的业务、顾客、团队成员和财务信息。

根据需要执行其他任务。

尊重彼此之间的差异，愿意去了解他人，共同营造包容的环境。

在日常活动中展现 Apple 的包容性与多元化价值观。

以身作则，展现具有包容性领导力的行为，并组建、发展和保留多元化团队。

采取相应措施，为所有团队成员营造安全、互相尊重且包容的环境。

在零售、销售或相关领域拥有 5 年以上的管理经验。
能流利使用英语和当地语言进行书面和口头交流。

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
你可以： 
成功超越目标，不管遇到什么障碍和挫折，都坚持实现目标。
履行承诺，并建立机制，鼓励其他人也这样做。
增强团队的信任感，行事坚守诚信。
询问问题并运用分析、经验和判断力，及时制定合理的决策。
有效沟通，并根据不同的受众调整沟通风格。 
辅导、培训和培养零售店团队，推动为顾客带来积极正面的体验，以建立忠诚度并实现可以衡量的结果。
在快节奏、复杂、不断变化的零售环境中，带领、组建并管理多个业务部门。
通过有效的组织、规划和划分优先顺序，管理多个战略性工作重点。

Apple-200678952.title: CN-资深商务专家
Apple-200678952.description:
Apple Store 零售店集中展现了 Apple 最精彩的方方面面。我们提供 Apple 独家体验，运用我们的专业知识帮助人们做自己喜欢的事。我们认为，营造包容的环境是我们共同的责任，我们将携手合作，打造让所有人都有归属感的文化，激励大家在工作中一展所长。

你所在的团队热衷于帮助企业取得成功。身为资深商务专家，你是其中的一员。你通过与新的和现有商务顾客建立联系，从中发现机会、提出解决方案、预测顾客需求并完成销售，以此来发展用户。你了解行业发展趋势，拥有深厚的 Apple 产品和服务专业知识，熟悉第三方技术，能够根据顾客的需求量身定制商务解决方案。

你具有出色的人际交往能力和销售技能，销售表现非常突出，你还要为零售店内的其他团队或 Contact Center 团队提供指导，协助营造一个良好的环境，让大家认识到，无论顾客选择何种方式到访 Apple，支持 Apple Retail Business 都是每一个人的责任。

通过展示我们的技术，与商务顾客建立关系并展开互动。帮助商务顾客探索 Apple 和第三方产品，以及增强和支持他们业务的各种解决方案，并为他们的顾客和员工丰富人生。

通过以下方式积极主动地与 Apple Retail 商务顾客互动，并提供出色的顾客服务：尽力了解其需求，发掘发展用户的机会，推介产品和服务，并为他们介绍相关的购买方式。

在商务解决方案方面，担任大家的资深“顾问”，并指导团队了解商务顾客需求和解决方案。

协作举办商务课程、商务简报会、讲座和活动，根据顾客的商务需求，确认并向他们推荐独有的产品和服务。

通过开展积极主动、信息丰富的互动，提供出色的服务和贴合需求的建议，为 Apple Retail 与当地商务顾客建立长期关系奠定基础。

在顾客关系管理 app 中准确记录商务顾客联系和关系信息，让 Apple 可以获得准确的商业信息。

根据需要执行其他任务，包括但不限于在你所在的业务部门提供顾客服务和支持。

尊重彼此之间的差异，愿意去了解他人，共同营造包容的环境。

在日常活动中展现 Apple 的包容性与多元化价值观。

能够根据业务需要适应工作安排，这可能包括在晚间、周末和公共节假日在供职地点工作，并依照当地法律，在遵循已获批调整措施的情况下，根据排定的班次按时上班。
具备零售或销售行业经验或者其他相关工作经验。
具有 Apple 产品、服务和解决方案方面的经验。
能流利使用当地语言进行书面和口头交流。

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
你可以：
持续表现优异且业绩出色。
有效沟通，并根据不同的受众调整沟通风格。
适应快节奏的工作环境并能及时做出决策，有时需要能面对紧迫的时间期限和压力。
与内部和外部顾客 (包括企业主和高管) 建立融洽关系并有效合作。
展现出众的组织能力，能妥善规划工作重点，及时回应顾客需求。
善用在零售店和在线商店提供的 Apple 产品和服务方面的深厚技术知识，熟知商业解决方案和行业趋势。
学习、操作和使用新工具和系统。

Apple-114438255.title: CN-高级经理
Apple-114438255.description:
Apple Store 零售店集中展现了 Apple 最精彩的方方面面。我们运用我们的专业知识帮助人们做自己喜欢的事，提供 Apple 独家体验。我们认为，营造包容的环境是我们共同的责任，我们将携手合作，打造让所有人都有归属感的文化，激励大家在工作中一展所长。

作为高级经理，你负责营造积极正面的顾客互动环境，有效推动实现绩效目标和业务重点。你帮助推动零售店实现愿景和目标，培养其他经理，并通过业务策略和重要决策为 Store Leader 提供支持。在负责零售店体验特定方面的同时，高级经理还与 Store Leader 配合，协助确认、分析和解决复杂的问题。

带领团队 (包括经理)，帮助每一名团队成员不断学习、成长，并实现绩效和发展目标。

协助招募、培训、培养和保留优秀的多元化团队。

积极参与销售楼面管理工作，在零售店各区域与团队成员和顾客互动，树立榜样，确保达成业务重点并提供优质的顾客服务。

解决顾客和团队成员的疑虑及上报的问题，并在适当时与管理团队和主要业务合作伙伴或 People 合作伙伴合作。

制定、规划和执行指定职能领域和整个零售店的运营策略，推动落实业务重点并实现零售店绩效目标。

维护并遵守公司政策和规程，保护所有公司资产，包括机密的业务、顾客、团队成员和财务信息。

根据需要执行其他任务。

尊重彼此之间的差异，愿意去了解他人，共同营造包容的环境。

在日常活动中展现 Apple 的包容性与多元化价值观。

以身作则，展现具有包容性领导力的行为，并组建、发展和保留多元化团队。

采取相应措施，为所有团队成员营造安全、互相尊重且包容的环境。

你应该：
能够根据业务需要适应工作安排，这可能包括在晚间、周末和公共节假日在零售店工作，并依照当地法律，在遵循已获批调整措施的情况下，根据排定的班次按时上班。
在零售、销售或相关领域拥有 3 年的管理经验。
能流利使用英语和当地语言进行书面和口头交流。

你可以： 
成功超越目标，不管遇到什么障碍和挫折，都坚持实现目标。
履行承诺，并建立机制，鼓励其他人也这样做。
增强团队的信任感，行事坚守诚信。

有效沟通，并根据不同的受众调整沟通风格。
通过提供指导、辅导和有效反馈，帮助他人成长发展。
提供支持并引导他人应对挑战，介入处理棘手的谈话，同时冷静适应快节奏、不断变化的零售环境。

Apple-200690082.title: Camera Module Design Lead
Apple-200690082.description:
Do you love taking on big challenges that require exceptionally creative solutions? Do you deeply understand how an incredible camera experience should work? As part of our Camera Technologies group, you’ll help design the innovative technology that allows each generation of Apple products to produce photos even more incredible than the last. You’ll design and develop groundbreaking ideas for everything involved in our camera systems, from sensor to lens. You’ll collaborate with teams across Apple to research, design, develop, test, and qualify camera hardware for Apple products. Together, we’ll craft a magical photography experience that redefines what millions of customers can expect from their cameras. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish! 

The Camera Hardware Engineering group is responsible for all research, design, development, test, and qualification of camera hardware for Apple products. We are searching for extraordinary Hardware Engineers to take ownership in the development and system integration of very high-performance, compact camera modules and depth-sensing hardware.

Definition and trade-off studies of RGB camera and depth-sensing optics, sensors, actuator, and packaging.
Interaction with optical, electrical, process, controls systems, sensing, test, and mechanical teams on integration of camera/depth-sensing hardware into products.
Leadership of offshore manufacturing partners on camera/depth-sensing design evaluation, product prototype builds, and qualification.
Leadership of failure analysis and corrective action implementation at manufacturing sites as well as remotely, including assembly processes, testing, and calibration; parametric-data analysis of end-of-line yield and post-reliability failures.
Evaluation and debugging of camera/depth-sensing HW at module and product levels for Camera Design and Integration.
Documentation of camera-specific design, test, and manufacturing requirements.
International travel may be required to supplier facilities for product development and production bring-up.
Apple-200690082.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
BSc/MSc/PhD in relevant field (Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Optics, Physics, Materials or equivalent).

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
For BSc candidate, 3+ years working experience in optomechanical products or semiconductor is preferred
Ability to lead a multi-functional team of engineers and scientists with unique background and technical expertise through the R&D phase of product development from concept to mass production.
Ability to influence cross-functional teams, manage risk, make decisions with limited amount of information, deliver against a fast-paced development schedule.
Able to communicate and convey ideas clearly and concisely.
The applicant will also be familiar with at least 3 of the skills listed below:
Camera module or imaging system design and architecture, including optical components, optical sensing, and system integration.
Design and tolerance analysis of highly constrained, high-volume actuators or translational mechanisms.
Electronic circuit and system design including power delivery, high-speed signal integrity, electrical integration of sensor interfaces.
Understanding of geometric optics and image quality evaluation, including test charts, algorithms, and lighting.
Image/depth sensor design or characterization.
Compact module manufacturing processes such as sensor attachment, flex attachment, active alignment, etc.
Failure analysis techniques including optical microscopy, X-ray, CT scans, SEM, etc.
Ability in root-cause and corrective-action analysis.
Proficiency in statistical analysis, data reporting, and visualization.
Proven track record of successfully delivering new products into mass production on time, meeting yield and efficiency targets.

Apple-200682876.title: Campaign Operations Specialist
Apple-200682876.description:
At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming outstanding products, services and customer experiences very quickly. We believe that if you bring passion and dedication to your job, there's no telling what you can accomplish!  Apple is looking for an individual to join Worldwide Marketing team to deliver successful direct marketing / transactional emails, push notifications and outbound communications.

As a Campaign Operations Specialist, you'll own the end-to-end execution of direct marketing campaigns — email, push and others — on behalf of Product Marketing and Retail in China. You'll design audience segments, build automated workflows, and ensure every message is relevant, personalized, and compliant with China's privacy and regulatory landscape and is meeting required Apple standards.

This role is deeply cross-functional. You'll partner with teams across Worldwide Product Marketing, Marketing Communications, AppleCare, Engineering, Legal, Privacy, Compliance, Regulatory, Retail, IS&T, and Services to bring campaigns from concept to customer. You'll also serve as a bridge between global strategy and local execution, adapting Apple's marketing to China's unique platforms, regulations, and cultural context.

Design, build, and execute campaigns end-to-end — including workflows, segmentation, automation rules, and technical QA — optimizing for performance and deliverability.
Build and maintain processes, procedures, and controls that ensure data accuracy and compliance with local regulation, local anti-spam laws, and Apple's privacy and security policies.
Creatively problem-solve within known constraints — propose pragmatic solutions when resources or platforms have limitations.
Investigate operational issues, conduct root-cause analysis, and recommend process improvements.
Participate in User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for system development and platform enhancements.
Apple-200682876.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
5+ years of experience in marketing campaign operations
Hands-on experience with complex audience segmentation and campaign automation
Working experience with Snowflake procedures and Vertica database systems
Working knowledge of messaging best practices across email, push, and SMS
Advanced proficiency in writing and adjusting SQL queries
Understanding of China's email marketing regulations, including local regulation and local anti-spam laws
Familiarity with China's social commerce and messaging platforms (e.g., WeCom, Douyin, Xiaohongshu) and how they fit into broader user engagement strategies
Comfortable working across regional and global teams in a fast-paced, matrixed environment
Able to balance multiple projects concurrently and cut through ambiguity to communicate strategy clearly
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with confidence presenting to audiences ranging from team members to senior leadership
Fluent in Simplified Chinese and English (written and verbal)

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件

Apple-200677545.title: China Export Compliance Program Manager
Apple-200677545.description:
Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming great products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish.
Do you love taking on big challenges without precedent? Do you possess a deep knowledge of the legal field and a passion for innovation? As a part of our Legal group, you’ll help uphold Apple’s high ethical and corporate standards, as well as defend our intellectual property by providing legal support for all our products and businesses globally. Working for a company that invents entire categories and industries means you’ll be challenged to creatively apply your deep legal expertise to rare and often unexplored aspects of the law. 
An exciting position that is critical to the successful launch of new Apple products awaits you. This is an extraordinary opportunity to join Apple’s Global Export and Sanctions Compliance (GESC) team. Join the Apple GESC organization and make a positive impact on a company world renowned for its impressive lineup of products and technology, including the Apple Watch, iPhone, iPad, iPod, the Mac and iTunes. At Apple, you’ll share in a commitment to excellence by collaborating with extraordinary managers, all with one unified vision – creating innovative products that delight customers. We do this by hiring quality individuals with integrity, personal accountability, commit to excellence, proactive thinking, and who are team players. If you exemplify our values and want to be part of something big, contact us today.

The Global Export & Sanctions Compliance (GESC) team at Apple ensures compliance with worldwide laws governing the export of technology and products, developing creative, innovative solutions to complex compliance challenges. As an integral member of GESC, you will be responsible for a wide array of activities to:
•	Monitor and manage compliance with PRC export regulations and countermeasure regimes, including but not limited to the PRC Export Control Law (ECL), Anti-Foreign Sanctions Law (AFSL), Provisions on the Unreliable Entity List, Regulations on the Export Control of Dual-Use Items, and Administrative Regulations on the Import/Export of Technologies, alongside the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR) and other applicable foreign trade regulations.
•	Manage and support export, re-export, deemed export controls, as well as license applications for China-based transactions or activities involving Chinese personnel.  
•	Track changes to restricted/denied party lists and controlled-items lists (PRC and US) affecting Apple's China operations and supply chain.
•	Advise engineering, supply chain, and R&D teams on controlled technology handling pertaining to advanced and emerging technologies.
•	Support restricted/denied party screening and sanctions/countermeasure risk assessments for China-based transactions and partners.
•	Provide technical and strategic support to business and operations teams to address export compliance issues pertaining to cross-border activities involving China supply chain. 
•	Collaborate with the broader GESC team on regulatory analysis, due diligence, and risk mitigation involving Chinese entities or individuals.
•	Participate in cross-functional sanctions/export coordination to ensure a unified compliance posture worldwide.
In addition, you will be expected to participate and contribute to the many other facets of responsibilities which the global export and sanctions compliance team manages across the company. Come join us for an opportunity to work with people that think different.

Experience with restricted/denied party screening and reviews 
Experience in managing compliance programs for China export control and countermeasure regimes 
Excellent project management and documentation skills
Bachelor’s degree in law, engineering, international business, international trade, or a related degree or equivalent work experience.

Strong analytical capability with attention to detail and ability to clearly organize and inform through excellent written and verbal communications
Ability to build relationships and partner at all levels of the organization
Familiarity with international regulations and experience with investigating and researching companies and individuals for sanctions/countermeasure risks
Mac, MacOS and iOS proficiency

Our Advertising Platform is a set of technologies that enable thriving ecosystems for Apple’s content partners; we help publishers and developers earn money for the work that they produce, and we help consumers discover amazing content that iOS developers are creating for their iPhone and iPad. Ads in the App Store is an easy, efficient and fast-growing platform for app discovery. With over 65% of all app downloads resulting directly from a search on the App Store, Apple Ads is quickly becoming the platform of choice for app promotion for iOS developers.
